advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Fa @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt anaa @listEnteredAt yiyi kaad nna mu. Nhwɛsoɔ: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' anaa @endAt = none. Fa nsɛm a wɔafa aka ho agyiraehyɛde twa beae a woahyɛ da ayɛ no din ho, sɛ ɛde @ na efi ase a.
advanced-filter-description: Nsɛm mu yiyiyi a ɛkɔ akyiri no ma wutumi kyerɛw nsɛm a ɛwɔ ahyɛde yi: == != <= >= && || ( ) Fa ntam kwan tetew ahyɛde no mu. Wubetumi ayi afã a woahyɛ da ayɛ nyinaa mu denam wɔn din ne botae a wobɛkyerɛw so. Sɛ nhwɛso no: Field1 == Value1. Hyɛ no nsow: sɛ afã anaa botae no wɔ ntam kwan a, fa hyɛ nsɛm a wɔafa mu sɛnkyerɛnne biako mu. Sɛ nhwɛso no: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wɔfa agyiraehyɛde (' \/) sɛ nsɛm kɛkɛ a, fa \ di kan. Sɛ nhwɛso no: Field1 == I\'m. Wubetumi aka tebea pii abom nso. Sɛ nhwɛso no: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Wɔtaa kenkan ahyɛde nyinaa fi benkum kɔ nifa. Wubetumi de nkahyɛmu asesa ntoatoaso no. Sɛ nhwɛso no: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Wubetumi de regex ahwehwɛ nsɛm afã nso: F1 == /Tes.*/i

import-board-instruction-kanboard: Fa Kanboard JSON a wɔayi no bata ha: ade a ɛwɔ "columns" (anaa adwuma a ɛwɔ column_name) ne "tasks" din a wɔahyehyɛ (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns no bɛyɛ din a wɔahyehyɛ, na tasks no bɛyɛ kaad.
import-board-instruction-deck: Paste a NextCloud Deck bɔɔd JSON (a bɔɔd ne "stacks", each stack carrying its "cards"). Stacks become nhyehyɛes ne kaads become kaads.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Fa OpenProject work-packages kuw JSON (GET /api/v3/work_packages) bɔ ha. Tebea ahorow no bɛyɛ din a wɔahyehyɛ, na adwuma akuw no bɛyɛ kaad.
import-board-instruction-issues: Paste a __sourceName__ issues JSON array (__endpoint__). Issues become kaads grouped kɔ Bue / To mud nhyehyɛes.
import-board-instruction-asana: Fa Asana adwuma JSON a wɔayi no bata ha ({ "data": [...] } a efi Asana nsɛm a wɔayi anaa GET /tasks mu). Wɔkyekyɛ adwuma no mu afã (memberships); adwuma a wɔawie no kɔ Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Fa ZenKit din a wɔahyehyɛ JSON a wɔayi no bata ha ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages no bɛyɛ din a wɔahyehyɛ, na items no bɛyɛ kaad.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Fa markdown adwuma nhyehyɛe krataa (kwan a markdown-kanban nnwinnade te sɛ Obsidian Kanban de di dwuma): "## List din" ntitire, ne "- [ ]"/"- [x]" nneɛma wɔ ase. Ntitire bɛyɛ nkrataa na nneɛma bɛyɛ kaad; bullet list a checkbox nni mu nso betumi akɔ mu, sɛ kaad a ɛda hɔ.
import-board-instruction-leo: Fa Leo nhyehyɛe (.leo fael) no bata ha. Afã a ɛwɔ soro paa no bɛyɛ din a wɔahyehyɛ, afã a ɛwɔ wɔn ase pɛɛ no bɛyɛ kaad, na afã no mu nsɛm bɛyɛ kaad no nkyerɛkyerɛmu. Afã a ɛwɔ ase kɔ akyiri no bɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso. Wɔde afã a wɔahyɛ no agyirae ba sɛ nea wɔawie.
import-board-instruction-opml: Fa OPML nhyehyɛeɛ hyɛ mu, sɛdeɛ Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq ne nhyehyɛeɛ dwumadie foforɔ yi no adi no. Nneɛma a ɛwɔ soro pa ara bɛyɛ nhwɛso, wɔn mma bɛyɛ kaad a nkyerɛwee no yɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu, na nneɛma a ɛkɔ fam bɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso. Nneɛma a wɔawie no ba mu sɛ awie.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Fa Org mode fael hyɛ mu, sɛdeɛ Emacs, Orgzly anaa Beorg kyerɛw no. Ati a ɛwɔ soro pa ara bɛyɛ nhwɛso na ati a ɛtɔ so mmienu bɛyɛ kaad. TODO ne DONE, nea ɛdi kan, nsɛnkyerɛnne, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE ne CLOSED tena hɔ, na nhwehwɛmu adaka ne ati a ɛkɔ fam bɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Fa todo.txt fael bi bata ha: adwuma baako wɔ nkyekyɛmu biara mu, sɛnea todo.txt dwumadi ne dwumadi a ɛne no hyia kyerɛw no. Nnwuma a wɔawie ("x") kɔ Awie, +project ne @context yɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne, (A) yɛ ade a ɛdi kan ho nsɛnkyerɛnne, na due: ne t: yɛ da a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔwie ne da a wɔfi ase.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Fa nea efi task export mu ba no bata ha: JSON nhyehyɛe anaa adwuma baako wɔ nkyerɛwde fã biara mu. Nnwuma a wɔawie kɔ Done, project ne priority dan nsɛnkyerɛnne, annotations dan nsɛm a wɔka, na depends dan ahotoso wɔ nnwuma a esiw wɔn kwan so.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Yi .boardarchive fael no fi zip mu na fa board.jsonl a ɛwɔ bɔɔd no mu nsɛm bata ha, ɛne nkyerɛwde a ɛkyerɛ nkyerɛase no anaa ɛno nni mu. Bɔɔd no hwɛbea mu kuwkyekyɛ su dan nhyehyɛe, paw su afoforo dan nsɛnkyerɛnne, nkyerɛwee ne adaka a wɔhyɛ no agyirae no afã dan nkyerɛkyerɛmu ne nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso, na wɔkora nsɛm a wɔka no so. Wɔmfa mfonini ne fael a wɔde abata ho no mma mu.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-azuredevops: Wɔ Azure DevOps mu, bue Boards, na afei Queries, yɛ query a ɛkyerɛ afadum a wopɛ, na paw Export to CSV; paw saa .csv fael no. Board Column (anaa State) bɛyɛ ahyehyɛde no na Board Lane bɛyɛ akwan no; adwuma nneɛma bɛyɛ kaad a wɔn su ne tags yɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne, Assigned To, nna, nkyerɛkyerɛmu ne ɔwofo, na afadum a aka no bɛyɛ wo ankasa mmeae.
import-board-instruction-mslists: Wɔ Microsoft Lists mu, bue ahyehyɛde no, paw Export, na afei Export to CSV, na paw saa .csv fael no. Status afadum (anaa Progress) bɛyɛ ahyehyɛde no na adeɛ biara bɛyɛ kaad, ne ne din, nkyerɛkyerɛmu, nnipa, nna ne tags; afadum a aka no bɛyɛ wo ankasa mmeae.
import-board-instruction-msproject: Wɔ Microsoft Project mu, paw File, na afei Save As, a ne su yɛ XML Format (*.xml), na paw saa fael no. Nnwuma a ɛbɔ mu bɛyɛ akwan na nnwuma bɛyɛ kaad wɔ Wɔmfii aseɛ, Ɛrekɔ so anaa Awie mu, ne wɔn nna, nkyerɛwee, ahodeɛ, nnwuma nketewa ne wɔn a wɔdi kan.
import-board-instruction-outlook: Wɔ Outlook mu, twe nkra kɔ fɔlda bi so wɔ wo kɔmputa so, anaa kora wɔn so wɔ File, na afei Save As, sɛ Outlook Message Format (*.msg). Paw .msg fael baako, anaa .zip a .msg ne .eml fael wom. Nkɔmmɔ biara bɛyɛ kaad wɔ Board View / Email mu, ne mmuae sɛ nsusuiɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde aka ho sɛ fael.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Wɔ MeisterTask mu, mia prɔgyɛkt din no so, paw Export project na yi CSV no adi, afei fa hyɛ mu. Afã ahodoɔ bɛyɛ nhwɛso na nnwuma bɛyɛ kaad, ne wɔn nkyerɛwee, da a ɛtwa toɔ, nea wɔde adwuma ama no ne nsɛnkyerɛnne; nnwuma a wɔawie kora da a wɔwiee. CSV a wɔkyerɛw maa MeisterTask ankasa nnwuma a ɛde ba mu nso yɛ adwuma.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Wɔ Obsidian mu, bue Kanban bɔɔd fael no sɛ Markdown (anaa bue .md fael no wɔ nkyerɛwee nsiesiei mu), afei fa ne nyinaa hyɛ mu. Akwan bɛyɛ nhwɛso a wɔn kaad anohyetoɔ ka ho, kaad kora wɔn nsɛnkyerɛnne, nna, nea ɛdi kan, mmeae ne nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso, na Archive bɛyɛ kaad a ɛwɔ adekorabea.
import-board-instruction-linear: Wɔ Linear mu, yi nsɛm no adi sɛ CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, anaa hwɛbea bi deɛ a wɔyi adi), afei fa CSV no hyɛ mu. Tebea ahodoɔ bɛyɛ nhwɛso, akuo bɛyɛ akwan, na nsɛm bɛyɛ kaad a nea wɔde adwuma ama no, nsɛnkyerɛnne, nna, asɛm a ɛyɛ agya, nea ɛdi kan, nsusuiɛ, prɔgyɛkt ne kyinhyia ka ho.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Wɔ TickTick mu, bue Settings, Account, Backup & Import na yɛ ahwɛsoɔ, afei fa CSV fael no hyɛ mu. TickTick nhwɛso biara bɛyɛ kwan na ne kɔlɔm bɛyɛ nhwɛso; nnwuma kora wɔn nsɛnkyerɛnne, nna, nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso, nea ɛdi kan ne adwuma nketewa.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Wɔ ClickUp mu, yi nnwuma no adi sɛ CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, anaa List anaa Table hwɛbea deɛ a kɔlɔm nyinaa ka ho), afei fa CSV no hyɛ mu. Tebea ahodoɔ bɛyɛ nhwɛso, ClickUp nhwɛso bɛyɛ akwan, na nnwuma bɛyɛ kaad a wɔn adwuma nketewa, wɔn a wɔde adwuma ama wɔn, nsɛnkyerɛnne, nna, nea ɛdi kan ne berɛ ka ho.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Wɔ Nullboard mu, bue bɔɔd no, paw Export this board... fi menu no mu, bue .nbx fael no wɔ nkyerɛwee nsiesiei mu na fa emu nsɛm hyɛ mu. Nhwɛso bɛyɛ nhwɛso na nkyerɛwee bɛyɛ kaad: nkyerɛwee no nsensanee a ɛdi kan yɛ kaad din na nkaeɛ no yɛ ne nkyerɛkyerɛmu. Nkyerɛwee a ɛyɛ raw nya nsɛnkyerɛnne raw. Fael a bɔɔd pii wɔ mu de ne bɔɔd a ɛdi kan ba mu.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Wɔ Kanri mu, bue Import & Export na paw Export individual board (anaa Export all data), afei fa .json fael no hyɛ mu. Kɔlɔm bɛyɛ nhwɛso na kaad bɛyɛ kaad, a wɔn nkyerɛkyerɛmu, da a ɛtwa toɔ, nsɛnkyerɛnne ne kɔla ka ho; kaad nnwuma bɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso. Fi data nyinaa a wɔyi adi mu, bɔɔd a ɛdi kan na ɛba mu.
import-board-instruction-planka: Kyerɛw wo Planka address (sɛ nhwɛso https://planka.example.com), wo Planka dwumadini din ne ahintasɛm, na afei mia Kyerɛ Din. Wɔde di dwuma sɛ wɔde bɛfa bɔɔd no nko ara na wɔnkora so. Paw bɔɔd na mia Fa: WeKan kenkan fi Planka API mu, ne n'ahyehyɛde, kaad, nkyerɛkyerɛmu, da a ɛtwa toɔ, nsɛnkyerɛnne, amanfoɔ, adwuma ahyehyɛde ne nsusuiɛ, na afei toa fa ba mu so sɛnea ɛteɛ daa. Kaad a ɛwɔ Planka adekorabea no ba mu sɛ nea wɔakora; nneɛma a wɔde aka ho ne kaad a ɛwɔ nwura kɛntɛn mu mma mu.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Wɔ Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer) mu, kɔ mu, penee Tasks.Read ho kwan so na fa token no fi Access token tab no so. Fa hyɛ ha na mia Kyerɛ Din; wɔde token no di dwuma ma saa fa yi nko ara na wɔnkora so. Paw ahyehyɛde nyinaa anaa baako na mia Fa. To Do ahyehyɛde biara bɛyɛ ahyehyɛde na adwuma biara bɛyɛ kaad, ne ne nkyerɛwee, da a ɛtwa toɔ ne mfiaseɛ da, anammɔn sɛ nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso, nkyekyɛmu sɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne, ne hia kɛseɛ ne tebea sɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne; adwuma a awie no kɔ adekorabea. Nkaeɛ ne nsanɛ mma mu.
import-board-instruction-onenote: Wɔ Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer) mu, kɔ mu, penee Notes.Read ho kwan so na fa token no fi Access token tab no so. Fa hyɛ ha na mia Kyerɛ Din; wɔde token no di dwuma ma saa fa yi nko ara na wɔnkora so. Paw nkyerɛwee nhoma baako na mia Fa. Nkyekyɛmu bɛyɛ ahyehyɛde na nkratafa bɛyɛ kaad, ne wɔn nkyerɛwee, to-do adaka sɛ nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso ne nkratafa nketewa sɛ nnwuma nketewa.
import-board-instruction-teams: Fa Microsoft Graph token a Chat.Read wom (fi Graph Explorer, adwuma anaa sukuu akawnt) hyɛ ha na mia Kyerɛ Din, na afei paw nkɔmmɔ anaa kwan bi na mia Fa; wɔnkora token no so. Anaa paw fael: .tar a ɛyɛ wo ankasa export fi teams.live.com/dataexport, anaa .json a nkɔmmɔ nkra wom. Nkɔmmɔ biara bɛyɛ kaad wɔ Board View / Chat mu, ne nkra yɛ nsusuiɛ.
import-board-instruction-sandstorm: Wɔ Sandstorm mu, bue __app__ grain no, paw Download backup wɔ grain no atifi bar so, na paw .zip fael no. Grain no mu nneɛma bɛyɛ bɔɔd, na ne nneɛma bɛyɛ kaad ahodoɔ a app no kora wɔn ho nsɛm. Paw app a grain no yɛ ne dea: wɔpo grain a ɛyɛ app foforo dea, na ɛka app a ɛyɛ.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: Wɔ KanbanFlow mu, bue bɔɔd no menu, paw Settings → API & Webhooks na fa bɔɔd no API token. Fa token no hyɛ ha, mia Kyerɛ Din, paw bɔɔd no na mia Fa; wɔde token no di dwuma ma saa fa no nko ara na wɔnkora so. Afadum bɛyɛ ahyehyɛde na akwan kɔ so yɛ akwan; adwuma kora ne nkyerɛkyerɛmu, ahosu, nsɛnkyerɛnne, da a ɛtwa toɔ, nketewa adwuma sɛ nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso, berɛ a wɔde adi, nsusuiɛ, nnipa ne nsusuiɛ.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Kyerɛw wo Basecamp akawnt ID (nɔma a ɛdi basecamp.com/ akyi wɔ address no mu) ne access token (fi OAuth 2 app a wɔakyerɛw din wɔ launchpad.37signals.com, anaa nea integration bi wɔ dedaw), mia Kyerɛ Din, paw dwumadie bi na mia Fa. Wɔde token no di dwuma ma saa fa no nko ara na wɔnkora so. Kaad pon biara bɛyɛ kwan a n'afadum yɛ ahyehyɛde, na nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ ahyehyɛde bɛyɛ To-dos kwan; kaad ne nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ kora wɔn nsɛm, nna, nnipa a wɔde ama wɔn ne nsusuiɛ, kaad anammɔn bɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso, na nea awie kɔ adekorabea.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Nya access token fi OAuth 2.0 Playground: wɔ Tasks API v1 ase paw tasks.readonly, mia Authorize APIs, afei Exchange authorization code for tokens, na fa access token no. Fa hyɛ ha na mia Kyerɛ Din, paw adwuma ahyehyɛde nyinaa anaa baako, afei Fa. Wɔde token no di dwuma ma saa fa yi nko ara na wɔnkora so. Adwuma ahyehyɛde bɛyɛ ahyehyɛde na adwuma bɛyɛ kaad, ne wɔn nkyerɛwee, link ne da a ɛtwa toɔ; nketewa adwuma bɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso na adwuma a awie ba mu sɛ nea wɔakora.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: Google Keep API no yɛ Google Workspace akawnt nko ara dea. Nya OAuth 2.0 access token a ne scope yɛ https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (wɔ OAuth 2.0 Playground mu sɛ wo Workspace admin ma kwan, anaa fi service akawnt a ɔwɔ domain nyinaa tumi), fa hyɛ mu, mia Kyerɛ Din na afei Fa. Wɔde token no di dwuma ma saa fa yi nko ara na wɔnkora so. Nkyerɛwee nsɛm bɛyɛ kaad wɔ Nkyerɛwee ahyehyɛde mu, na nhwehwɛmu nkyerɛwee bɛyɛ kaad wɔ Ahyehyɛde ahyehyɛde mu a wɔn nneɛma yɛ nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso. Nkyerɛwee a ɛwɔ nwura kɛntɛn mu, nneɛma a wɔde aka ho ne kyɛ mma mu.
api-import-desc: Fa fi adwumayɛbea no ne w'ankasa w'akawnt. Nea wokyerɛw wɔ ha no, wɔde di dwuma ma saa fa yi nko ara na wɔnkora so.
api-import-token: Access token a wɔde kɔ mu
api-import-list: Kyerɛ Din nea wotumi de ba mu
api-import-fetched: Wɔafa. Hwɛ amanfoɔ a wɔwɔ ase hɔ na fa ba mu.
api-import-nothing: Biribiara nni hɔ a wode bɛba mu wɔ saa akawnt yi so.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Wɔ Pivotal Tracker mu, bue prɔgyɛkt no MORE tab na paw Export CSV (anaa paw abasɛm na paw Bulk Actions, CSV), afei fa CSV no hyɛ mu. Abasɛm tebea biara bɛyɛ nhwɛso na abasɛm bɛyɛ kaad, a wɔn su ne nsɛnkyerɛnne, wuranom, nea ɔbisaeɛ, nna, nsusuiɛ, nnwuma ne nkwanssiansiane ka ho; Estimate bɛyɛ Story points na mpɛn ahodoɔ bɛyɛ sprint.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Wɔ Tasks.org mu, bue Settings, Backups na paw Export tasks, afei fa saa .json fael no mu nsɛm hyɛ mu. Nhwɛso bɛyɛ nhwɛso na nnwuma bɛyɛ kaad, a wɔn nkyerɛwee, nsɛnkyerɛnne, nna, nsusuiɛ ne adwuma nketewa ka ho; nnwuma a wɔawie kora da a wɔwiee, na nea ɛdi kan bɛyɛ wo ankasa beae.
import-board-instruction-monday: Wɔ monday.com mu, bue bɔɔd menu no, paw More actions ne Export board to Excel (a nsɛm foforɔ ne nneɛma nketewa ka ho sɛ wopɛ a), afei paw saa .xlsx fael no. Status kɔlɔm no bɛyɛ nhwɛso na akuo bɛyɛ akwan; nnipa, nna, berɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛnne tena wɔn mmeae, kɔlɔm foforɔ bɛyɛ wo ankasa mmeae na nsɛm foforɔ bɛyɛ nsusuiɛ.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Wɔ Super Productivity mu, bue Settings, afei Sync & Backup, paw Export Data na fa sp-backup .json fael no mu nsɛm hyɛ mu. Prɔgyɛkt biara bɛyɛ kwan na nnwuma bɛyɛ kaad wɔ To Do, In Progress, Backlog anaa Done mu, a wɔn nkyerɛwee, nsɛnkyerɛnne, da a ɛtwa toɔ, berɛ a wɔde dii dwuma ne adwuma nketewa ka ho; nnwuma a ɛwɔ adekorabea bɛyɛ kaad a ɛwɔ adekorabea.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Wɔ Taiga mu, bue Admin > Project > Export na twe prɔgyɛkt no nyinaa (bue .json.gz fael no kan), afei fa ne JSON hyɛ mu. Dwumadini abasɛm tebea bɛyɛ nhwɛso, dwumadini abasɛm bɛyɛ kaad a wɔn nnwuma yɛ adwuma nketewa, epic ne nsɛm nya wɔn ankasa akwan, na sprint, nsɛnkyerɛnne, nsusuiɛ ne wo ankasa su nso ka ho ba. Wɔmfa nneɛma a wɔde aka ho mma mu.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Wɔ Vikunja mu, bue Settings, paw Data Export na twe .zip fael a ɛde bɛbrɛ wo no, afei paw saa fael no, anaa fa data.json a ɛwɔ mu no hyɛ mu. Kanban bokiti bɛyɛ nhwɛso na nnwuma bɛyɛ kaad, a wɔn nsɛnkyerɛnne, wɔn a wɔde adwuma ama wɔn, nna, nkyerɛkyerɛmu, adwuma nhwɛso sɛ nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso ne nsusuiɛ ka ho; nea ɛdi kan, ɔha nkyɛmu a wɔawie ne awie bɛyɛ wo ankasa mmeae. Wɔmfa nneɛma a wɔde aka ho mma mu.
import-board-instruction-quire: Wɔ Quire mu, bue prɔgyɛkt menu no na paw Export CSV, afei fa CSV no hyɛ mu. Tebea ahodoɔ bɛyɛ nhwɛso na nnwuma bɛyɛ kaad, a wɔn adwuma nketewa sɛ kaad mma, wɔn a wɔde adwuma ama wɔn, nsɛnkyerɛnne, mfiase, ɛtwa toɔ ne awieɛ nna, nkyerɛkyerɛmu ne nea ɛdi kan sɛ wo ankasa beae ka ho. Nsusuiɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde aka ho nni Quire CSV mu.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Wɔ Wrike mu, yi prɔgyɛkt anaa fɔlda bi adi kɔ Excel mu, anaa hyɛ Wrike Excel nhwɛsoɔ a wɔde fa ba mu no ma, afei paw saa .xlsx fael no. Fɔlda ne prɔgyɛkt nsensanee bɛyɛ akwan, Status bɛyɛ nhwɛso na nnwuma bɛyɛ kaad, a wɔn Key, adwuma a ɛyɛ agya, wɔn a wɔde adwuma ama wɔn, mfiase ne awieɛ nna, nneɛma a wɔde wɔn ho to so ne nkyerɛkyerɛmu ka ho; Priority, Duration ne kɔlɔm foforɔ bɛyɛ wo ankasa mmeae.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Wɔ Teamwork.com mu, hyɛ Excel adwuma nhwɛsoɔ a wɔde fa ba mu no ma (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) na sie no sɛ .xlsx, afei paw saa fael no. Adwuma nhwɛso bɛyɛ nhwɛso na nnwuma bɛyɛ kaad; adwuma a ɛfi ase de -, # anaa > bɛyɛ adwuma ketewa ma adwuma a ɛwɔ ne soro (--, ## anaa >> kɔ fam baako bio). Wɔn a wɔde adwuma ama wɔn, nna ne nsɛnkyerɛnne tena wɔn mmeae; Priority, Estimated time ne Complete bɛyɛ wo ankasa mmeae.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Wɔ Businessmap (kane no Kanbanize) mu, bue Advanced Search, paw Configure results na paw kɔlɔm no, twe Excel fael no, afei paw saa .xlsx fael no. Wɔkenkan kɔlɔm no wɔ wɔn Borɔfo din so (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): sɛ wo akawnt de kasa foforɔ di dwuma a, sesa ati nsensanee no kɔ Borɔfo mu kan. Column bɛyɛ nhwɛso na Lane bɛyɛ akwan; wuranom, nsɛnkyerɛnne, kɔla, nna, nsusuiɛ ne agya linki tena wɔn mmeae, na Priority, Size, Type ne kɔlɔm foforɔ bɛyɛ wo ankasa mmeae.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Wɔ Redmine mu, bue prɔgyɛkt no Issues, paw Also available in: CSV wɔ nhwɛso no ase, paw kɔlɔm no (All columns, a Description ka ho) na yi adi, afei fa CSV no hyɛ mu. Redmine de wo kasa to kɔlɔm no din, enti sesa wo kasa kɔ Borɔfo wɔ My account mu ansa na woayi adi. Tebea biara bɛyɛ nhwɛso na nsɛm bɛyɛ kaad, a tracker no sɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne, nea wɔde adwuma ama no, ɔkyerɛwfoɔ, nna, adwuma a ɛyɛ agya ne nsɛm a ɛfa ho ka ho; nea ɛdi kan, nkyekyɛmu, ɔsɛsoɔ a wɔrebɔ ho mmɔden, berɛ a wɔasusu, % Done ne wo ankasa mmeae bɛyɛ wo ankasa mmeae.
import-board-instruction-notion: Wɔ Notion mu, bue database no sɛ krataafa a ɛyɛ ma, paw ••• ne Export, paw Markdown & CSV, na paw .zip fael a ɛtwe no, anaa database CSV baako a ɛwɔ mu, anaa fa saa CSV no hyɛ mu. Kɔlɔm a ne din de Status bɛyɛ nhwɛso no (sɛ ɛnni hɔ a, kɔlɔm a ɛdi kan a ɛte sɛ apaweɛ na ɛbɛyɛ, na nsɛm a ɛfa fa ba mu ho no bɛka deɛ ɛyɛ); nsensanee bɛyɛ kaad a wɔn din, nsɛnkyerɛnne, nnipa sɛ amanfoɔ, nna, ne krataafa no nkyerɛwee sɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu ka ho; kɔlɔm foforɔ bɛyɛ wo ankasa mmeae. Wɔmfa abusuabɔ, mfonini ne nneɛma a wɔde aka ho mma mu.
import-board-instruction-plane: Wɔ Plane mu, bue Workspace Settings, paw Exports, yi prɔgyɛkt no adi sɛ JSON, CSV anaa Excel na twe .zip fael no, afei paw saa fael no, anaa fael baako a ɛwɔ mu, anaa fa JSON anaa CSV no hyɛ mu. Tebea ahodoɔ bɛyɛ nhwɛso, prɔgyɛkt bɛyɛ akwan, na nsɛm bɛyɛ kaad a wɔn nsɛnkyerɛnne nɔma, agya, wɔn a wɔde adwuma ama wɔn, nsɛnkyerɛnne, nna, linki ne nsusuiɛ ka ho; nea ɛdi kan, nsusuiɛ, kyinhyia ne module bɛyɛ wo ankasa mmeae. Plane deɛ a wɔyi adi nni nkyerɛkyerɛmu anaa nneɛma a wɔde aka ho, enti wɔmfa mma mu.
import-board-instruction-fizzy: Wɔ Fizzy mu, yi akawnt no fi wɔ "Account settings" mu, anaa wo ankasa wo kaad ahodoɔ fa "Download my data" so, na paw .zip fael a Fizzy de bɛmena wo no, anaa kaad baako .json fael. Bɔɔd ahodoɔ bɛyɛ akwan na nkyerɛwee bɛyɛ nhwɛso ahodoɔ, a "Maybe?", "Not now" ne "Done" te sɛ wɔ Fizzy mu; kaad ahodoɔ kura wɔn nkyerɛkyerɛmu, nsɛnkyerɛnne, nnipa a wɔde adwuma ama wɔn, anammɔn sɛ nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso, nsusuiɛ ne fael.
import-board-instruction-mail: Paw .mbox fael, sɛnea Thunderbird, Apple Mail, mutt anaa Gmail fa Google Takeout so kora no, anaa .eml nkra baako, anaa fa ne nsɛm no hyɛ mu. Nkɔmmɔbɔ biara bɛyɛ kaad baako wɔ Inbox nhwɛso no mu, ne nea ɔde mane, nea wɔde kɔma ne asɛmti, sɛnea ɛbɛda adi wɔ Email nhwɛe no mu; mmuae no bɛyɛ ne nsusuiɛ. Gmail nsɛnkyerɛnne bɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne. Wɔmfa nneɛma a wɔde aka ho mmra mu.
import-board-instruction-ical: Paw .ics kalenda fael, sɛnea Google Calendar, Apple Calendar anaa Reminders, Thunderbird, Nextcloud anaa Outlook yi no fi, anaa fa ne nsɛm no hyɛ mu. Nnwuma kɔ To Do, In Progress, Done anaa Cancelled sɛnea wɔn tebea te, na dwumadi kɔ Events, ne wɔn mfiase ne bere a ɛsɛ sɛ wowie, sɛnea ɛbɛda adi wɔ Calendar ne Gantt nhwɛe no mu. Nkyekyɛmu ne nea edi kan bɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne. Nneɛma a ɛsan ba no, wɔde ba mu prɛko pɛ.
import-board-instruction-googletakeout: Wɔ takeout.google.com, paw Tasks, Keep, Mail, Calendar ne Google Chat, yɛ export no na twe .zip fael no, afei paw wɔ ha. Adwuma biara bɛyɛ ɔkwan: krataa ma Email nhwɛe no, nnwuma nhwɛso ne nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw ne wɔn nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso, kalenda dwumadi ne nnwuma a ɛwɔ da, ne nkɔmmɔbɔ beae a wɔn nkra yɛ nsusuiɛ ma Chat nhwɛe no. Wɔmfa nneɛma afoforo ne nneɛma a wɔde aka ho mmra mu.
import-board-instruction-slack: Wɔ Slack mu, bue workspace nhyehyɛe, paw Import/Export Data, yi workspace no fi na twe .zip fael no, afei paw wɔ ha. Channel biara bɛyɛ kaad wɔ Channels, Groups anaa Direct messages mu, na ne nkra ne mmuae bɛyɛ kaad no nsusuiɛ, sɛnea nea ɔkyerɛwee te, sɛnea Chat nhwɛe no bɛkyerɛ channel no. Wɔmfa fael mmra mu.
import-board-instruction-mattermost: Fa mmctl export create yi fi, twe export no na paw ne .jsonl fael, anaa fa ne nsɛm no hyɛ mu. Channel biara ne nkra tee biara bɛyɛ kaad, na ne nsɛm ne mmuae bɛyɛ kaad no nsusuiɛ, sɛnea Chat nhwɛe no bɛkyerɛ channel no. Akuo bɛyɛ akwan. Wɔmfa fael mmra mu.
import-board-instruction-telegram: Wɔ Telegram Desktop mu, bue Settings, Advanced, Export Telegram data, paw JSON ɔkwan na yi fi, afei paw result.json fael no, anaa fa ne nsɛm no hyɛ mu. Nkɔmmɔbɔ biara bɛyɛ kaad wɔ Direct messages, Groups anaa Channels mu, na ne nkra bɛyɛ kaad no nsusuiɛ, sɛnea Chat nhwɛe no bɛkyerɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ no. Wɔmfa mfonini ne fael mmra mu.
import-board-instruction-whatsapp: Wɔ WhatsApp mu, bue nkɔmmɔbɔ no, paw Export chat a media nni mu, na paw .txt fael no wɔ ha, anaa fa ne nsɛm no hyɛ mu. Nkɔmmɔbɔ no bɛyɛ kaad a ne nkra yɛ ne nsusuiɛ, sɛnea nea ɔde mane ne bere no te, sɛnea Chat nhwɛe no bɛkyerɛ. Wɔmfa media ne sistem nkra mmra mu.
import-board-instruction-discord: Fa DiscordChatExporter yi Discord channel fi wɔ JSON ɔkwan so na paw .json fael no, anaa fa ne nsɛm no hyɛ mu. Channel no bɛyɛ kaad wɔ ne nkyekyɛmu mu, na ne nkra bɛyɛ kaad no nsusuiɛ, sɛnea Chat nhwɛe no bɛkyerɛ channel no. Server no bɛyɛ ɔkwan no. Wɔmfa nneɛma a wɔde aka ho mmra mu.
import-board-instruction-rocketchat: Wɔ Rocket.Chat mu, yi wo data fi sɛ JSON wɔ "My Data" mu na paw .zip fael a ɛde bɛmena wo no, anaa dan baako .json fael a wɔayi afi. Dan biara bɛyɛ kaad na ne nkra bɛyɛ kaad no nsusuiɛ, sɛnea Chat nhwɛe no bɛkyerɛ dan no. Wɔkenkan .zip a WeKan yi ma Rocket.Chat CSV importer no nso.
import-board-instruction-evernote: Wɔ Evernote mu, yi nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw anaa nhoma baako fi sɛ .enex fael na paw wɔ ha, anaa fa ne nsɛm no hyɛ mu. Nsɛm biara bɛyɛ kaad a ne nsɛm, ne to-do adaka sɛ nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso, ne tags sɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne ne ne nkaebɔ sɛ bere a ɛsɛ sɛ wowie; nsɛm a ne nkaebɔ awie no kɔ Done. Wɔmfa mfonini ne fael a wɔde aka ho mmra mu.

Fa ba mu kenkan JSON a wɔde ahyɛ mu wɔ soro no, fi WeKan anaa Wrike GET /workflows, kɔ bɔɔd a wɔapaw no mu: tebea a nhwɛso nni hɔ ma no bɛyɛ nhwɛso, na mmara bi hyɛ kaad agyiraeɛ sɛ awie sɛ wɔde kɔ Completed anaa Cancelled tebea mu, na ɛnwieeɛ sɛ ɛwɔ Active anaa Deferred mu. globalSearch-instructions-description: Wubetumi de ahyɛde aka nhwehwɛmu ho na ama nea worehwehwɛ no ada adi pɛpɛɛpɛ. Kyerɛw ahyɛde no din ne botae, na fa colon (:) kyekyɛ mu. Sɛ nhwɛso no, `list:Blocked` ma nhwehwɛmu no fa kaad a ɛwɔ din a wɔahyehyɛ a wɔfrɛ no *Blocked* mu nkutoo ho. Sɛ botae no wɔ ntam kwan anaa agyiraehyɛde soronko a, ɛsɛ sɛ wode hyɛ nsɛm a wɔafa mu sɛnkyerɛnne mu (sɛ nhwɛso no, `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operators: Ahyɛde a wubetumi de adi dwuma:
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - kaads wɔ bɔɔds matching no specified *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - kaads wɔ nhyehyɛes matching no specified *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - kaads wɔ kwans matching no specified *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-comme: `__operator_comment__:<text>` - kaad a ɛwɔ adwenkyerɛ a *<text>* wom.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - kaad a ɛwɔ agyiraehyɛde a ɛne *<color>* anaa *<name> hyia
globalSearch-instructions-operator-hash: `__operator_label_abbrev__<name|color>` - ɔkwan tiaa a wɔde kyerɛ `__operator_label__:<color>` anaa `__operator_label__:<name>`
globalSearch-instructions-operator-user: `__operator_user__:<username>` - kaad a *<username>* yɛ *ɔmannifo* anaa *nea wɔde ahyɛ ne nsa*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-assig: `__operator_assignee__:<username>` - kaad a *<username>* yɛ *nea wɔde ahyɛ ne nsa*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - kaad a ɛwɔ bɔɔd a wɔde ahyɛ ahyehyɛde *<name>* nsa so
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - kaad a ɛwɔ bɔɔd a wɔde ahyɛ kuw *<name>* nsa so
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - kaad a ɛsɛ sɛ wowie wɔ nna *<n>* anaa nea ennu saa mu fi seesei. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ kyerɛ kaad a ne bere a ɛsɛ sɛ wowie atwam no nyinaa.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - kaads which were yɛɛ *<n>* days ago anaa less
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - kaads which were modified *<n>* days ago anaa less
globalSearch-instructions-operator-statu: `__operator_status__:<status>` - *<status>* yɛ nea edidi so yi mu biako:
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - kaad nyinaa, nea ɛwɔ adekorabea ne nea enni adekorabea
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - kaads nko ara wɔ public bɔɔds
globalSearch-instructions-status-private: `__predicate_private__` - kaads nko ara wɔ private bɔɔds
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - *<field>* yɛ `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` anaa `__predicate_member__` mu biako. Sɛ wode `-` di *<field>* anim a, ɛhwehwɛ sɛ botae biara nni saa afã no mu (sɛ nhwɛso no, `has:-due` hwehwɛ kaad a enni da a ɛsɛ sɛ wowie).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - *<sort-name>* yɛ `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` anaa `__predicate_modified__` mu biako. Sɛ wopɛ nhyehyɛe a efi soro ba fam a, fa `-` di nhyehyɛe din no anim.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - *<n>* yɛ nɔma mũ a ɛboro 0 a ɛkyerɛ kaad dodow a wɔbɛkyerɛ wɔ kratafa biara so.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Wɔde ahyɛde a ɛwɔ ɔkwan koro mu bom wɔ *OR* kwan so. Kaad a ɛne emu tebea biara hyia no bɛba.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` bɛma kaad a ɛwɔ din a wɔahyehyɛ a wɔfrɛ no *Blocked* anaa *Available* mu aba.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Wɔde ahyɛde a ɛsono emu biara bom wɔ *AND* kwan so. Kaad a ɛne ahyɛde ahorow no nyinaa hyia nkutoo na ɛba. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` de kaad a ɛwɔ *Available* din no mu a ɛwɔ *red* agyiraehyɛde nkutoo ba.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Wubetumi akyerɛ nna sɛ nɔma mũ a ɛboro 0 anaa nea ɛba fam sen 0, anaa wode `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` anaa `__predicate_year__` akyerɛ bere a ɛwɔ hɔ seesei no.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Nsɛm mu nhwehwɛmu no mfa nkyerɛwde akɛse ne nketewa nsonsonoe nyɛ adwuma.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Sɛ woansesa nhyehyɛe no a, wɔnhwehwɛ kaad a ɛwɔ adekorabea mu.

sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Sɛ nsɛm a wɔde kɔ baabi foforo no yɛ yiye a, nsɛm no wɔ FerretDB ne fael nhyehyɛe no mu, enti wubetumi apopa MongoDB 3 nsɛm akorabea fael dedaw no ama grain disk so baabi ada hɔ. Wuntumi nsan nyi eyi.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Popa MongoDB 3 nsɛm akorabea fael no na ma disk so baabi nna hɔ? Wɔde nsɛm no akɔ FerretDB ne fael nhyehyɛe no mu dedaw. Wuntumi nsan nyi eyi.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Wɔapopa MongoDB nsɛm akorabea fael ankasa no; beae a ada hɔ
features-desc: Nneɛma a WeKan ma wo kwan ma wopaw sɛ wode bɛyɛ adwuma. Ade a wɔanhyɛ no agyirae no, wɔde sie afi wɔn a wɔde di dwuma nyinaa anim. Wɔkora ne data so, na tumi a wɔde ama no nsesa.
feature-views-table-desc: Bɔɔd no sɛ kaad pon a wobetumi ahyehyɛ.
feature-views-overview-desc: Akontaabu, kyekyɛ mu sɛnea onipa a wɔde adwuma ama no te, adwuma ho nhyehyɛe, nsɛm bɔɔd ne bɔɔd kɛse.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Adwuma a aka wɔ ade a wɔreyɛ no ho, adwumayɛ bere ntiantiaa, saa bere no ho amanneɛbɔ ne adwumayɛ ahoɔhare.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Adwuma a aka, adwuma a wɔawie, adwuma nantew a wɔaboaboa ano, adwumayɛ bere ne twɛntwɛn bere, adwuma a wɔawie dodow, bere a adwuma de atwɛn, akwanside, Monte Carlo ne adwuma nantew ho susudua afoforo.
feature-views-map-desc: Kaad ahorow sɛ agyiraehyɛde wɔ mfonini a wɔde akɔ so.
feature-approval-required: Ma nneɛma a WeKan foforoyɛ de ba no ntumi nyɛ adwuma kosi sɛ ɔhwɛfo bɛma wɔayɛ adwuma
feature-preview-admins: Ahwɛfo hu nneɛma a wɔadum no, na wɔasɔ ahwɛ ansa
feature-pilot-users: Wɔn a wɔde sɔ hwɛ a wɔn nso hu nneɛma a wɔadum no
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Wɔn a wɔde di dwuma din, fa koma tetew mu
feature-profiles-desc: Wo ho nsɛm yi de nea wɔapaw no sie fi dwumadifoɔ, akuo ne nkabomkuo a wɔde ama wɔn no ho. Wɔka kyerɛ dwumadini biara wo ho nsɛm a ɔwɔ. Obi a onni bi no, ɛnka no, wɔmpopa data biara na tumi biara nsesa.
feature-profile-teams: Akuo, baako wɔ nkyerɛwee biara so
feature-profile-orgs: Nkabomkuo, baako wɔ nkyerɛwee biara so
feature-profile-remove: Yi wo ho nsɛm no fi hɔ
feature-profile-add: Fa wo ho nsɛm ka ho
feature-profile-notice: Wo ho nsɛm __name__ de nneɛma __count__ asie. Bisa sodifo sɛ wohia emu baako a.
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Wɔasie. Wɔanhu wɔn a wɔde di dwuma din yi:
card-field-visibility-desc: Afã a ɛwɔ Bɔɔd nhyehyɛeɛ / Kaad a bɔɔd ahorow betumi akyerɛ. Sɛ wɔyi agyiraehyɛde no fi ɔfã bi so a, wɔde saa ɔfã no sie wɔ kaad nyinaa, kaad nketewa ne Bɔɔd nhyehyɛeɛ / Kaad mu wɔ bɔɔd nyinaa so. Kaad ho nsɛm ne bɔɔd nhyehyɛeɛ nsesa. Sɛ wɔsan hyɛ no agyirae a, bɔɔd biara da adi sɛnea wɔhyehyɛɛ no kan no. Bɔɔd biara wɔ n'afã nhyehyɛeɛ ankasa.
features-performance: Sɛnea dwumadi no yɛ adwuma yiye
cards-loading-auto: Ɛno ankasa (kaad a wohia nkutoo ma bɔɔd akɛse)
cards-loading-lazy: Kaad a wohia nkutoo (nea wohu nkutoo)
cards-loading-description: WeKan ankasa de bɔɔd kaad ba: bɔɔd kɛse (a ɛboro kɛseyɛ ano a wɔahyɛ) de kaad a wohu seesei nkutoo ba (wotwe a, ɛtoa so) ne dodow a ɛsesa ntɛm, enti ɛyɛ ntɛm na ɛde memory ne nkitahodi ahoɔden kakraa bi di dwuma. Bɔɔd nketewa de kaad nyinaa ba ma dwumadi nyinaa yɛ mmerɛw. Biribiara nni hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wohyehyɛ. Wɔn a wɔhwɛ nhyehyɛe no so betumi de CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) ne CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD nhyehyɛe ahorow ahyɛ ɔkwan bi.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Kaad kakraa bi a wɔde ba bere a ɛho hia no da so wɔ sɔhwɛ mu: kaad dodow ne adwuma a ɛrekɔ so ano no yɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, nanso Kalenda/Pon/Gantt ne nneɛma pii a wɔpaw no fa kaad a wɔde aba dedaw no nkutoo ho. Sɛ wosesa eyi a, san bue bɔɔd a abue no.
render-links-as-plain-text: Kyerɛ link sɛ nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw kɛkɛ
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Sɛ wɔasɔ a, link nyinaa (markdown link te sɛ [label](url) ne HTML <a href> agyiraehyɛde) da adi bere nyinaa sɛ nsɛm kɛkɛ a wuntumi mmia so wɔ nsɛm afã biara mu (bɔɔd ne kaad asɛmti, nkyerɛkyerɛmu, adwenkyerɛ, nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ ho din ne nea ɛkeka ho). Eyi siw link a ɛdaadaa no ano. Wɔadum fi mfiase, enti wotumi mia link so.
always-show-code-as-text-description: Sɛ wɔasɔ a, wɔmfa nsɛm no nkyerɛ sɛ markdown anaa HTML da: wɔkyerɛ nsɛm no fibea nyinaa sɛ nsɛm kɛkɛ wɔ afã biara mu (bɔɔd ne kaad asɛmti, nkyerɛkyerɛmu, adwenkyerɛ, nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ ho din ne nea ɛkeka ho). Eyi da nsɛm a ahintaw adi — HTML adwenkyerɛ (<!-- -->), baabi a markdown link kɔ, JavaScript ne koodu foforo biara — enti koodu nyinaa da adi bere nyinaa, wuntumi mmia so, na ɛnyɛ adwuma. Wɔadum fi mfiase, enti wɔkyerɛ markdown sɛnea ɛtaa te.
disable-all-import: Dum nsɛm a wɔde ba mu no nyinaa
disable-all-import-description: Sɛ wɔasɔ a, wɔadum nsɛm a wɔde ba mu no nyinaa: bɔɔd a wɔde fi WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea ne Forgejo ba mu, ne bɔɔd a wɔyɛ bi foforo. Wɔde nea wubetumi apaw de aba mu no sie, na som afiri no po adesrɛ biara sɛ wɔmfa nsɛm mmra mu. Wɔadum fi mfiase.
import-max-megabytes: Fael kɛse a wɔde ba mu (MB)
import-max-megabytes-description: Fael kɛse a ɛsen biara a Fa ba mu krataafa no gye, wɔ megabytes mu. Sɛ ɛyɛ hunu a, ɛkyerɛ sɛ anohyeto biara nni hɔ: fael no betumi ayɛ kɛse sɛnea baabi a ɛda mpan wɔ disk no so ma kwan ma fa ba mu no ba awiei. Wɔkyerɛw biribiara a wɔde kɔ soro no gu server no disk so fã fã, na wɔpo fa ba mu biara a ɛbɛma disk no ayɛ ma.
import-disk-full: Baabi a ɛda mpan nnɔɔso wɔ server no disk so mma saa fa ba mu yi.
import-upload-not-found: Fael a wɔde kɔɔ soro no nni hɔ bio. San paw.
import-upload-failed: Wɔantumi amfa fael no ankɔ soro.
import-upload-aborted: Wɔtwaa fael a wɔde rekɔ soro no mu.
disable-all-export: Dum nsɛm a woyi kɔ abɔnten no nyinaa
disable-all-export-description: Sɛ wɔasɔ a, wɔadum nsɛm a woyi kɔ abɔnten no nyinaa: bɔɔd a woyi sɛ WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, anaa kɔ NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, ne ade biako a wɔde abata ho a woyi kɔ abɔnten. Wɔde nea wubetumi apaw de ayi akɔ abɔnten no sie, na som afiri no po adesrɛ biara sɛ wonyi nsɛm nkɔ abɔnten. Wɔadum fi mfiase.
disable-import-avatars: Dum wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no mfonini a wɔde ba mu
disable-import-avatars-description: Sɛ wɔasɔ a, wɔmfa wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no mfonini mmra mu da. Eyi ka WeKan JSON, Trello ne mfonini a wɔde fi abɔnten nokwaredi nhyehyɛe ba bere a wɔkɔ mu (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Wɔda so de din ne nsɛm foforo ba mu; mfonini nkutoo na wɔgyae. Wɔadum fi mfiase.
disable-export-avatars: Dum wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no mfonini a woyi kɔ abɔnten
disable-export-avatars-description: Sɛ wɔasɔ a, wɔmfa wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no mfonini nka bɔɔd a woyi kɔ abɔnten no ho da (WeKan JSON ne CSV). Wɔda so yi din ne nsɛm foforo kɔ abɔnten; mfonini nkutoo na wɔayi afi mu. Wɔadum fi mfiase.
anonymize-import-users: Yi nnipa a wɔde wɔn ba mu no din ankasa fi hɔ
anonymize-import-users-description: Sɛ wɔasɔ a, WeKan JSON bɔɔd a wɔde ba mu no de din a wɔakan (user1, user2, ...) si obiara din, ne din nyinaa ne din mfiase nkyerɛwde ananmu, yi ne mfonini fi hɔ, na san kyerɛw @username a wɔabɔ din (ne requested-by / assigned-by afã) wɔ kaad ne adwenkyerɛ mu. Wɔnsie obiara din ankasa a efi bɔɔd no mu. Asɛmfua "user" no di nea ɔde nsɛm no ba mu no kasa akyi. Wɔadum fi mfiase.
anonymize-export-users: Yi nnipa a woyi wɔn nsɛm kɔ abɔnten no din ankasa fi hɔ
anonymize-export-users-description: Sɛ wɔasɔ a, bɔɔd a woyi kɔ abɔnten no de din a wɔakan (user1, user2, ...) si obiara din, ne din nyinaa ne din mfiase nkyerɛwde ananmu, yi ne mfonini fi hɔ, na san kyerɛw @username a wɔabɔ din (ne requested-by / assigned-by afã) wɔ kaad ne adwenkyerɛ mu. Fael a woyi no nkura obiara din ankasa. Asɛmfua "user" no di nea oyi nsɛm no no kasa akyi. Wɔadum fi mfiase.
anonymize-account: Yi akontaabu no ho din ankasa fi hɔ
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Wopɛ sɛ woyi akontaabu yi ho din ankasa fi hɔ ampa? Eyi de din a ɛnkyerɛ onipa no si ne din, ne din nyinaa ne email address ananmu korakora, yi ne mfonini fi hɔ, na dum mu a ɔbɛkɔ. Ɛnte sɛ popa: bɔɔd, kaad ne adwenkyerɛ kura wɔn abakɔsɛm na ɛda so kyerɛ akontaabu yi, nanso ɛnkyerɛ ne din ankasa. Wuntumi nsan nyi adeyɛ yi.
disable-activities-description: Sɛ wɔasɔ a, wɔntwerɛ dwumadi kyerɛwtohɔ na wɔnnkyerɛ wɔ baabiara da (bɔɔd no nkyɛn ne kaad dwumadi afã). Wɔnkora nea ɔyɛɛ biribi no ho abakɔsɛm so. Wɔadum fi mfiase.
disable-notifications-description: Sɛ wɔasɔ a, WeKan mmɔ akyidi amanneɛ wɔ dwumadi biara ho da (wɔ app mu, email anaa ɔsom foforo mu). Wobetumi akɔ so akyerɛw dwumadi no (gye sɛ wɔadum ɛno nso wɔ soro); amanneɛbɔ nkutoo na wɔasiw ano. Wɔadum fi mfiase.
disable-watch-description: Sɛ wɔasɔ a, wɔadum akyidi no — wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no ntumi mpaw sɛ wɔbɛgye bɔɔd, din a wɔahyehyɛ anaa kaad ho amanneɛbɔ, na wɔpo mmɔden biara sɛ wɔbɛsesa akyidi dodow. Wɔadum fi mfiase.
backup-description: Kora fael a wɔde aka ho, ahyɛnsode mfonini ne/anaa nsɛm ho mfonini so (nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw a ɛnyɛ fael a wɔde aka ho anaa ahyɛnsode mfonini nyinaa). Wɔde .zip no kɔ akorae a wɔapaw no tẽẽ; wɔnyɛ fael a ɛbɛtena hɔ bere tiaa bi. Wɔkora no so sɛ backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, a YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars ne /data wɔ mu. Intanɛt so akorae (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) de akwanhyɛ nsɛm a wɔahyehyɛ wɔ wɔn akorae ntab mu no na ɛyɛ adwuma.
backup-scope: Nea wɔde bɛka nsɛm a wɔkora so no ho
backup-scope-description: Nhyehyɛe yi nyinaa anaa Ahyehyɛde biako. Ahyehyɛde bi nsɛm a wɔakora so no kura ne bɔɔd ne biribiara a ɛwɔ so, a nneɛma a wɔde abata saa bɔɔd no ho ka ho — nanso nnipa akontaabu ne nhyehyɛe no ankasa nhyehyɛe nka ho, efisɛ Ahyehyɛde biara kyɛ saa nneɛma no. Ahyehyɛde bi nsɛm a wɔakora so a wɔsan de ba no kyerɛw bɔɔd a saa Ahyehyɛde no wɔ nkutoo so.
theme-override-all-tenants: Nsakrae a ɛhyɛ wɔn a wɔkyɛ nhyehyɛe no nyinaa de ananmu
backup-now: Kora nsɛm no bi so seesei
backup-done: Wɔawie nsɛm no bi a wɔkora so
backup-schedule: Nsɛm no bi a wɔkora so a wɔahyɛ ho bere
continuous-backup: Nsɛm ho mfonini a wɔkora so bere nyinaa
continuous-backup-description: Ɛde nsakrae biara a ɛba nsɛm siebea, fael a wɔde aka ho, ahyɛnsode mfonini ne dwumadi kyerɛwtohɔ mu kɔ fael akorae wɔ sikɔne kakraa bi mu, na wɔatumi asan de tebea a na ɛwɔ bere biara mu aba. Ɛne nsɛm akora a wɔahyɛ bere ama no no yɛ adwuma; ɛno na ɛyɛ nsɛm nyinaa ho mfonini.
continuous-backup-enabled: Ma nsɛm ho mfonini akora a ɛkɔ so bere nyinaa nyɛ adwuma wɔ sɛva yi so
continuous-backup-target: Fael akorae a wɔde bɛkɔ (ɔkwan a edi mu wɔ disk foforo, nkitahodi so akorae anaa rclone akorae a wɔde abɔ ho so)
wekan-data-no-database: Wɔanhu WeKan nsɛm siebea biara a wotumi kenkan.
continuous-backup-engine-oplog: Oplog (nsakrae biara, bere a ɛsi no ara)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: SQLite nkratafa (nkratafa a asesa wɔ bere biara a wɔahyɛ mu)
continuous-backup-engine-litestream: Litestream (dwumadi a wubetumi apaw de ahyɛ mu)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Nsɛm siebea dwumadi biara ntumi nyɛ adwuma wɔ sɛva yi so
continuous-backup-encrypt: Fa kokoam koodu kata mfonini a wɔakora so no so (AES-256-GCM)
continuous-backup-key-file: Kokoam koodu safe fael (ɔkwan a edi mu wɔ fael akorae a wɔde bɛkɔ no akyi; nkyerɛwde 64 a ɛwɔ akontaabu a ne nnyinaso yɛ 16 mu anaa kokoam kasamu a ɛwɔ nkyerɛwde 16 anaa nea ɛboro saa). Kora bi so: sɛ fael yi nni hɔ a, wɔrentumi mfa mfonini a wɔakora so no mma bio.
continuous-backup-upload-none: Mmfa nkɔ baabiara (fael akorae a wɔde bɛkɔ no nkutoo)
continuous-backup-upload-prefix: Fael akorae a ɛwɔ akora ade no mu
continuous-backup-fetched: Wɔafa fael ahorow no afi omununkum no mu
continuous-backup-litestream-binary: Litestream dwumadi fael (ɔkwan a edi mu)
continuous-backup-restore-points: Mmere a wobetumi asan de aba
continuous-backup-restore-to: San fa tebea no bra wɔ (da ne bere)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: SQLite nsɛm siebea fael (wɔyɛ wɔ mfonini a wɔakora so no nkyɛn, wɔntwerɛ ngu fael a wɔde reyɛ adwuma no so da)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Fa SQLite nsɛm siebea a wɔasan ayɛ no si hɔ bere a wɔbɛsan afi nhyehyɛe no ase bio no (wɔbɛkora nsɛm siebea dedaw a wɔasesa no so)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: San fa mfonini kuw a wɔapaw no bra wɔ bere a wɔapaw no mu? Nsɛm ho mfonini akora a ɛkɔ so bere nyinaa no begyina kakra bere a wɔresan de aba no.
continuous-backup-saved: Wɔasie nsɛm ho mfonini akora a ɛkɔ so bere nyinaa nhyehyɛe
backup-restore-mode: Ɔkwan a wɔfa so san de ba
backup-restore-add-missing: Fa nsɛm a enni hɔ nkutoo ka ho
backup-restore-replace-all: Fa si nsɛm no nyinaa ananmu
backup-restore-select-first: Di kan paw nsɛso a wɔasie fi din a wɔahyehyɛ no mu.
backup-restore-confirm: San fa nsɛm ho mfonini a wɔapaw no bra? Wɔde fael a wɔde aka ho ne ahyɛnsode mfonini bɛhyɛ fael nhyehyɛe no mu, na wɔde nsɛm no ahyɛ nsɛm siebea no mu sɛnea ɔkwan a wɔapaw no kyerɛ.
gcs-key-filename-description: Ɛnyɛ ahyɛde: ɔkwan a service account JSON safoa fael no da so wɔ sɛɛva no so.
gcs-credentials-description: Ɛnyɛ ahyɛde: fa service account JSON safoa no bɔ ha. Gyae ha hɔ kwa na fa safoa fael no anaa nsɛm a wɔahyɛ dedaw a wɔde kɔ mu no di dwuma.
gcs-permissions-note: Ma WeKan service account no kwan sɛ ɛkenkan na ɛkyerɛw wɔ akorabea no mu: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → wo akorabea → Permissions → Grant access. Wɔ "New principals" mu no, fa service account email no bɔ hɔ — "client_email" botae a ɛwɔ wo JSON safoa mu no — afei paw "Storage Object Admin" dwumadi na mia Save so.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Gyae ha hɔ kwa na kura botae a ɛwɔ hɔ seesei no mu.
azure-account-name-description: Wo Azure Storage akontaabu no din.
azure-container-description: Blob akorabea a wɔde fael besie mu.
gcs-project-id-description: Wo Google Cloud adwuma no ID.
gcs-bucket-description: Cloud Storage akorabea a wɔde fael besie mu no din.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: gyae ha hɔ kwa (ɛde ɔmantam no nkitahodi awiei beae di dwuma). Akorabea a ɛne S3 yɛ adwuma: fa Endpoint URL a ɛwɔ wo MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces nhyehyɛe beae no.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → wo bucket → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → wo bucket din (anaa Yɛ bucket → Bucket din).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → wo de → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → paw 'Application running outside AWS' sɛ nea wode bɛyɛ → Create access key. Wɔkyerɛ no sɛ 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Ɛwɔ beae koro no ara a Access key ID wɔ; wɔkyerɛ 'Secret access key' pɛnkoro bere a wɔyɛ safoa no — kɔpi no saa bere no (anaa Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → w’akontaabu → din a wɔakyerɛ wɔ soro (ɛwɔ Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name nso).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → w’akontaabu → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → w’akontaabu → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → w’akontaabu → Data storage → Containers → wo container (anaa + Container na yɛ foforo).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → nea wɔde paw adwuma a ɛwɔ soro → w’adwuma no ID (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → wo akorabea din (anaa Create na yɛ foforo).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Ɔkwan a service account JSON safoa fael a wɔatwe aba (a wɔyɛ wɔ ase ha) no da so wɔ WeKan sɛɛva no so. Fa eyi di dwuma ANAA fa JSON no bɔ afã a ɛwɔ ase ha no mu.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → wo service account → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (ɛtwe fael no ba). Fa emu nsɛm bɔ ha, anaa sie fael no na kyerɛ ɔkwan a ɛda so wɔ soro hɔ.
cloud-secret-set: (wɔasie — gyae ha hɔ kwa na kura nea wɔasie no mu)
cloud-connection-failed: Mfomso bi sii wɔ dwumadi yi mu
cloud-settings-desc: Sɛ WeKan wɔ Weddy mu a, Cloud Panel no som WeKan domain pii fi server baako so, na emu biara wɔ ne data. Wɔ Cloud Panel Domain no so, SuperAdmin no hwɛ domain no ne CloudFlare so.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel no yɛ SuperAdmin nko ara dea, wɔ Cloud Panel Domain no so.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Sɛ wowɔ CloudFlare API safe a, domain a ne zone wɔ wo CloudFlare account mu no nya DNS record a ɛfa proxy so ne CloudFlare Origin krataa. Domain afoforo nya Let's Encrypt krataa. Wɔde safe no sie server no so na wɔnkyerɛ bio da.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Wɔnkoraa CloudFlare API safe biara: domain biara nya Let's Encrypt krataa.

sync-recovery-description: Nkabom amanneɛbɔ a wɔakora so wɔ nna 30 a atwam no mu. Fa bɔɔd anaa din a wɔahyehyɛ no ID hwehwɛ. Nea ɛnwiei no betumi akɔ so ayɛ adwuma anaa atwa. San fa nsɛm foforo bra na hwɛ bio; amanneɛbɔ yi ntumi ntoa nsakrae no so anaa nsan nyi no.
sync-recovery-unavailable: Wɔantumi ankenkan nkabom mu nhwehwɛmu no. Hwɛ sohwɛfo kwan ne som afiri no a ɛwɔ hɔ no.
sync-estimate-field: Jira akontaa afã a wɔde abata ho
sync-estimate-field-hint: Paw nɔma afã a ɛwɔ Jira afã ID ne nea wɔde susuw akontaa, sɛnea Jira nsɛm a wɔde abata ho de ba mu no ayɛ no. Wɔhwɛ ha nsakrae sɛ nsɛm a enhyia. Wɔmfa nsɛm fibea botae a enni hɔ no nyɛ adwuma; null a wɔakyerɛ pefee no yi botae a wɔde abata ho no fi hɔ.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab: Nsusuwii beae wɔ bɔɔd yi so
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: Wɔkyerɛw GitLab emu duru anaa bere ho nsusuwii wɔ nɔma beae a wopaw no. Wɔhwɛ nsakrae a ɛwɔ ha no sɛ abira; asɛm a enni emu duru no pepa dodow a wɔde abata ho no.
email-recovery-description: Nkyekyɛmu baako ma obiara a obegye. Fa ɔdefo no ID hwehwɛ. Wɔrenkyerɛ nkra no mu nsɛm ne nea obegye no ɛmɛl afã no. Bere tiaa mu gyinabea siw nkra a ɛwɔ hɔ ne nea ɛbɛba no soma ano; sɛ wɔtoa so a, wɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛsoma nkra a ɛretwɛn no bio seesei. Sɛ wɔgyae a, wɔyi nkra a wɔde guu ntwɛnso no mu kosi abisade no bere. Sɛ wɔresoma a, san sɔ hwɛ wɔ bere tiaa bi akyi. Wontumi nsan mfa nkra a wɔafi ase resoma no mma, na nkra a wonnim sɛ akɔdu no betumi akɔ bio. Mfomso a ɛtra hɔ daa ne nkra a adu mmɔdenbɔ dodow anohyeto no kɔ so wɔ hɔ ma nhwehwɛmu. Sɛ wɔsan sɔ nkra a ankɔ no hwɛ a, ɛhyɛ mmɔdenbɔ foforo ase na ɛkora bere tiaa mu gyinabea a ɛwɔ hɔ no so.
email-recovery-attempts: Mmɔdenbɔ a wɔasan abɔ no dodow a ɛsen biara
email-recovery-oldest: Bere a wɔde guu ntwɛnso mu kan
email-recovery-changed: Ɔdwumayɛfo no nsakrae a etwa to

email-recovery-empty: Nkra biara nni ntwɛnso, na obiara nni hɔ a wɔagyina soma a ɛkɔ ne nkyɛn no bere tiaa bi.
email-recovery-unavailable: Wontumi nkenkan ɛmɛl ntwɛnso no. Hwɛ ɔhwɛfo no kwan ho hokwan ne sɛ afidie a ɛsom no wɔ hɔ a wobetumi de adi dwuma anaa.
email-recovery-busy: Soma anaa ntwɛnso no ho adwuma foforo rekɔ so. Yɛ no foforo na san sɔ hwɛ wɔ bere tiaa bi akyi.
email-recovery-failed: Wɔantumi ansi adwuma no so dua. Yɛ ntwɛnso no foforo na san yɛ saa adwuma no ara sɛ ɛho hia a.
email-recovery-superseded: Ɔdwumayɛfo no adeyɛ foforo asi abisade yi ananmu. Wɔrekyerɛ ntwɛnso no tebea a ɛwɔ hɔ seesei.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Gyae nkra a ɛretwɛn seesei a ɛkɔ saa obi yi nkyɛn nyinaa? Wɔbɛyi emu nsɛm no afi hɔ na wɔrentumi nsan mfa mma. Wɔbɛkora nkra foforo a wɔyɛe wɔ abisade yi akyi no so.
email-recovery-retry: San sɔ nkra a ankɔ no hwɛ

sync-time-estimate-hint: Bere a wɔbu no de nɔma afã a ɛkyerɛ bere a wɔbu toom mfiase/ne nea aka a Jira nsɛm a wɔde ba mu no ayɛ no di dwuma. Ɛsɛ sɛ afã biako pɛ a ɛne no hyia wɔ bɔɔd yi so. Wɔhwɛ ha nsakrae sɛ nsɛm a enhyia; wɔmfa nsɛm fibea botae a enni hɔ no nyɛ adwuma na null a wɔakyerɛ pefee no yi botae no fi hɔ.
sync-planning-hint: Sprint ne adeyi hyia berɛ a Scrum sɔ wɔ bɔɔd yi so nko ara. Sprint anaa adeyi a ɛnni hɔ no, wɔyɛ no wɔ bɔɔd yi so de nna a fibea no de ma; deɛ ɛwɔ hɔ dada no, wɔde ne fibea ID hyia kan, afei ne din. Mpɔtam nhyehyɛeɛ nsesaeɛ tena hɔ kosi sɛ fibea no bɛsesa saa asɛm no nhyehyɛeɛ, na Sync a ɛdi kan nyi nhyehyɛeɛ da.
activity-recovery-description: Afiri no ankasa san sɔ amanneɛbɔ a ɛnwiei no hwɛ. Hwɛ dwumadi a enni hɔ anaa asesa no mu ansa na woasan asɔ ahwɛ. Sɛ wɔsan sɔ hwɛ a, wɔnyɛ dwumadi no foforo da.

activity-recovery-unavailable: Wɔantumi amfa dwumadi ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛretwɛn no amma.

activity-recovery-denied: Nea ɔbɛgye no kwan anaa n'amanneɛbɔ nhyehyɛe no mma wɔmfa nkɔ bio.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Dwumadi a ɛwɔ hɔ mfiase no nni hɔ anaa asesa. Wɔanyɛ biribiara foforo.
activity-recovery-failed: Wɔantumi anwie amanneɛbɔ no nkrato. Wɔakora adwuma a ɛretwɛn no so.
activity-recovery-paused: Wɔagyina dwumadi ho amanneɛbɔ no nkrato kakra.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Amanneɛbɔ yi asesa fi bere a wɔde bae no. Hwɛ tebea foforo no mu ansa na woasan asɔ ahwɛ.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Wɔantumi ansi nkrato nhyehyɛe no so dua. San fa nsɛm foforo bra na hwɛ ne tebea a ɛwɔ hɔ seesei no mu.

rule-email-recovery-description: Hwɛ mmɔden a wɔabɔ de mmara no imeel akɔ a wɔakyerɛw ato hɔ no mu. Mmɔden a wɔnnhyɛɛ mu den no betumi ayɛ sɛ wɔgu so de rekɔ anaa biribi asiw ano. Fa "Hwɛ mu" bue biako na san fa kɔ, hyɛ agyirae sɛ wɔde akɔ, anaa gyae nkɔma no.
rule-email-recovery-invalid: Nsɛm a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ mmɔdenbɔ no mu no nteɛ
rule-email-recovery-empty: Mmɔden biara nni hɔ a wɔbɔ de mmara no imeel kɔ a ɛne saa hwehwɛ yi hyia.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Wɔantumi amfa mmara email nkrato a wɔasɔ ahwɛ no amma. San fa nsɛm foforo bra na sɔ hwɛ bio.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan mfa imeel a wɔnnhyɛɛ ne nnya den nkɔ bio wɔ n'ankasa so da. Sɛ wode kɔ bio a, wɔn a wɔnnhyɛɛ wɔn nnya den nkutoo na ɛkɔ wɔn nkyɛn. Hyɛ no agyirae sɛ wɔde akɔ sɛ wunim sɛ adu a, anaa gyae nkɔma no.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Ebia nkɔma a edi kan no da so rekɔ so. Wubetumi asi gyinae wɔ __time__ akyi.
rule-email-recovery-resend: San fa kɔ wɔn a wɔnnhyɛɛ wɔn nnya den nkyɛn
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: San fa imeel yi kɔ wɔn a wɔnnhyɛɛ wɔn nnya den nkyɛn? Obiara a ne imeel sɛɛva agye no a ɛnka nkyerɛɛ WeKan no benya no mprenu.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Hyɛ imeel yi agyirae sɛ wɔde akɔ obiara nkyɛn? Yɛ eyi bere a wunim sɛ adu nkutoo.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Gyae imeel yi nkɔma? Wɔremfa nkɔ wɔn a wɔnnhyɛɛ wɔn nnya den nkyɛn.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Ebia nkɔma a edi kan no da so rekɔ so. Sɔ hwɛ bio akyiri yi.
rule-email-resolution-already-resolved: Wɔasi imeel yi ho gyinae dedaw.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Ebia nkɔma a wɔasan ayɛ dedaw no da so rekɔ so. Sɔ hwɛ bio akyiri yi.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Wɔahyɛ obiara nnya den dedaw. Hyɛ no agyirae sɛ wɔde akɔ mmom.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Imeel sɛɛva no amma mmuae. Ebia imeel a wɔasan de akɔ no adu anaa ennu; wɔkyerɛ sɛ ɛda so rekɔ so.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Ɔhwɛfo foforo resi imeel yi ho gyinae. Sɔ hwɛ bio bere tiaa bi akyi.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Imeel a wɔasie no ne sɔhwɛ yi nhyia bio, enti wontumi nsi ho gyinae wɔ ha.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Nsɛm a wɔasie afa sɔhwɛ yi ho nni mu, enti wontumi nsi ho gyinae wɔ ha.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Wɔantumi ansi imeel yi ho gyinae. Bue kratafa no bio na sɔ hwɛ bio.
rule-email-legacy-heading: Mmara no imeel ahorow a ɛretwɛn nhwehwɛmu
rule-email-legacy-description: WeKan nkyerɛase dedaw bi na ɛsiesiee mmara no imeel ahorow yi, na ɛankyerɛw baabi a emu nsɛm fi, enti WeKan remfa nkɔ wɔ n'ankasa so. Di kan hwɛ sɛ nea ɔhyehyɛɛ mmara no da so wɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔbɛkɔ mu, na san fa imeel no bata ho na wɔasiesie no bio afi kaad no tebea a ɛwɔ hɔ seesei mu, anaa tow kyene.
rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Kaad no ho nsɛm a efi nkyerɛase dedaw mu
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: San siesie imeel yi fi kaad no tebea a ɛwɔ hɔ seesei mu? Ebia emu nsɛm bɛyɛ soronko wɔ nea wɔsiesiee dedaw no ho.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Tow imeel yi kyene? Wɔremfa nkɔ da.
rule-email-legacy-empty: Mmara no imeel biara nni hɔ a ɛretwɛn nhwehwɛmu.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Wɔantumi amfa mmara no imeel ahorow a ɛretwɛn nhwehwɛmu no amma. Bue kratafa no bio na sɔ hwɛ bio.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Nea ɔhyehyɛɛ mmara no nni ho kwan bio sɛ ɔbɛkɔ kaad yi mu, anaa mmara no asesa, enti wontumi nsan mfa imeel no mmata ho. Wubetumi atow akyene.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Adeyɛ a ɛmaa wɔsiesiee imeel yi asesa, enti wontumi nsan mfa mmata ho. Wubetumi atow akyene.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Kaad a imeel yi fi mu no nni hɔ bio, enti wontumi nsan mfa mmata ho. Wubetumi atow akyene.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Mmara no dwumadi a ɛsiesiee imeel yi no nni nea wɔasie mu bio, enti wontumi nsan mfa mmata ho. Wubetumi atow akyene.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Wɔde imeel yi akɔ dedaw, wɔasɔ ahwɛ sɛ wɔde bɛkɔ, anaa wɔatow akyene.
rule-email-legacy-not-legacy: Wɔasan de imeel yi abata ho dedaw.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Wɔantumi anwie adeyɛ yi. Bue kratafa no bio na sɔ hwɛ bio.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: List Sync dwumadie a wontumi nsan nyɛ
stuck-sync-operation-description: List Sync dwumadie a wɔasie yi mu biara gyinaa ntam na wontumi nwie bio, ɛfiri sɛ wɔayi ne nhwɛso no, wɔasan ayɛ no anaa wɔasan ahyehyɛ no, anaa dwumadini a ɔhyɛɛ ase no nni kyerɛw kwan bio. Berɛ a baako retwɛn no, saa nhwɛso no ntumi nhyia. Tow no gu na nhwɛso no ntumi nhyia bio: nsesaeɛ a wɔayɛ dada no tena hɔ, nsesaeɛ a aka a wɔasie no wɔnkyerɛw da, na Sync a ɛdi so no de nhwɛso no toto ne fibea ho bio.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Wɔayi nhwɛso no, wɔasan ayɛ no anaa wɔasesa ne Sync nhyehyɛeɛ
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Dwumadini a ɔhyɛɛ ase no nni kyerɛw kwan wɔ nhwɛso no nyinaa so bio
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: WeKan tete bi na ɛsiee no a deɛ ɛhyɛɛ ase nka ho
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: Nsɛm a ɛkyerɛ nea ɔhyɛɛ ase no ayera
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: Wotumi san yɛ no seesei na ɛbɛwie ne ho, enti wontumi ntow nngu.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Tow List Sync dwumadie a wɔasie yi gu? Nsesaeɛ a ɛyɛɛ dada no tena hɔ; nkaeɛ no wɔnkyerɛw da. Afei nhwɛso no tumi hyia bio.

optional-apis: API a ɛnhia sɛ wode di dwuma
optional-apis-desc: REST API a ɛte sɛ nhwehwɛmu nnwinnade foforo API, sɛnea wɔn apps ne scripts betumi de WeKan yi ayɛ wɔn backend: nea wɔkora no, wɔkora wɔ WeKan mu, wɔ WeKan Bɔɔd so. Ɛmu biara dum kosi sɛ wobɛtow agyiraehyɛde wɔ ha. Ɛmu biara nni ne tumi ankasa: client de WeKan API token kɔ mu, na otumi hu na ɔsesa nea onipa no tumi hu na ɔsesa wɔ WeKan mu nkutoo. Ne nyinaa hia sɛ WeKan REST API no bue (WITH_API=true). Address a ɛwɔ biara ase no ne nea client de di dwuma sɛ ne server.
optional-api-trello-desc: Apps ne scripts a wɔakyerɛw ama Trello REST API (sɛ Trellinator) ne WeKan yɛ adwuma: Bɔɔd ahodoɔ, nhyehyɛe, kaad, Nsɛnkyerɛnne, Amanfoɔ, Nsusuiɛ ne Nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso. Trello token no yɛ WeKan API token. Sɛ wopopa kaad a, wɔsie no wɔ WeKan mu.
optional-api-jira-desc: Jira REST API v2 clients ne WeKan yɛ adwuma: project yɛ Bɔɔd (ne key yɛ Bɔɔd key), issue yɛ kaad (DEV-7), status yɛ nhyehyɛe, na transition de kaad no kɔ baabi foforo. Nhwehwɛmu gye JQL a ɛnyɛ den: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text ne ORDER BY. De WeKan API token kɔ mu sɛ password. Sɛ wopopa issue a, wɔsie no.
optional-api-github-desc: GitHub REST API ma Nsɛm clients ne WeKan yɛ adwuma: repository yɛ Bɔɔd, issue yɛ kaad, a Nsɛnkyerɛnne, Anammɔn (Nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛwɔ da a ɛsɛ sɛ wowie), Nsusuiɛ, ne Abue anaa Wɔato mu te sɛ Bɔɔd hwɛbea / Nsakrae So Hwɛ mu no ka ho. Token no yɛ WeKan API token.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Gitea ne Forgejo REST API ma Nsɛm clients ne WeKan yɛ adwuma, sɛnea API a ɛne GitHub hyia no te: repository yɛ Bɔɔd na issue yɛ kaad. Token no yɛ WeKan API token.
bots-none: Bɔt biara nni hɔ da. Bɔt yɛ adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ wo ankasa wo server so - AI ananmusifoɔ, CI adwuma, script - a bɔɔd yi de kaad ma no.

webhook-internal-hosts: Nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ mu a wɔma kwan
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Webhook a ɛkɔ abɔnten ntumi nkɔ address a ɛwɔ WeKan ankasa network so, sɛnea obiara ntumi nkyerɛ bɔɔd bi webhook nkɔ som a ɛwɔ mu. Kyerɛw host a ɛwɔ saa network no so a webhook betumi akɔ ho wɔ ha - Node-RED, nkɔmmɔbɔ server - baako wɔ line biara so, sɛ din anaa address, na fa port ka ho sɛ wopɛ sɛ wo ma saa port no nko ara kwan. Hwee nni mu: biribiara nni hɔ. Site no adwumayɛfo panyin nko ara na wotumi sesa saa nhyehyɛe yi.

account-webhook-desc: Address baako a WeKan ka kyerɛ bere a obi kɔ mu anaa wɔbue akawnt foforɔ. Wɔmmmɔ hwee nkɔ kosi sɛ wobɛhyɛ asɛm bi a ɛwɔ ase hɔ agyirae. Ɛkura asɛm a esii no, Dwumadini din ne bere no; hyɛ mmeae foforɔ agyirae sɛ ɔgyefo no hia a nko ara.

Mia din bi so na sesa din no, fa agyan ketewa no mia kwan bi so anaa bue no, twe ne nsa kura so sesa akwan no nhyehyɛeɛ, na twe n'ase hyeɛ sesa ne tenten, gye sɛ bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ ato sesa a wɔsesa kɛseɛ no mu.
help-board-view-lists-what-it-is-descrip: Nhwɛso yɛ afadum a kaad no wɔ mu. Wɔ kanban bɔɔd so no, nhwɛso biara yɛ adwuma no anammɔn baako, na kaad tu fi nhwɛso baako kɔ foforɔ sɛnea adwuma no kɔ so. Wɔ Akwan hwɛbea mu no, nhwɛso betumi ayɛ kwan baako dea.
help-board-view-lists-how-it-works-descr: Mia nhwɛso foforɔ ahyɛnsode a ɛwɔ nhwɛso ti nifa so, anaa Fa ka ho wɔ nhwɛso mɛnu mu, kyerɛw din na paw nhwɛso a ɛbɛdi n'akyi; sɛ wode nkyerɛwee pii hyɛ mu a, ebetumi ayɛ nhwɛso biako ama nkyerɛwee biara. Mia nhwɛso asɛmti so na sesa ne din, na agyan ketewa a ɛwɔ ne ti so no mia so anaa ɛbue no ma wo nko ara. Nhwɛso mɛnu no nso wɔ yɛ bio, tu ne fa kɔ adekorabea, na wobɛtumi atwe nsa kura a ɛda nhwɛso ntam no sesa wɔn trɛ bere a wɔama ho kwan.
help-board-view-table-what-it-is-descrip: Pon hwɛbea no kyerɛ bɔɔd no kaad sɛ pon te sɛ spreadsheet, kaad biara wɔ ne nkyerɛwee, ne nhwɛso, ne kwan, ne nnipa, ne nsɛnkyerɛnne ne ne nna. Ɛboa ma wohwɛ kaad pii prɛko na wode kaad ka ho anaa wotu wɔn a wontwe wɔn mfa nhwɛso so.
help-board-view-table-how-it-works-descr: Mia afadum ti so na hyehyɛ, na mia so bio na dane nhyehyɛeɛ no. Kyerɛw wɔ hwehwɛ adaka no mu na hwehwɛ kaad asɛmti, nhwɛso, akwan ne nsɛnkyerɛnne, na fa Nea atwam ne Nea edi hɔ kɔ nkyerɛwee 25 so prɛko. Sesa bɔtn no bue kaad wɔ pon no so. Kyekyere asɛmti ne Boaboa ano wɔ akwan so sesa sɛnea ɛte, na brawsa yi kae. Wɔnnkyerɛ kaad a ɛwɔ adekorabea, na Yiyi mu a ɛwɔ nkyɛn no tew nkyerɛwee no so.
help-board-view-cal-what-it-is-descripti: Kalenda hwɛbea no de bɔɔd no kaad gu kalenda so sɛnea wɔn nna te: kaad a ɛwɔ mfitiaseɛ ne awieeɛ nna yɛ dua a ɛda wɔn ntam, na da a wɔnyaa no, da a ɛtwa toɔ ne awieeɛ da nso yɛ wɔn ankasa nsɛm. Nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso nneɛma a ɛwɔ nna nso pue.
help-board-view-cal-how-it-works-descrip: Fa Ɛnnɛ, Nea atwam ne Nea edi hɔ kyinkyin, na sesa fi da, nnawɔtwe ne bosome mu, biara sɛ grid anaa nhwɛso. Twe kaad bi ma no da a ɛtwa toɔ foforɔ, anaa trɛ no mu sesa n'awieeɛ da. Mia da bi so, anaa twe fa nnɔnhwerew so wɔ nnawɔtwe anaa da grid mu, na yɛ kaad foforɔ a ne da a ɛtwa toɔ ne saa bere no; ɛkɔ bɔɔd no kwan a edi kan ne nhwɛso a edi kan mu.
help-board-view-calendar-mode-what-it-is: Kalenda Kwan kyerɛ kaad biara wɔ ne da a ɛtwa toɔ so, ne nsɛnkyerɛnne ne n'asɛmti nyinaa, wɔ bosome anaa nnawɔtwe grid mu. Ɛyɛ nhwɛsoɔ a wotumi kenkan nko ara a ɛkyerɛ nea ɛsɛ sɛ wowie ne bere, te sɛ Trello kalenda.
help-board-view-calendar-mode-how-it-wor: Fa Ɛnnɛ, Nea atwam ne Nea edi hɔ tu bosome anaa nnawɔtwe baako, na Nnawɔtwe anaa Bosome sesa grid no; brawsa yi kae wo nea wopaw. Mia kaad bi so na bue no. Wɔnnkyerɛ kaad a ɛwɔ adekorabea na Yiyi mu a ɛwɔ nkyɛn no yɛ adwuma. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wotwe sesa nna a, fa Kalenda hwɛbea no di dwuma.
help-board-view-multiboard-cal-what-it-i: Bɔɔd Pii Kalenda kyerɛ kaad a ɛwɔ nna wɔ bɔɔd biara a woka ho no so wɔ kalenda baako mu, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛhunu nea ɛsɛ sɛ wowie nnawɔtwe yi nyinaa, bɔɔd biara so a ɛwɔ. Nsɛm biara de ne bɔɔd asɛmti a ɛwɔ bracket mu na ɛhyɛ aseɛ.
help-board-view-multiboard-cal-how-it-wo: Bue no fi bɔɔd biara Bɔɔd hwɛbea mɛnu mu na twɛn kosi sɛ wo bɔɔd nyinaa kaad bɛba. Fa Ɛnnɛ, Nea atwam ne Nea edi hɔ ne da, nnawɔtwe ne bosome hwɛbea di dwuma, biara nso sɛ nhwɛso. Da a wɔnyaa no, da a ɛtwa toɔ ne awieeɛ da nya wɔn ankasa nsɛm. Mia nsɛm bi so na bue saa kaad no wɔ ne bɔɔd so. Wontumi ntwe nna wɔ ha.
help-board-view-time-what-it-is-descript: Bere hwɛbea no boaboa bɔɔd no bere a wɔde di dwuma ano wɔ baabi baako: bere dodoɔ a wɔde adi dwuma, obi a ɔyɛeɛ ne kaad a ɔyɛ so, ne bere a aka ansa na kaad no da a ɛtwa toɔ adu. Wɔkyerɛw bere no wɔ kaad no ankasa so; hwɛbea yi ka ho asɛm nko ara.
help-board-view-time-how-it-works-descri: Kenkan bere a wɔde adi dwuma no mua wɔ soro, afei ne mu nkyekyɛmu wɔ nea wɔde adwuma ama no ne kaad biara so, na wɔahyɛ kaad a atwa bere agyirae. Ɛno ase no wɔakyerɛw nsakraeɛ biara a ɛbaa kaad nnɔnhwerew a wɔakyerɛw so, ne onipa a ɔyɛeɛ. Mia Yi adi na sie amanneɛbɔ no sɛ PDF anaa Excel. Amanfoɔ a wotumi hwɛ kaad a wɔde ama wɔn nko ara nya wɔn ankasa kaad mua, na nkyekyɛmu a aka no da hɔ hunu.
help-board-view-timeline-what-it-is-desc: Bere Ntoatoasoɔ hwɛbea no kyerɛ bɔɔd no sɛnea na ɛte wɔ bere bi a atwam, na ɛde bɔɔd no abakɔsɛm di dwuma. Ɛboa wo ma wohunu nea asesa na wode kaad bi san kɔ sɛnea na ɛte.
help-board-view-timeline-how-it-works-de: Mia baabi wɔ ntoatoasoɔ no so na hwɛ kaad biara sɛnea na ɛte saa bere no, a wɔaboaboa ano wɔ ne nhwɛso a na ɛwɔ mu saa bere no, ne n'asɛmti, ne nkyerɛkyerɛmu, ne nsɛnkyerɛnne, n'amanfoɔ ne ne da a ɛtwa toɔ. Mia Seesei na san bra mprempren. Wɔ kaad so no, San fa ba tebea yi so de saa nsɛm no san ba bere a woagye atom. Wɔmpepa hwee: wɔkyerɛw san fa ba no sɛ abakɔsɛm foforɔ, na wɔkyerɛ bɔtn no nnipa a wɔtumi sesa saa kaad no nko ara.
help-board-view-stats-what-it-is-descrip: Akontaabu kyerɛ bɔɔd no tebea wɔ nhwɛ baako mu: sɛnea wɔde ne kaad ba ne akwan, nhwɛso, kaad, kaad a ɛwɔ adekorabea, nsɛnkyerɛnne, amanfoɔ ne wo ankasa mmeae dodoɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ.
help-board-view-stats-how-it-works-descr: Bue Akontaabu fi Nhwɛsoɔ kuo a ɛwɔ Bɔɔd hwɛbea mɛnu mu na kenkan Bɔɔd tebea pon no. Kaad a wɔde ba ka sɛ bɔɔd yi de kaad a wohunu nko ara anaa kaad nyinaa ba, ne sɛ wɔpaw no ankasa ama bɔɔd kɛseɛ. Wɔbu akontaa no wɔ server so, enti ɛyɛ pɛ mpo wɔ bɔɔd kɛseɛ so. Wobɛtumi apaw nsɛm biara na woayɛ bio, na hwɛbea no a wobue no nsesa hwee.
help-board-view-group-by-assignee-what-i: Boaboa ano wɔ obi a wɔde adwuma ama no so de kaad biara si onipa a wɔde ama no ase, sen ne nhwɛso, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛhunu obi a ɔwɔ nea ɛwɔ hɔ a wommue nhwɛso biara. Ɛfata kuo nhyiamu.
help-board-view-group-by-assignee-how-it: Bue no fi Bɔɔd hwɛbea mɛnu mu. Obiara a wɔde adwuma ama no nya ɔfa a ne kaad wɔ mu, da a ɛtwa toɔ baabi a wɔde ahyɛ, ne dɔnhwerew bere a kaad bi atwa bere; kaad a obiara nni so wɔ Obiara nni ho ase. Mia kaad asɛmti so na bue kaad no. Boaboa ano no de kaad no Nea wɔde adwuma ama no mmeae di dwuma, ɛnyɛ n'Amanfoɔ. Nnipa a wɔn dwumadie ma wɔhwɛ kaad a wɔde ama wɔn nko ara nnya nsɛm biara wɔ ha.
help-board-view-gantt-what-it-is-descrip: Gantt hwɛbea no twa bɔɔd no kaad wɔ kalenda so sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛhunu nea ɛhyɛ aseɛ, nea ɛsɛ sɛ wowie ne nea ɛka bom. Gantt yɛ pon a kaad biara wɔ ne nkyerɛwee ne ahyɛnsode ma ne da biara, na Frappe Gantt ne DHTMLX Gantt twa kaad biara sɛ dua fi mfitiaseɛ kosi awieeɛ.
help-board-view-gantt-how-it-works-descr: Paw Gantt, Frappe Gantt anaa DHTMLX Gantt wɔ Kalenda ne bere kuo a ɛwɔ Bɔɔd hwɛbea mɛnu mu; ɛsɛ sɛ kaad wɔ da biako a wɔnyaa no, mfitiaseɛ da, da a ɛtwa toɔ anaa awieeɛ da. Wɔ Gantt mu no, nnawɔtwe biara a nna wɔ mu nya ne pon; mia kaad din so na bue kaad no anaa da ahyɛnsode so na sesa saa da no. Wɔ Frappe Gantt ne DHTMLX Gantt mu no, amanfoɔ a wɔtumi kyerɛw betumi atwe dua bi asesa kaad no bere.
help-board-view-product-backlog-what-it-: Adeyɛ Adwuma a Aka yɛ adwuma nhwɛso a wɔahyehyɛ a Scrum kuo nnya mfaa nkɔɔ sprint mu. Ɛkyerɛ bɔɔd no kaad a sprint biara nni so seesei, a wɔahyehyɛ wɔ backlog gyinabea so, a wonnyi wɔn mfi wɔn nhwɛso mu.
help-board-view-product-backlog-how-it-w: Hwehwɛ kaad wɔ pon no mu na wɔ ne Nneyɛeɛ mu no, hyɛ ne Sprint, Backlog gyinabea, Release, Adwuma su ne Gyedie nhwɛsoɔ, na afei mia Sie. Gyinabea nketewa di kan. Mia Ctrl so, anaa Cmd wɔ Mac so, na fa kaad bi hyɛ release pii mu. Mia kaad asɛmti so na bue kaad no, na Kyerɛ pii na fa kaad 100 a edi hɔ bra. Sesa di kaad ho kwan a ɛtaa yɛ akyi.
help-board-view-sprints-what-it-is-descr: Sprint yɛ bere tiawa a ɛyɛ pɛ a Scrum kuo wie adwuma a wɔapaw ama botaeɛ bi. Sprints hwɛbea no ne baabi a wɔhyehyɛ bɔɔd no sprints, wɔhyɛ aseɛ, wɔto mu anaa wɔgyae, ne ne releases ne Scrum nhyiamu.
help-board-view-sprints-how-it-works-des: Bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ di kan bue Scrum nhyehyɛeɛ, ɔsɔ Scrum nhyehyɛeɛ so na ɔpaw nsusuiɛ fibea, susukoro, wiei mmara ne adwuma nna. Afei yɛ sprint a wɔahyehyɛ a ɛwɔ din, botaeɛ, mfitiaseɛ ne awieeɛ, de kaad fi Adwuma a Aka mu ma no, na mia Hyɛ sprint aseɛ. Sɛ wobɛwie a, paw baabi a adwuma a wonwiee no bɛkɔ na mia To sprint mu, anaa ka deɛ enti na mia Gyae sprint. Bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ nko ara na wɔhwɛ sprints so.
help-board-view-sprint-report-what-it-is: Sprint amanneɛbɔ ka nea ɛkɔɔ so wɔ sprint baako a wɔato mu mu: nea wɔhyɛɛ bɔ, nea wɔwiee, nea wɔde kaa ho, nea wɔyii ne nea wɔannwie. Ahoɔhare kyerɛ saa nsunsuanso no ma sprint biara a wɔato mu, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛtumi ahyehyɛ sprint a edi hɔ afi nea kuo no yɛɛ ampa so.
help-board-view-sprint-report-how-it-wor: Wɔ Sprint amanneɛbɔ mu no, paw sprint na paw Kaad anaa Nsusuiɛ wɔ nnua no soro, afei kenkan da biara adwuma dodoɔ ne adwuma a aka ne nsakraeɛ biara abakɔsɛm wɔ ase. Wɔ Ahoɔhare mu no, kenkan nkyerɛwee baako ma sprint biara a wɔato mu. Nsunsuanso no fi mfonini a wɔtwaa bere a sprint biara hyɛɛ aseɛ ne bere a wɔto mu, enti nsusuiɛ nsakraeɛ a ɛba akyiri nsesa wɔn. Yi adi sie nsunsuanso no sɛ PDF anaa Excel, na Yɛ no foforɔ san de amanneɛbɔ no ba.
help-board-view-burndown-what-it-is-desc: Scrum mfonini yi kyerɛ sɛnea adwuma kɔ anim bere mu. Burndown kyerɛ adwuma a aka da biara na Burnup nea wɔawie, Ahoɔhare kyerɛ nea sprint biara a wɔato mu wiee, Release Burndown di adwuma a aka wɔ release mu akyi, na Epic nkɔanim kyerɛ baabi a kaad maame adu.
help-board-view-burndown-how-it-works-de: Paw mfonini no wɔ Scrum ase wɔ Bɔɔd hwɛbea mɛnu mu. Biara twa fi bɔɔd no ankasa kaad ne sprints mu na ɛkyerɛ nɔma no wɔ pon a ɛwɔ mfonini no ase. Ahoɔhare hia sprint biako a wɔato mu, na ɛma wopaw Kaad anaa Nsusuiɛ. Mia Yi adi wɔ soro na sie saa nɔma no ara sɛ PDF anaa Excel. Mfonini a hwee nni hɔ a ɛbɛtwa ka sɛ Nsunsuanso biara nni hɔ.
help-board-view-roadmap-what-it-is-descr: Kwan Mfonini no boaboa kaad ano wɔ nkyerɛwee mu sɛnea wo ankasa mmeae bi so nsɛm te, te sɛ release anaa epic, na ɛtwa nkyerɛwee biara kaad wɔ bere ntoatoasoɔ so. Ɛho wɔ mfasoɔ ma release anaa asɛmti kwan mfonini bere a wɔakora saa boaboa ano no dada wɔ wo ankasa mmeae mu.
help-board-view-roadmap-how-it-works-des: Ɛsɛ sɛ bɔɔd no wɔ wo ankasa mmeae biako a ɛyɛ nsɛm anaa dropdown. Paw mmeae no wɔ Boaboa ano wɔ so wɔ soro; nsɛm biara nya ne Gantt mfonini ketewa a ne kaad wɔ mu, na kaad a nsɛm biara nni so no wɔboaboa ano wɔ Nsɛm biara nni hɔ ase. Wɔde kaad gu hɔ sɛnea wɔn nna te, enti ma wɔn mfitiaseɛ ne da a ɛtwa toɔ na woahunu wɔn wɔ bere ntoatoasoɔ no so.
help-board-view-dashboard-what-it-is-des: Nhwɛsoɔ mfonini yi bua sɛnea bɔɔd no so adwuma dɔɔso ne sɛnea ne adwuma atrɛtrɛ: Dashboard ne Pulse ka bɔɔd no mua, Adwuma dodoɔ kyerɛ obi a ɔwɔ deɛ, Nkyekyɛmu sɛnea wɔakyekyɛ kaad, Nnyinasoɔ mfonini sɛnea kaad si wɔn ho kwan anaa wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn ho so, na Dwumadie ahohyehyeɛ mfonini bere a nnipa yɛ adwuma wɔ bɔɔd no so.
help-board-view-dashboard-how-it-works-d: Paw mfonini bi wɔ Nhwɛsoɔ kuo a ɛwɔ Bɔɔd hwɛbea mɛnu mu. Krataafa biara twa mfonini no fi bɔɔd no kaad ne n'abakɔsɛm mu na ɛkyerɛ nɔma pon a ɛwɔ n'akyi. Mia Yi adi wɔ soro na sie saa nsɛm no ara sɛ PDF anaa Excel. Sɛ hwee nni hɔ a ɛbɛtwa a, mfonini no ka sɛ Nsunsuanso biara nni hɔ.
help-board-view-bigboard-what-it-is-desc: Bɔɔd Kɛseɛ de bɔɔd biara a woka ho no si ho wɔ krataafa baako a wotumi kyinkyin so, biara ne ne nhwɛso ne ne kaad, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛtumi ayɛ adwuma wɔ wo bɔɔd nyinaa so prɛko.
help-board-view-bigboard-how-it-works-de: Bue Bɔɔd Kɛseɛ fi Bɔɔd hwɛbea mɛnu mu na twɛn bere a bɔɔd biara kaad reba. Bɔɔd ɔfa biara yɛ adwuma te sɛ bɔɔd a ɛtaa yɛ: twe kaad fa nhwɛso ntam, bue kaad na sesa nhwɛso. Wobɛtumi nso atwe kaad akɔ bɔɔd foforɔ nhwɛso mu wɔ krataafa no so, na ɛde no kɔ saa bɔɔd no so. Wobɛtumi atwe nhwɛso wɔ wɔn ankasa bɔɔd mu nko ara. Mia bɔɔd asɛmti so na bue no ankasa.
help-board-view-flow-what-it-is-descript: Kanban nsenee mfonini kyerɛ sɛnea adwuma kɔ bɔɔd no mu: nsenee a ɛboaboa ano, nhwɛsoɔ ne kyinhyia bere, bere a ɛfa, nsenee mfasoɔ, adwuma a ɛfi mu, WIP, adwuma a anyini, nneɛma a esiw kwan, nkɔmhyɛ a ɛkyerɛ bere a adwuma bɛwie, adeyɛ su ne sɛ nsusuiɛ akɛseɛ gye bere tenten anaa. Ɛboa wo ma wohunu baabi a adwuma bu so ne bere dodoɔ a ɛgye ampa.
help-board-view-flow-how-it-works-descri: Paw mfonini bi wɔ Kanban nsenee kuo a ɛwɔ Bɔɔd hwɛbea mɛnu mu. Kenkan nkyerɛwee a ɛwɔ asɛmti no ase, a ɛka sɛnea ɛsusu, afei mfonini no ne pon a ɛwɔ n'ase. Krataafa bi gye nhyehyɛeɛ, te sɛ kaad a wɔrehwehwɛ ne da ma Monte Carlo nkɔmhyɛ anaa kɛseɛ mmeae ma Adwuma kɛseɛ ne Kyinhyia bere, a wɔde Fa di dwuma na ɛyɛ. Yi adi wɔ soro sie pon no sɛ PDF anaa Excel.
help-board-view-reports-what-it-is-descr: Amanneɛbɔ yi kyerɛ sɛnea adwuma kɔ bɔɔd no mu nnawɔtwe biara: kaad a wɔyɛɛ ne nea wɔwiee, nsenee a ɛkɔ anim, bere dodoɔ a kaad tena nhwɛso biara mu, kaad a abue mfeɛ mfinimfini, nnawɔtwe biara adwuma a ɛfi mu ne mpɛn dodoɔ a wodu da a ɛtwa toɔ so.
help-board-view-reports-how-it-works-des: Paw amanneɛbɔ bi wɔ Kanban nsenee kuo a ɛwɔ Bɔɔd hwɛbea mɛnu mu: Nea wɔyɛɛ ne Nea wɔwiee, Nsenee a ɛkɔ anim, Bere wɔ nhwɛso mu, Mfeɛ mfinimfini, Adwuma a ɛfi mu mfonini anaa Da a ɛtwa toɔ dwumadie. Biara kyerɛ mfonini na, n'ase no, nɔma pon a wɔde twaa no. Mia Yi adi wɔ soro na sie saa pon no sɛ PDF anaa Excel.
help-board-view-map-what-it-is-descripti: Asase Mfonini hwɛbea no kyerɛ bɔɔd no kaad sɛ agyiraeɛ wɔ mfonini a bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ de aba so, te sɛ dan mu nhyehyɛeɛ anaa beaeɛ mfonini. Ɛfata adwuma a ɛkɔ so wɔ mmeaeɛ, te sɛ adan, mfidie anaa asase fa.
help-board-view-map-how-it-works-descrip: Bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ mia Fa asase mfonini bra na ɔpaw PNG, JPEG, GIF anaa WebP fael, na ɔbɛtumi ayi no akyiri a kaad no mmeaeɛ nyera. Nnipa a wɔtumi sesa bɔɔd no hunu kaad a ennya nni mfonini no so; twe baako fa mfonini no so, anaa paw no na mia baabi a ɛsɛ sɛ ɛwɔ, na twe agyiraeɛ bi tu no. Agyiraeɛ no fa kaad no nsɛnkyerɛnne a edi kan kɔla, na sɛ womia so a ɛbue kaad no.
help-board-view-email-what-it-is-descrip: Ɛmɛl hwɛbea no kyerɛ bɔɔd no sɛ ɛmɛl adaka: kaad yɛ nkra, nhwɛso yɛ fɔlda na nsɛnkyerɛnne yɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne. Wobɛtumi akyerɛw ɛmɛl na woabua afi bɔɔd no ankasa address so, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a mmuaeɛ bɛsan aba bɔɔd no so sɛ kaad ne nsusuiɛ.
help-board-view-email-how-it-works-descr: Mia Nea aba, Nea wɔde akɔ, Ɛmɛl nyinaa, nhwɛso anaa nsɛnkyerɛnne bi so paw nea wɔbɛkyerɛ, kyerɛw wɔ hwehwɛ adaka no mu tew nkyerɛwee no so, na mia nkyerɛwee bi so bue kaad no, a ne nsusuiɛ ne nkɔmmɔ no. help-board-view-chat-what-it-is-descript: Nkɔmmɔ hwɛbea no kyerɛ bɔɔd no sɛ nkɔmmɔ adwumabea: kaad biara a nkɔmmɔ wɔ so yɛ kwan na ne nsusuiɛ yɛ nkra. Akwan dua no kata bɔɔd biara a wohunu so, ne nkra dodoɔ a wonkenkanee.
help-board-view-chat-how-it-works-descri: Bue adwumabea ne bɔɔd wɔ Akwan mu na mia kaad bi so; ɛbue wɔ mfimfini fa no mu na ne nkra wɔ nkɔmmɔ fa no mu. help-board-view-version-control-what-it-: Nsakraeɛ Nhwɛsoɔ hwɛbea no kyerɛ bɔɔd no sɛ code akorabea ɔhaw akyidi: kaad yɛ ɔhaw, nsɛnkyerɛnne yɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne, nsɛnkyerɛnne a da a ɛtwa toɔ wɔ so yɛ ahyɛnsode akɛseɛ, nsusuiɛ yɛ nkɔmmɔ na nneɛma a wɔde aka ho yɛ fael. Ɛsan de ɔhaw fi GitHub, GitLab, Gitea ne Forgejo ba na ɛma ɛne wɔn hyia.
help-board-view-version-control-how-it-w: Hwehwɛ ɔhaw a abue ne nea wɔato mu, yiyi mu wɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne anaa ahyɛnsode kɛseɛ so, na bue ɔhaw bi kenkan na fa ka ne nkɔmmɔ ho.
