Ɔhaw foforɔ bɛyɛ kaad wɔ bɔɔd no nhwɛso a abue mu, na To mu anaa San bue tu kaad no fa nhwɛso a abue ne nea wɔato mu ntam. Biribiara yɛ kaad nsɛm a ɛtaa yɛ, enti wɔkora nsakraeɛ wɔ bɔɔd no abakɔsɛm mu.
help-board-view-column-sets-what-it-is-d: Afadum ahodoɔ ma wohyehyɛ kaad koro no ara wɔ akwan foforɔ so, te sɛ nea ɛho hia, ahyɛnsode kɛseɛ anaa kɛseɛ, a wonnyi kaad biara mfi ne nhwɛso mu. Kuo biara wɔ n'afadum a ɛwɔ kɔla.
help-board-view-column-sets-how-it-works: Bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ kyerɛw din wɔ Afadum kuo foforɔ mu na ɔmia Fa ka ho, afei ɔde afadum a ɛwɔ din ne kɔla ka ho. Paw kuo bi wɔ soro; kaad biara wɔ n'afadum baako mu anaa wɔ Wɔmfaa nsii hɔ mu. Twe kaad kɔ afadum foforɔ mu sesa ne gyinabea wɔ kuo yi mu nko ara; ne nhwɛso, ne kwan, ne nsɛnkyerɛnne ne n'amanfoɔ nsesa. Kaad biara nso kyerɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne nketewa ma n'afadum wɔ kuo afoforɔ no mu.
help-board-view-website-what-it-is-descr: Wɛbsaet hwɛbea no kyerɛ bɔɔd no sɛ wɛbsaet a wɔde ne kaad ne nneɛma a wɔde aka ho asi, sɛ nhwɛsoɔ, wɛbsaet a wɔde fi WordPress, Ghost, Blogger anaa wɛbsaet a ɛnsesa mu ba. Bɔɔd a ɛyɛ baguam betumi abue wɔ hwɛbea yi mu, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ahɔhoɔ bɛhunu wɛbsaet no wɔ bɔɔd no address so.
help-board-view-website-how-it-works-des: Kaad a ɛwɔ nhwɛso a ne din de Published mu na ɛwɔ wɛbsaet no so, anaa nhwɛso biara kaad bere a saa nhwɛso no nni hɔ; kaad a ɛwɔ adekorabea mpue da. Kaad a ɛwɔ kwan a ne din de Pages mu na ɛyɛ mɛnu no, na adwuma nketewa yɛ krataafa nketewa, na kaad afoforɔ no yɛ nsɛm wɔ krataafa a edi kan so, nea ɛyɛ foforɔ di kan. Kaad nkyerɛkyerɛmu yɛ krataafa nsɛm na nneɛma a wɔde aka ho yɛ ne mfonini ne fael. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wode di dwuma sɛ baguam bɔɔd hwɛbea a, paw no wɔ Bɔɔd nhyehyɛeɛ / Bɔɔd hwɛbea mu.
help-board-view-shop-what-it-is-descript: Sotɔɔ hwɛbea no kyerɛ nneɛma a ɛwɔ bɔɔd no kaad so sɛ wɛb sotɔɔ, ne mfonini, nneɛma bo, nkyekyɛmu, adeɛ krataafa, kɛntɛn ne tua ka beaeɛ. Kaad a ɛwɔ nhwɛso a wɔreton mu bɛyɛ adeɛ bere a ne bo mmeae wɔ nɔma, na ne nsɛnkyerɛnne bɛyɛ nkyekyɛmu.
help-board-view-shop-how-it-works-descri: Bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ hyehyɛ sotɔɔ no wɔ Bɔɔd nhyehyɛeɛ / Sotɔɔ mu: bo, adeɛ code ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ mmeae, Orders nhwɛso a ɛyɛ kokoam, sika su, VAT, sɛnea wɔtua ka, nhwɛso a wɔreton ne nsɛnkyerɛnne a wɔkyerɛ sɛ nkyekyɛmu, afei ɔhyɛ Sotɔɔ no abue agyiraeɛ. Adetɔfoɔ yiyi mu wɔ nkyekyɛmu so, de nneɛma gu kɛntɛn mu na wɔtua ka. Adeɛ a wɔhwehwɛ biara bɛyɛ kaad foforɔ wɔ Orders nhwɛso mu, na adetɔfoɔ no nya ɛmɛl a ɛsi so dua.
help-sidebar-filter-what-it-is-descripti: Yiyi mu kyerɛ kaad a ɛne nea wopaw hyia nko ara, te sɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne, amanfoɔ, wɔn a wɔde adwuma ama wɔn, nna, wo ankasa mmeae nsɛm, kaad nsɛm anaa bere dodoɔ a kaad atena nhwɛso bi mu. Ɛnsesa kaad biara anaa obiara kwan, na wobɛtumi de yiyi mu a ɛka bom asie din bi ase na woasan de adi dwuma.
help-sidebar-filter-how-it-works-descrip: Paw nsɛnkyerɛnne, nnipa, nna anaa nhyehyɛeɛ foforɔ wɔ nkyɛn no, na bɔɔd no kyerɛ kaad a ɛhyia nko ara. Wɔ Nsɛnkyerɛnne ase no, OR hyia nsɛnkyerɛnne biara a woapaw na AND hwehwɛ ne nyinaa; sɛ wosan mia nsɛnkyerɛnne a woapaw so a, ɛyi no fi mu. Kaad nsɛm yɛ adwuma bere a woreyɛ. Sɛ woto fa no mu a, yiyi mu no kɔ so yɛ adwuma kosi sɛ wobɛpepa. Wiase Nhwehwɛmu, a ɛwɔ ha nso, hwehwɛ kaad wɔ wo bɔɔd nyinaa so.
help-sidebar-search-what-it-is-descripti: Hwehwɛ hu bɔɔd yi kaad ne nhwɛso a ne nsɛm wɔ nea wokyerɛw no mu, na ɛkyerɛ kaad biara a wohuu no wɔ bɔɔd no ankasa so. Wɔ Bɔɔd nyinaa so no, bɔtn koro no ara tew wo bɔɔd nhwɛso so wɔ asɛmti so.
help-sidebar-search-how-it-works-descrip: Kyerɛw wɔ mmeae no na mia Enter. Nkyɛn no kyerɛ nhwɛso ne kaad a ɛhyia, na kaad a edi kan bue wɔ bɔɔd no so ne kanfoɔ wɔ mmeae no ase. San mia Enter ma kaad a edi hɔ anaa Shift+Enter ma nea atwam; agyan no nso yɛ saa ara na ɛsan fi mfitiaseɛ. Mia kaad anaa nhwɛso bi so wɔ nsunsuanso no mu na kyerɛ no wɔ bɔɔd no so, na san mia Hwehwɛ to nkyɛn no mu.
help-sidebar-multiselection-what-it-is-d: Multi-Pawion ma wohyɛ kaad pii agyiraeɛ na afei woyɛ ade baako ma ne nyinaa prɛko: hyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne anaa muni, sesa kɔla, tu, yɛ bio anaa fa kɔ adekorabea. Wɔ Bɔɔd nyinaa so no, ɛpaw bɔɔd mmom.
help-sidebar-multiselection-how-it-works: Sɔ Multi-Pawion wɔ bɔɔd ti so, afei hyɛ kaad no agyiraeɛ adaka, anaa fa Yiyi mu kɔ pawion wɔ Yiyi mu nkyɛn mu paw kaad biara a yiyi mu no kyerɛ. Paw dwumadie wɔ nkyɛn no mu, te sɛ Hyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne ma pawion, Tu pawion anaa Fa pawion kɔ adekorabea. Mia Dum Multi-Pawion, X a ɛwɔ ti bɔtn no nkyɛn, bere a woawie. Wohia kwan na woatumi asesa bɔɔd no.
help-sidebar-custom-fields-what-it-is-de: Wo ankasa mmeae yɛ bɔɔd no ankasa mmeae foforɔ ma kaad, te sɛ version, sika nhyehyɛeɛ, adetɔfoɔ, agyiraeɛ adaka anaa deɛ wopaw fi nhwɛso mu. Wɔkyerɛkyerɛ mmeae mu prɛko ma bɔɔd no, na kaad biara betumi akura ne nsɛm ma no.
help-sidebar-custom-fields-how-it-works-: Mia + na yɛ mmeae, ma no din ne su (nsɛm, nɔma, da, dropdown, dropdown a wopaw pii, agyiraeɛ adaka, sika anaa nsɛm nhwɛsoɔ) na paw baabi a wɔbɛkyerɛ no: wɔ kaad no so, wɔ kaad ketewa so, wɔ kaad foforɔ so anaa wɔ kaad biara so. Wontumi nsesa su no akyiri. Nɔma ne sika mmeae betumi akyerɛ wɔn nkabom wɔ nhwɛso biara soro. Afei wɔhyɛ kaad nsɛm wɔ kaad a abue no so.
help-sidebar-archives-what-it-is-descrip: Adekorabea kura kaad, nhwɛso ne akwan a wɔde kɔɔ Adekorabea. Sɛ wode biribi kɔ adekorabea a, ɛde sie a ɛnyera, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛtumi asan de aba akyiri, na sɛ wopepa a, ɛyi no fi hɔ koraa.
help-sidebar-archives-how-it-works-descr: Paw Kaad, Nhwɛso anaa Akwan tab na mia San fa bra wɔ adeɛ bi nkyɛn, anaa San fa ne nyinaa bra. Ebia wontumi nsan mfa kaad bi mma bere a ne nhwɛso wɔ adekorabea anaa ayɛ ma wɔ ne WIP anohyeto ase, na Adekorabea ka saa. Bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ nso hunu Pepa ne Pepa ne nyinaa, a wontumi nsan nyɛ. Wɔsan de bɔɔd a ɛwɔ adekorabea fi Bɔɔd nyinaa Adekorabea krataafa so mmom.
help-sidebar-original-positions-what-it-: Mfitiaseɛ gyinabea kyerɛ baabi a wɔde kwan, nhwɛso ne kaad biara sii bere a wɔyɛɛ no, ne wɔn mu nea atu fi saa bere no. Ɛho wɔ mfasoɔ wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ kɛseɛ akyi, anaa sɛ wopɛ sɛ wohunu asɛmti a wɔde yɛɛ kaad bi.
help-sidebar-original-positions-how-it-w: Kenkan akuo mmiɛnsa no, Akwan, Nhwɛso ne Kaad. Adeɛ biara kyerɛ ne din seesei, Atu bere a ɛnni baabi a wɔde sii bio, baabi a wɔyɛɛ no, n'asɛmti a edi kan bere a asesa, ne bere a wɔyɛɛ no. Mia Yɛ no foforɔ na san kenkan bɔɔd no abakɔsɛm. Nneɛma a wɔyɛɛ ansa na wɔrekyerɛw gyinabea no nni nkyerɛwee.
help-sidebar-summary-what-it-is-descript: Mua yɛ standup amanneɛbɔ a ɛfa nea ɛkɔɔ so wɔ bɔɔd no so, onipa biara, a efi bɔɔd no ankasa nkyerɛwee mu. Ɛbua nea yɛn mu biara yɛɛ wɔ da anaa nnawɔtwe a atwam mu, ne nea bere atwam.
help-sidebar-summary-how-it-works-descri: Paw Da a atwam anaa Nnawɔtwe a atwam. Muni biara a ɔyɛɛ biribi anaa ɔwɔ kaad a bere atwam nya akuo ma kaad a Wɔawie, Atu, Wɔde aka ho ne Wɔde nsusuiɛ ama, ne ne kaad a Bere atwam, na kaad biara bue fi ne link so. Mia Yɛ bio sɛ nsɛm na yɛ mua no nyinaa bio, a ɛyɛ krado sɛ wode bɛhyɛ nkɔmmɔ anaa ɛmɛl mu.
help-sidebar-since-last-visit-what-it-is: Efi wo nsrahwɛ a etwa toɔ kyerɛ nea nnipa afoforɔ asesa wɔ bɔɔd yi so fi bere a wobuee no kɔsii seesei: kaad foforɔ, ntutuo, nsusuiɛ, da a ɛtwa toɔ nsakraeɛ ne amanfoɔ a wɔde aka ho. Mɛnu no so nsɛm kyerɛ nsakraeɛ dodoɔ.
help-sidebar-since-last-visit-how-it-wor: Sɛ wobue bɔɔd no a, wɔkyerɛw wo nsrahwɛ. Bue hwɛbea yi na hwɛ nsakraeɛ no a wɔaboaboa ano wɔ kaad biara so, nea ɛyɛ foforɔ di kan, na mia nkyerɛwee bi so bue saa kaad no. Wɔnkyerɛ wo ankasa nsakraeɛ. Sohwɛfoɔ betumi de dwumadie yi asie wɔ Sohwɛfoɔ paanel / Nhyehyɛeɛ / Nea wubetumi ayɛ mu.
help-board-visibility-what-it-is-descrip: Ahwɛ kwan si gyinaeɛ wɔ obi a ɔbɛtumi ahunu bɔɔd no: nnipa a wɔde wɔn aka ho nko ara (Kokoam), WeKan yi so dwumadifoɔ biara a wɔakɔ mu (Dwumadifoɔ a wɔakɔ mu), anaa obiara a ɔwɔ link no (Baguam). Sesa kɔ so tena bɔɔd no amanfoɔ nsam gye sɛ bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ ama kwan foforɔ.
help-board-visibility-how-it-works-descr: Bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ mia ahwɛ kwan bɔtn a ɛwɔ bɔɔd ti so na ɔpaw Kokoam, Dwumadifoɔ a wɔakɔ mu anaa Baguam; nea wɔapaw seesei no wɔ agyiraeɛ na afei bɔtn no kyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ foforɔ no. Wɔ Dwumadifoɔ a wɔakɔ mu anaa Baguam bɔɔd so, bere a sohwɛfoɔ panin ma kwan no, sohwɛfoɔ no betumi nso ahyɛ Obiara a ɔakɔ mu betumi asesa agyiraeɛ. Ma nnipa afoforɔ no, bɔtn no kyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no nko ara.
help-board-watch-what-it-is-description: Hwɛ si dodoɔ a wobɛte afa bɔɔd yi ho: Rehwɛ ka nsakraeɛ biara kyerɛ wo, Akyidi ka nsakraeɛ a ɛba kaad a woyɛeɛ anaa woka ho nko ara, na Wɔadum amanneɛbɔ nka hwee. Nhyehyɛeɛ no yɛ wo dea; amanfoɔ afoforɔ paw wɔn dea.
help-board-watch-how-it-works-descriptio: Mia hwɛ bɔtn a ɛwɔ bɔɔd ti so na paw Rehwɛ, Akyidi anaa Wɔadum amanneɛbɔ; wo gyinabea seesei wɔ agyiraeɛ na bɔtn no kyerɛ gyinabea foforɔ no. Sɛ wɔpo nsakraeɛ no a, nkra bi ka deɛ enti na biribiara nsesa. Wɔde bɔtn no sie bere a sohwɛfoɔ adum hwɛ.
help-board-sort-cards-what-it-is-descrip: Hyehyɛ kaad sesa sɛnea wɔkyerɛ kaad wɔ nhwɛso biara mu: wɔ da a ɛtwa toɔ, asɛmti, bere a wɔyɛɛ no, aba anaa bɔɔd no nsɛnkyerɛnne nhyehyɛeɛ so. Ɛsesa nea wohunu nko ara, na wɔntu kaad biara.
help-board-sort-cards-how-it-works-descr: Mia Hyehyɛ kaad wɔ bɔɔd ti so na paw nhyehyɛeɛ; kaad a ɛwɔ nhwɛso biara mu di akyi na bɔtn no ka sɛ Nhyehyɛeɛ no reyɛ adwuma. Mia X a ɛwɔ ne nkyɛn yi nhyehyɛeɛ no fi hɔ na san kɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔtwee kaad no kɔɔ mu. Wo brawsa kora nea wopaw no bere a wosan bue no mpo. Ma Nsɛnkyerɛnne nhyehyɛeɛ no, bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ betumi de Tu kɔ soro ne Tu kɔ fam asesa nsɛnkyerɛnne nhyehyɛeɛ bere a ɔresesa nsɛnkyerɛnne bi.
help-board-settings-what-it-is-descripti: Bɔɔd nhyehyɛeɛ boaboa biribiara a wɔahyehyɛ ama bɔɔd baako yi ano: ne mmara, nhyehyɛeɛ, kɔla ne n'akyi, nna, hwɛbea, akwan, nhwɛso ne kaad, yi adi ne fa ba mu, amanneɛbɔ, webhooks ne adekorabea. Nsɛm no mu dodoɔ no ara wɔ hɔ ma bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ; wo dwumadie ne wɛbsaet no nhyehyɛeɛ na ɛkyerɛ nea wobɛhunu.
help-board-settings-how-it-works-descrip: Bue bɔɔd no nifa nkyɛn fa mɛnu no so na mia Bɔɔd nhyehyɛeɛ. Paw nsɛm bi na ne popup anaa ne krataafa bue. Wɔaboaboa nsɛm no ano: mmara di kan, afei bɔɔd no ahoɔfɛ, afei sɛnea wɔtwa no, afei nea ɛkɔ mu ne nea efi mu, na awieeɛ no adekorabea.
help-board-settings-color-what-it-is-des: Sesa kɔla hyɛ bɔɔd yi ankasa kɔla nhyehyɛeɛ, a muni biara hunu wɔ bɔɔd yi so. Ɛyɛ ɔkwan a wobɛfa so ahunu bɔɔd ahodoɔ ntam nsonsonoeɛ ntɛm. Bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ nko ara na wɔtumi sesa.
help-board-settings-color-how-it-works-d: Mia kɔla nhwɛsoɔ bi so; ɛyɛ adwuma ntɛm ara, Sie bɔtn biara nni hɔ. Ma kɔla nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ tratraa ne nea ɛyɛ hann no, wobɛtumi nso de kɔla kyinhyia apaw wo ankasa kɔla na woahwɛ wɔ nhwɛsoɔ mu. Kɔla a wohyɛɛ ma wo ho wɔ Muni nhyehyɛeɛ mu da so di bɔɔd no kɔla anim ma wo.
help-board-settings-announcement-what-it: Bɔɔd dawurubɔ yɛ nkra a bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ kyerɛw ma obiara a ɔwɔ bɔɔd yi so, a wɔkyerɛ no wɔ dua bi a ɛda bɔɔd no nhwɛso soro. Fa di dwuma ma nsɛm a ɛsɛ sɛ muni biara hunu, te sɛ da a ɛtwa toɔ anaa nsakraeɛ wɔ sɛnea wɔde bɔɔd no di dwuma mu.
help-board-settings-announcement-how-it-: Kyerɛw nsɛm no, nkyerɛwde 2000 a ɛyɛ nsɛm kɛkɛ, hyɛ Kyerɛ obiara a ɔwɔ bɔɔd yi so agyiraeɛ, na mia Sie. Amanfoɔ hunu dua no kosi sɛ wɔde ne X bɛto mu, a ɛde sie ma wɔn nko ara. Sɛ wɔsesa dawurubɔ no a, wɔsan kyerɛ obiara.
help-board-settings-background-what-it-i: Akyi mfonini yɛ mfonini a wɔkyerɛ wɔ bɔɔd no nhwɛso akyi, na ɛsan yɛ bɔɔd no tayel wɔ Bɔɔd nyinaa krataafa so. Ebetumi ayɛ mfonini address wɔ wɛb so anaa mfonini a wɔde aba na wɔakora wɔ WeKan mu.
help-board-settings-background-how-it-wo: Kyerɛw mfonini address wɔ Akyi mfonini URL mu na mia Sie, anaa fa Yi akyi mfonini pepa. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wokora mfonini a, mia Fa akyi mfonini bra na paw fael; mfonini a wɔde aba no wɔ ase, baabi a sɛ womia baako so a ɛyɛ bɔɔd no akyi, na ahyɛnsode no twe no ba anaa ɛpepa no.
help-board-settings-date-what-it-is-desc: Da ma bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ paw da kyerɛwbea baako ma obiara a ɔwɔ bɔɔd yi so, sen kyerɛwbea a wɔahyɛ ama wɛbsaet no nyinaa. Popup koro no ara wɔ wo ankasa nnawɔtwe nɔma sɔ ne dum, na ma bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ no, kalenda nhyiamu a ɛde kaad no nna a ɛtwa toɔ gu CalDAV kalenda te sɛ Nextcloud mu.
help-board-settings-date-how-it-works-de: Hyɛ bɔɔd no Da kyerɛwbea agyiraeɛ, paw kyerɛwbea na mia Sie; yi agyiraeɛ no fi so na san di wɛbsaet no nhyehyɛeɛ akyi. Muni ankasa kyerɛwbea a ɔsɔɛ wɔ Muni nhyehyɛeɛ mu da so di kan. Kyerɛ afe no nnawɔtwe sɔ nnawɔtwe nɔma anaa ɛdum ma wo ntɛm ara. Ma kalenda nhyiamu no, kyerɛw kalenda address, dwumadini din ne app ahintasɛm, hyɛ nhyiamu adaka no agyiraeɛ na Sie.
help-board-settings-all-boards-what-it-i: Bɔɔd nyinaa nhyehyɛeɛ si gyinaeɛ wɔ nea bɔɔd yi tayel kyerɛ wɔ Bɔɔd nyinaa krataafa so, te sɛ nhwɛso biara kaad dodoɔ ne amanfoɔ mfonini. Ɛsan hyɛ kaad a ɛrenyin, kaad a obiara mfaa ho a wɔde kɔ adekorabea ankasa, ne sɛ nhwɛso trɛ yɛ obiara dea anaa wɔkyɛ.
help-board-settings-all-boards-how-it-wo: Hyɛ nkyerɛwee bi agyiraeɛ anaa yi fi so na wɔsie ntɛm ara. Bere a kaad a ɛrenyin sɔ no, kyerɛw nna nɔma mmiɛnsa a ɛno akyi no kaad no hann so tew nkakrankakra. Ma ankasa adekorabea no, kyerɛw nna dodoɔ a kaad betumi atena a dwumadie biara nni so ansa na wɔde akɔ adekorabea, anaa gyae no hunu na dum no. Wɔmfa nhwɛsoɔ nkɔ adekorabea da.
help-board-settings-board-view-what-it-i: Bɔɔd hwɛbea paw hwɛbea a wɔde bɛma wɔ bɔɔd yi Bɔɔd hwɛbea mɛnu mu, te sɛ Akwan, Nhwɛso, Pon, Kalenda, Gantt anaa mfonini no, ne nea bɔɔd no bɛbue wɔ mu. Wɔhyɛ no soronko ma bere a bɔɔd no yɛ baguam ne bere a ɛyɛ kokoam.
help-board-settings-board-view-how-it-wo: Popup no wɔ nkyerɛwee baako ma hwɛbea biara ne agyiraeɛ adaka anan: hwɛbea a edi kan ne hwɛbea a wɔkyerɛ ma baguam bɔɔd, ne saa mmienu no ara ma kokoam bɔɔd. Hyɛ hwɛbea bi Kyerɛ adaka agyiraeɛ na wɔde ama wɔ mɛnu no mu na ne Nea edi kan adaka na bɔɔd no abue wɔ mu.
help-board-settings-swimlane-what-it-is-: Kwan kura akwan nhyehyɛeɛ ma bɔɔd no nyinaa: sɛ wobɛtumi atwe akwan, sɛ wobɛtumi asesa wɔn tenten, sɛ akwan nyinaa kyɛ nhwɛso ti nkyerɛwee baako, ne Scrum mmeae a kwan kyerɛ. WIP anohyeto akuo, adwuma a ɛkɔ so anohyeto a wɔkyɛ wɔ nhwɛso pii so, nso wɔ ha.
help-board-settings-swimlane-how-it-work: Hyɛ adaka a wopɛ no agyiraeɛ; Wotumi twe agyiraeɛ adaka no wɔ pon a ɛwɔ soro no mu. Nhwɛso ti nkyerɛwee baako a wɔkyɛ kyerɛ kwan biara ne bɔɔd no nhwɛso nyinaa wɔ ti nkyerɛwee baako a ɛtena soro ase, a ɛnsesa nhwɛso no. Mia WIP anohyeto akuo wɔ ase na fa anohyeto a wɔkyɛ ka ho anaa sesa.
help-board-settings-list-what-it-is-desc: Nhwɛso kura nhwɛso nhyehyɛeɛ ma bɔɔd no nyinaa: sɛ wobɛtumi atwe nhwɛso, sɛ wobɛtumi asesa wɔn trɛ, sɛ nhwɛso biara trɛ yɛ pɛ, ne Scrum mmeae a nhwɛso kyerɛ. Ɛsan sɔ Kanban nsenee mmara: nhwɛso mmara, nhwɛso a wɔakyekyɛ mu ayɛ Ɛrekɔ so ne Wɔawie, bɔhyɛ beaeɛ ne WIP anohyeto ma onipa biara.
help-board-settings-list-how-it-works-de: Hyɛ sɔ ne dum a wohia no agyiraeɛ; Wotumi twe agyiraeɛ adaka no wɔ pon a ɛwɔ soro no mu. Bere a wɔama sesa kɛseɛ ho kwan no, twe nsa kura a ɛda nhwɛso ntam na sesa trɛ. Nsenee mmara nkyerɛwee pue bere a wɔasɔ saa dwumadie no ama wɛbsaet no nko ara, na sɛ ɛsɔ a, wɔhyɛ ne nsɛm fi nhwɛso biara ankasa mɛnu mu.
help-board-settings-shop-what-it-is-desc: Sotɔɔ dane bɔɔd no kaad yɛ wɛb sotɔɔ a wɔkyerɛ wɔ Sotɔɔ bɔɔd hwɛbea mu. Bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ paw wo ankasa mmeae a ɛyɛ bo, adeɛ code ne nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ, nhwɛso a wɔreton, nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛyɛ nkyekyɛmu, baabi a wɔkyerɛw nneɛma a wɔhwehwɛ ne ɔkwan a wɔfa so tua ka a wɔde ma.
help-board-settings-shop-how-it-works-de: Hyɛ nkyerɛwee no na mia Sie; wɔsie biribiara bom na server no san hwɛ mu bio. Kaad a bo wɔ so wɔ nhwɛso a wɔreton mu bɛyɛ adeɛ. Wɔkyerɛw nneɛma a wɔhwehwɛ sɛ kaad wɔ Orders nhwɛso mu, a ɛsɛ sɛ ɛwɔ kokoam bɔɔd so, na adetɔfoɔ no betumi anya ɛmɛl a ɛsi so dua. Wobɛtumi nso ayɛ Sotɔɔ no nea baguam bɔɔd no ahɔhoɔ hunu.
help-board-settings-card-what-it-is-desc: Kaad si gyinaeɛ wɔ nea kaad nketewa ne kaad a abue wɔ bɔɔd yi so kyerɛ, ne nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ mu, biara soronko. Fa di dwuma bere a bɔɔd de ne ho to mmeae kakra so, sɛ nhwɛsoɔ de nkyerɛkyerɛmu anaa wo ankasa mmeae di kan, anaa de da a ɛtwa toɔ di kan wɔ kaad nketewa so.
help-board-settings-card-how-it-works-de: Popup no wɔ mfa mmienu, Kyerɛ wɔ kaad ketewa so ne Kyerɛ wɔ kaad so. Hyɛ ɔfa anaa mmeae bi agyiraeɛ anaa yi fi so na kyerɛ no anaa sie no, na twe nkyerɛwee sesa wɔn nhyehyɛeɛ. Ɔfa kakra wɔ wɔn ankasa mɛnu a nhyehyɛeɛ pii wɔ mu, te sɛ Adwuma nketewa ne kaad no twe akwan.
help-board-settings-import-export-what-i: Yi adi kyerɛw bɔɔd yi, anaa ne fa bi, kɔ fael mu: WeKan ankasa nhyehyɛeɛ, spreadsheet, PDF, HTML, kalenda fael ne adwinnadeɛ afoforɔ pii nhyehyɛeɛ. Fa ba mu de nsɛm a efi WeKan yi adi mu ka bɔɔd yi ho. Bɔɔd yi adi nyɛ wɛbsaet no nyinaa backup.
help-board-settings-import-export-how-it: Wɔ Yi adi mu no, di kan paw nea wobɛfa aka ho, afei mia nhyehyɛeɛ bi na fael no ba. Wɔ Fa ba mu no, paw WeKan yi adi fael a ɛyɛ json anaa zip na wɔde ne nsɛm ka bɔɔd yi ho. Fa ba mu hia kyerɛw kwan wɔ bɔɔd no so, na wɛbsaet sohwɛfoɔ betumi adum emu biara.
help-board-settings-notifications-what-i: Amanneɛbɔ hyɛ bɔɔd yi nhyehyɛeɛ a edi kan ma ɛmɛl ne app mu amanneɛbɔ, ne da a ɛtwa toɔ nkaeɛ, ɛmɛl kɔ kaad, ne sɛnea wɔde amanneɛbɔ ma. Muni ankasa apawdeɛ a ɛda adi betumi ada so adi bɔɔd no nhyehyɛeɛ so.
help-board-settings-notifications-how-it: Ma app mu adaka ne ɛmɛl no, paw Nea edi kan na di wɛbsaet no nhyehyɛeɛ akyi, anaa Aane anaa Daabi na sesa ma bɔɔd yi. Wɔ Da a ɛtwa toɔ nkaeɛ ase no, kyerɛw nna a wɔbɛkae wo, a wɔde comma atetew mu, baabi a 0 ne da a ɛtwa toɔ no na nɔma a ɛyɛ nea ɛnni mu yɛ nna a edi akyi, afei mia Sie. Ɔfa a ɛwɔ ase no hyɛ nea amanneɛbɔ kura, boaboa ano ne bere.
help-board-settings-webhooks-what-it-is-: Webhooks a ɛkɔ abɔnten de bɔɔd yi dwumadie kɔ dwumadie foforɔ so, te sɛ nkɔmmɔ adwinnadeɛ anaa wo ankasa nkabom, bere a ɛrekɔ so no. Webhook biara de dwumadie no nsɛm ne bɔɔd, nhwɛso, kwan, kaad ne nnipa a wɔka ho din ne link kɔ.
help-board-settings-webhooks-how-it-work: Kyerɛw din, address a dwumadie a ɛgye no de maa wo no ne, sɛ ɛhwehwɛ bi a, token, paw su no na mia Yɛ. Webhook a wɔasie kyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ pii: dwumadie a ɛde kɔ, nkra tee ma kaad amanfoɔ ma Mattermost, ne sɛnea wɔboaboa ne nkra ano na wɔhyɛ bere. Sesa na san Sie, anaa fa Dum Webhook yi na gyae no.
help-board-settings-scrum-meetings-what-: Mmoa mmienu ma Scrum nhyiamu, a ɛwɔ hɔ ma bɔɔd no so muni biara. Da biara standup yɛ bere susudua a ɛma muni biara bere koro, na Akyi nhwɛ bɔɔd yɛ bɔɔd foforɔ ma Hyɛ aseɛ, Gyae, Kɔ so akyi nhwɛ.
help-board-settings-scrum-meetings-how-i: Da biara standup kyerɛ bɔɔd no amanfoɔ wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔafrafra mu; Hyɛ aseɛ kan onipa a odi kan bere so, a ɛdane kɔkɔɔ bere a atwa mu, na Nea edi hɔ de ma kosi nea ɔtwa toɔ. Bere susudua no yɛ adwuma wɔ wo brawsa mu nko ara. Akyi nhwɛ bɔɔd yɛ na ɛbue kokoam bɔɔd foforɔ a nhwɛso Hyɛ aseɛ yɛ, Gyae yɛ, Kɔ so yɛ ne Nneyɛeɛ wɔ so.
help-board-settings-wip-limit-groups-wha: WIP anohyeto kuo yɛ adwuma a ɛkɔ so anohyeto baako a nhwɛso mmienu anaa nea ɛboro saa kyɛ bom, wɔ nhwɛso biara ankasa anohyeto so. Ɛho wɔ mfasoɔ bere a adwuma a ɛkɔ so trɛ nhwɛso pii so, te sɛ Ɛrekɔ so, Nhwehwɛmu ne Sɔhwɛ, anaa bere a wopɛ sɛ wohyɛ kwan no nyinaa ano.
help-board-settings-wip-limit-groups-how: Wɔ Fa WIP anohyeto kuo ka ho ase no, hyɛ nhwɛso a wɔbɛkan bom agyiraeɛ, anaa paw kwan bi na mia Fa di dwuma wɔ kwan so na hyɛ ne nhwɛso agyiraeɛ. Hyɛ anohyeto no na mia Fa WIP anohyeto kuo ka ho. Kuo a ɛwɔ hɔ dada no, wobɛtumi de Fa di dwuma asesa, de Sɔ WIP anohyeto asɔ anaa adum, anaa de Pepa ayi.
help-board-settings-subtasks-what-it-is-: Adwuma nketewa kyekyɛ kaad kɛseɛ mu ma ɛyɛ kaad nketewa a wobɛtumi de biara ama obi, ahyɛ ne bere na atu no soronko, na kaad maame no kyerɛ wɔn na ɛkan nea wɔawie. Nhyehyɛeɛ yi si gyinaeɛ wɔ baabi a wɔyɛ adwuma nketewa foforɔ ne sɛnea adwuma ketewa kyerɛ ne maame.
help-board-settings-subtasks-how-it-work: Paw sɛnea adwuma ketewa kaad ketewa bɔ ne maame din, sɛ bɔɔd no kaad wɔ Adwuma nketewa ɔfa, ne bɔɔd, nhwɛso ne kwan a wɔyɛ adwuma nketewa foforɔ wɔ mu. Sɛ wɔnsesa a, wɔkɔ wɔn ankasa bɔɔd so. Wɔde adwuma nketewa no ankasa ka ho fi kaad a abue Adwuma nketewa ɔfa mu.
help-rules-what-it-is-description: Mmara yɛ bɔɔd no adwuma ankasa: sɛ biribi si a, nea ɛkanyan, WeKan yɛ biribi, dwumadie no. Sɛ nhwɛsoɔ, sɛ wɔde kaad kɔ Done mu a, hyɛ no agyiraeɛ sɛ wɔawie. Bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ na wɔyɛ mmara, na bɔɔd betumi ama n'amanfoɔ akenkan.
help-rules-how-it-works-description: Kyerɛw asɛmti, paw nea ɛkanyan na hyɛ ne mmeae ma, afei paw dwumadie; wɔsie mmara no na ɛyɛ adwuma fi saa bere no gye sɛ wɔadum. Wɔ Adwuma kwan hwɛbea mu no, wobɛtumi ayɛ mmara denam nea ɛkanyan ne dwumadie a wobɛtwe so. Wobɛtumi asesa mmara din, apepa, ayi adi na de aba mu, na mmara betumi anya nea ɛkanyan ne dwumadie pii wɔ ne nsɛm mu.
help-member-settings-what-it-is-descript: Muni nhyehyɛeɛ yɛ wo ankasa mɛnu, a wobue fi wo dwumadini din anaa wo mfonini wɔ nifa soro. Ɛwɔ wo ankasa krataafa te sɛ Me Kaad, Kaad a ne bere adu ne Nea wɔahyɛ nsoroma, bɔɔd nhwɛsoɔ, ne wo ankasa nhyehyɛeɛ nyinaa, fi wo ho nsɛm ne ahintasɛm kosi kasa ne nkyerɛwde.
help-member-settings-how-it-works-descri: Mia wo dwumadini din anaa wo mfonini so na paw nsɛm bi; ne krataafa anaa ne popup bue. Nea wohunu gyina wo akawnt su, wo dwumadie ne wɛbsaet no nhyehyɛeɛ so. Bere a wɛbsaet sohwɛfoɔ dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ de dwumadie bi sie wo a, mɛnu no ka dodoɔ a wɔde asie.
help-member-edit-profile-what-it-is-desc: Sesa wo ho nsɛm sesa sɛnea nnipa afoforɔ hunu wo wɔ WeKan mu: wo din nyinaa ne wo din ahyɛaseɛ nkyerɛwde, na bere a wɛbsaet no ma kwan no, wo dwumadini din ne wo ɛmɛl address. Bere a wɛbsaet no ma kwan no, wobɛtumi nso apepa wo ankasa akawnt anaa ayɛ no a obiara nnim wo wɔ ha.
help-member-edit-profile-how-it-works-de: Sesa mmeae no na mia Sie; popup no to mu bere a ayɛ yie na ɛkyerɛ mfomsoɔ no sɛ anyɛ yie a. Wɔpo dwumadini din anaa ɛmɛl address a akawnt foforɔ de redi dwuma dada, na wɔhyɛ ɛmɛl address a wɔasesa agyiraeɛ sɛ wɔnsii so dua. Pepa yi wo akawnt a wontumi nsan nyɛ, na Yɛ akawnt no a obiara nnim wo kora w'abakɔsɛm nanso ɛsesa wo din.
help-member-change-settings-what-it-is-d: Sesa nhyehyɛeɛ kura wo ankasa sesa ne ahwɛ apawdeɛ, te sɛ twe nsa kura, kaad a asesa fi bere a wobuee no a etwa toɔ agyiraeɛ, adwene si so hyeɛ, sɛ wode Enter sie nsɛm, sɛ wobue kaad pii prɛko ne nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso nnyegyeeɛ. Ɛfa wo nko ara ho, wɔ bɔɔd biara so.
help-member-change-settings-how-it-works: Mia sɔ ne dum bi so na sɔ anaa dum; agyiraeɛ kyerɛ sɛ ɛsɔ na wɔsie ntɛm ara. Ma Kyerɛ kaad dodoɔ sɛ nhwɛso no kura nea ɛboro, kyerɛw nɔma na mia Sie. Da kyerɛwbea, nnawɔtwe mfitiaseɛ ne amanneɛbɔ wɔ wɔn ankasa nsɛm wɔ Muni nhyehyɛeɛ mu.
help-member-change-color-what-it-is-desc: Sesa kɔla hyɛ wo ankasa kɔla nhyehyɛeɛ ma WeKan. Ɛdi wɛbsaet no kɔla nhyehyɛeɛ so wɔ baabiara na ɛsan di bɔɔd no ankasa kɔla so wɔ bɔɔd krataafa so, nanso ma wo nko ara.
help-member-change-color-how-it-works-de: Mia kɔla nhwɛsoɔ bi so; ɛyɛ adwuma ntɛm ara. Ma kɔla nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ tratraa ne nea ɛyɛ hann no, wobɛtumi de kɔla kyinhyia apaw wo ankasa kɔla na woahunu wɔn wɔ nhwɛsoɔ mu. Paw Kɔla nhyehyɛeɛ a edi kan na yi wo apawdeɛ fi hɔ na san hunu bɔɔd no anaa wɛbsaet no kɔla.
help-member-change-font-what-it-is-descr: Nkyerɛwde ma wopaw nkyerɛwde su, nsɛm kɛseɛ ne nsɛm kɔla ma WeKan nhyehyɛeɛ no nyinaa ma wo ho. Ɛboa kenkan, sɛ nhwɛsoɔ, kɛseɛ a ɛso anaa kɔla a ɛfata w'ani.
help-member-change-font-how-it-works-des: Mia Nea edi kan anaa nkyerɛwde bɔtn no mu baako so; nkyerɛwde a wɔde ahyɛ wo brawsa mu nko ara na wɔde ma. Paw kɛseɛ na paw nsɛm kɔla wɔ kɔla kyinhyia no so, anaa mia Yi na san kɔ kɔla nhyehyɛeɛ no kɔla so. Nsakraeɛ yɛ adwuma ntɛm ara na wɔsie wɔ wo ho nsɛm mu, na nhwɛsoɔ nkyerɛwee no kyerɛ nea efi mu ba.
help-member-change-avatar-what-it-is-des: Wo mfonini yɛ mfonini ketewa a wɔkyerɛ ma wo wɔ kaad so, amanfoɔ nhwɛso, nsusuiɛ ne ti no mu. Sesa mfonini ma wode mfonini ba, wopaw nea wɔde bɛdi dwuma, wopepa wɔn, anaa wosan kɔ wo din ahyɛaseɛ nkyerɛwde so.
help-member-change-avatar-how-it-works-d: Mia Fa mfonini bra na paw mfonini; wɔde ka nhwɛso no ho, na sɛ womia ne nkyerɛwee so a ɛyɛ wo mfonini, a agyiraeɛ wɔ so. Mia Din ahyɛaseɛ nkyerɛwde na kyerɛ wo din ahyɛaseɛ nkyerɛwde mmom. Nwura adaka ahyɛnsode no pepa mfonini bere a woagye atom. Popup no kyerɛ kɛseɛ ne fael su anohyeto bere a wɛbsaet no hyɛ.
help-member-change-password-what-it-is-d: Sesa ahintasɛm sesa ahintasɛm a wode kɔ WeKan mu. Ɛyɛ ma akawnt a ɛwɔ WeKan ahintasɛm; akawnt a ɛfa dwumadie foforɔ so kɔ mu sesa wɔn ahintasɛm wɔ hɔ.
help-member-change-password-how-it-works: Kyerɛw w'ahintasɛm a ɛwɔ hɔ seesei, afei ahintasɛm foforɔ no mprenu, na fa kɔ. Wɛbsaet no betumi ahwehwɛ tenten a ɛsua koraa na apo ahintasɛm a ɛbɛn wo dwumadini din anaa wo ɛmɛl dodo, anaa nea wɔahu wɔ nsɛm a ayera a wɔnim mu. Nsakraeɛ no akyi no wɔyi wo akawnt nhyiamu biara, na wode ahintasɛm foforɔ no san kɔ mu.
help-member-passkeys-what-it-is-descript: Passkey ma wode mfidie yi nsateaa agyiraeɛ, anim, screen nsɔ anaa ahobanbɔ safoa kɔ mu sen w'ahintasɛm. Passkey no tena wo mfidie so na WeKan kora ne baguam fa nko ara.
help-member-passkeys-how-it-works-descri: Kyerɛw din te sɛ Me fon na mia Fa passkey ka ho wɔ mfidie yi so, afei fa wo screen nsɔ si so dua bere a brawsa no bisa. Wɔkyerɛ wo passkeys ne wɔn din ne nna, na nwura adaka ahyɛnsode no yi baako. Sɛ brawsa no ntumi nyɛ passkeys a, popup no ka saa.
help-member-sqrl-what-it-is-description: SQRL ma wokɔ mu denam QR code a wode SQRL app bɛhwɛ so, a ahintasɛm biara nni hɔ. Wɔ ha no wode wo SQRL nipasu ka wo akawnt ho prɛko, anaa wosan yi.
help-member-sqrl-how-it-works-descriptio: Mia Fa me SQRL nipasu ka ho na QR code bi pue. Fa SQRL app hwɛ, anaa mia Bue SQRL client ma client a ɛwɔ kɔmputa yi so; popup no ka kyerɛ wo bere a wɔde nipasu no aka ho, anaa sɛ code no bere atwam anaa anyɛ yie. Yi me SQRL nipasu yi fi wo akawnt so.
help-member-two-factor-what-it-is-descri: Nhwɛsoɔ mmienu nsi so dua ma kɔ mu bisa nɔma 6 code a efi authenticator app wɔ wo fon so w'ahintasɛm akyi, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ahintasɛm a wɔawia nko ara renso sɛ wɔde bɛkɔ wo akawnt mu.
help-member-two-factor-how-it-works-desc: Mia Sɔ Nhwɛsoɔ Mmienu Nsi So Dua, afei fa authenticator app hwɛ QR code no anaa kyerɛw code a ɛwɔ n'ase no hyɛ app no mu. help-card-subtasks-what-it-is-descriptio: Adwuma nketewa kyekyɛ kaad kɛseɛ mu ma ɛyɛ kaad nketewa a wobɛtumi de biara ama obi, ahyɛ ne bere na atu no soronko, na kaad maame yi kyerɛ wɔn na ɛkan nea wɔawie. Adwuma ketewa yɛ kaad a ɛtaa yɛ, a wɔkora wɔ bɔɔd a wɔapaw ama adwuma nketewa so.

help-card-locations-how-it-works-descrip: Hyɛ beaeɛ din, address, latitude ne longitude ma na mia Sie. Sɛ wode asase mfonini link hyɛ mu a, popup no hunu beaeɛ no ma wo, enti obiara renhia sɛ ɔkyerɛw nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ beaeɛ. Sɛ womia beaeɛ bi so wɔ kaad no so a ɛsan bue no ma wosesa anaa wopepa, na nnyinasoɔ a ɛwɔ ne nkyɛn yi no ntɛm ara.
help-card-dependencies-what-it-is-descri: Nnyinasoɔ de kaad yi bɔ kaad afoforɔ ho: ɛsiw wɔn kwan, wɔsiw ne kwan, ɛsiesie wɔn, ɛyɛ wɔn bio anaa ɛfa wɔn ho. Bere a nnyinasoɔ sɔ wɔ Muni nhyehyɛeɛ mu no, wɔtwa wɔn sɛ agyan nkyerɛwee a kɔla wɔ so wɔ bɔɔd no so, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛhunu adwuma no nhyehyɛeɛ ntɛm.
help-card-dependencies-how-it-works-desc: Paw abusuabɔ su ne kɔla, afei hwehwɛ na mia kaad a wode bɛbɔ ho no so. Wɔkyerɛ link no wɔ kaad no Nnyinasoɔ mu ne sɛ nkyerɛwee wɔ bɔɔd no so. Mia nkyerɛwee bi so, anaa fa kaad no Nnyinasoɔ di dwuma, na sesa ne su, ne kɔla anaa n'ahyɛnsode, anaa yi no. Wobɛtumi nso atwe kaad ketewa nkabom nsa kura akɔ kaad foforɔ so.
help-card-action-items-what-it-is-descri: Nneyɛeɛ dane nhyiamu nsɛm a wɔde ahyɛ mu no adwuma nkyerɛwee yɛ kaad. Nkyerɛwee te sɛ TODO: Kyerɛ nhyiamu beaeɛ, adwuma nkyerɛwee a wɔnhyɛɛ no agyiraeɛ, anaa nkyerɛwee a ɛde din bɔ hyɛ aseɛ, wɔhunu wɔn wɔ wɔn tebea so, a AI nka ho.
help-card-action-items-how-it-works-desc: Popup no kyerɛ kaad a wɔbɛyɛ, biara ne agyiraeɛ ne muni a din bɔ no kyerɛ no. Yi nea wompɛ agyiraeɛ fi so na mia Yɛ. Kaad foforɔ no kɔ nhwɛso koro a kaad yi wɔ mu no ara mu na ɛde link san ba ne so. Din bɔ bɛyɛ muni bere a saa onipa no yɛ bɔɔd no muni a ɔyɛ adwuma nko ara.
help-card-history-what-it-is-description: Abakɔsɛm yɛ nsakraeɛ biara a wɔayɛ wɔ kaad yi so nhwɛso: obi a ɔsesaa deɛ, bere ne nsɛm a efi mu ne nea ɛkɔɔ mu. Wobɛtumi apaw nsakraeɛ biara na woasan de aba, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛtumi asan ayɛ mfomsoɔ mpo akyiri yi.
help-card-history-how-it-works-descripti: Kyerɛw wɔ Hwehwɛ mu na tew nkyerɛwee no so, anaa mia onipa bi mfonini so na hwɛ ne nsakraeɛ nko ara. Fa agyan no kɔ krataafa so. Hyɛ nkyerɛwee baako anaa pii agyiraeɛ na mia San fa bra; wɔsan de nkyerɛwee pii ba, nea edi kan di kan sɛ nsakraeɛ baako, a wobɛtumi nso asan ayɛ. Ctrl+Z ne Ctrl+Y nso san yɛ na wɔsan yɛ wo ankasa nsakraeɛ a etwa toɔ.
help-card-qr-code-what-it-is-description: QR code no kyerɛ kaad yi link sɛ code a wobɛtumi ahwɛ, na woabue kaad no wɔ fon anaa tablet so a wonkyerɛw ne address. Ɛnsesa hwee wɔ kaad no so.
help-card-qr-code-how-it-works-descripti: Fa fon no kamera kyerɛ code no na bue link no; wɔsan kyerɛ address no sɛ nsɛm wɔ n'ase. Wɔtwa code no wɔ wo brawsa mu na wɔmfa hwee nkɔ baabiara. Obiara a ɔbɛhwɛ no da so hia sɛ ɔkɔ mu na ɔwɔ kwan wɔ bɔɔd no so. Link a ɛware dodo ma QR code no, wɔka ho asɛm mmom.
help-card-move-what-it-is-description: Tu kaad tu kaad no kɔ baabi foforɔ wɔ bɔɔd yi so anaa bɔɔd foforɔ so. Ɛyɛ nea twe yɛ, baabi a twe ntumi nnu mpo, te sɛ bɔɔd foforɔ anaa baabi pɔtee wɔ nhwɛso tenten mu.
help-card-move-how-it-works-description: Paw bɔɔd, kwan ne nhwɛso, afei kaad ne sɛ ɛbɛkɔ ne soro anaa n'ase. Wobɛtumi asesa asɛmti, akyerɛw ntutuo ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛho nhia, na woahyɛ Gyae link wɔ beaeɛ a edi kan agyiraeɛ na woakora kaad a link wɔ so wɔ baabi a na ɛwɔ. Mia Wɔawie bere a baabi a ɛrekɔ no aba. Shift+M nso bue popup yi, na wɔkae baabi a ɛrekɔ ma bɔɔd biara.
help-card-copy-what-it-is-description: Yɛ kaad bio yɛ kaad no foforɔ a ɛyɛ ankasa dea wɔ bɔɔd yi anaa foforɔ so, ne ankasa nɔma ne ne nsusuiɛ, nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso, nneɛma a wɔde aka ho ne adwuma nketewa foforɔ.
help-card-copy-how-it-works-description: Sesa asɛmti no sɛ wopɛ a; asɛmti hunu nyɛ hwee bio. Paw bɔɔd, kwan ne nhwɛso, afei kaad ne sɛ nea wɔayɛ bio no bɛkɔ ne soro anaa n'ase, na mia Wɔawie. Sɛ wɔpo nea wɔayɛ bio no a, wɔkyerɛ deɛ enti wɔ ha. Shift+C nso bue popup yi, na wɔkae baabi a ɛrekɔ ma bɔɔd biara.
help-card-recurrence-what-it-is-descript: Kaad a ɛsan ba ma WeKan yɛ kaad yi foforɔ wɔ nhwɛso koro no ara mu sɛnea nhyehyɛeɛ te, ma adwuma a ɛsan ba te sɛ nnawɔtwe biara tebea amanneɛbɔ anaa bosome biara ka krataa a anka wɔde nsa bɛsan ayɛ.
help-card-recurrence-how-it-works-descri: Paw Da biara, Nnawɔtwe biara anaa Bosome biara, anaa Dum na gyae no; Dum ne nea edi kan. Afei server no ankasa yɛ nea wɔayɛ bio no, a nhyehyɛeɛ foforɔ biara nhia. Sɛ wode kaad no kɔ adekorabea a, ɛno nso ma ɛgyae sɛ ɛbɛyɛ bio, sɛ bere ntam no da so wɔ hɔ mpo.
help-card-copy-many-what-it-is-descripti: Yɛ nhwɛsoɔ bio ma kaad pii yɛ kaad yi bio pii prɛko. Kaad no yɛ adwuma sɛ nhwɛsoɔ: ne nhwehwɛmu nhwɛso, nneɛma a wɔde aka ho, nsɛnkyerɛnne ne mmeae afoforɔ kɔ nea wɔayɛ bio biara so, na asɛmti ne nkyerɛkyerɛmu nko ara na ɛyɛ soronko.
help-card-copy-many-how-it-works-descrip: Wɔ nsɛm adaka no mu no, kyerɛw nsɛm baako ma kaad biara ne n'asɛmti ne ne nkyerɛkyerɛmu, di nhwɛsoɔ a wɔahyɛ ma dada no akyi. Paw bɔɔd, kwan, nhwɛso ne baabi a ɛwɔ kaad bi nkyɛn, afei mia Wɔawie. Sɛ nsɛm no nni nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfata mu a, wɔnyɛ hwee na wɔkyerɛ mfomsoɔ no wɔ ha.
help-card-color-what-it-is-description: Hyɛ kɔla ma kaad no akyi kɔla a ɛyɛ ne dea sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛda adi wɔ bɔɔd no so, sɛ nhwɛsoɔ kɔkɔɔ ma adwuma a ɛho hia ntɛm anaa adetɔfoɔ ankasa kɔla. Wɔyɛ kaad no nsɛm sɛnea wobɛtumi akenkan wɔ kɔla no so ankasa.
help-card-color-how-it-works-description: Mia kɔla a wɔato din no mu baako so, kɔla a wɔayɛ a wɔde adi dwuma wɔ bɔɔd yi so dada, anaa paw kɔla biara wɔ Wo ankasa kɔla ase, afei mia Sie. Yi de kɔla no kɔ. Kɔla no pue wɔ kaad ketewa so ne kaad a abue mu, gye sɛ wɔadum wɔ Bɔɔd nhyehyɛeɛ / Kaad mu.
help-card-drawing-what-it-is-description: Mfonini twa ma wotwa anaa wode nsa kyerɛw wɔ kaad no so denam akura, nsateaa anaa twerɛdua so: mfonini tiawa, nhyehyɛeɛ mfonini, nsa ano agyiraeɛ anaa nkyerɛwee a wɔde nsa akyerɛw. Wobɛtumi asan asesa mfonini no na wɔsan sie ne mfonini sɛ kaad no ho adeɛ.
help-card-drawing-how-it-works-descripti: Paw kɔla ne nkyerɛwee trɛ na twa. San yɛ san kɔ anammɔn baako akyi, Popa yi nkyerɛwee a ɛka no, na Pepa ne nyinaa yi biribiara. Sie kora nkyerɛwee no wɔ kaad no so na ɛsie mfonini no sɛ adeɛ a wɔde aka ho; mfonini foforɔ bɛyɛ kaad no akyi mfonini. Wɔkyerɛ mfonini a wɔasie wɔ ha sɛ wobɛsan abue na woasesa, na Twe sɛ SVG sie baako sɛ fael.
help-card-more-what-it-is-description: Pii kyerɛ kaad no link, ne kaad maame ne bere a wɔyɛɛ no. Ɛhɔ na wɔyɛ kaad no adwuma ketewa ma kaad foforɔ, na ɛhɔ na bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ pepa kaad no koraa.
help-card-more-how-it-works-description: Yɛ kaad link bio kɔ clipboard so yɛ kaad no address bio. Wɔ Sesa kaad maame ase no, paw bɔɔd a efi hɔ ne kaad maame, anaa biribiara na san yɛ no kaad a ɛwɔ soro koraa; Fa kaad maame foforɔ ka ho de maame pii ka ho, na nnyinasoɔ a ɛwɔ baako nkyɛn yi no. Pepa, ma bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ nko ara, yi kaad no koraa bere a wɔasi so dua.
help-card-create-board-what-it-is-descri: Yɛ bɔɔd fi kaad yi so dane kaad no link a ɛkɔ bɔɔd foforɔ so. Ɛyɛ ma kaad a anyini abɛyɛ ne ankasa adwuma kɛseɛ: adwuma no kɔ ne ankasa bɔɔd so, na kaad no tena baabi a na ɛwɔ sɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so kɔ mu.
help-card-create-board-how-it-works-desc: Wɔde kaad no asɛmti hyɛ bɔɔd foforɔ no din ma; sesa no sɛ wopɛ a na mia Yɛ bɔɔd fi kaad yi so. Wɔyɛ bɔɔd no a wo na woyɛ ne sohwɛfoɔ, na afei kaad no bue saa bɔɔd no. Biribi foforɔ biara nsesa wɔ kaad no so. Sɛ wɔpo a, wɔkyerɛ deɛ enti na biribiara nsesa.
help-card-link-to-board-what-it-is-descr: Bɔ bɔɔd ho de kaad yi kaad a link wɔ so gu bɔɔd foforɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ dada so. Afei kaad no pue wɔ bɔɔd mmienu no so: nea edi kan tena baabi a ɛwɔ, na link no kyerɛ ne nsɛm wɔ baabi a wode gu.
help-card-link-to-board-how-it-works-des: Paw bɔɔd, kwan ne nhwɛso, afei kaad ne sɛ link no bɛkɔ ne soro anaa n'ase, na mia Wɔawie. Wɔ nhwɛso hunu mu no, link no kɔ ase. Wɔnsesa kaad a edi kan no, na wɔnyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne no bio. Wɔkae baabi a ɛrekɔ ma bɔɔd biara.
help-card-actions-what-it-is-description: Kaad no mɛnu, Kaad Nneyɛeɛ, boaboa biribiara a wobɛtumi ayɛ wɔ kaad no nyinaa so ano, sen wɔ ne mmeae baako so. Nsɛm a ɛpue gyina wo dwumadie wɔ bɔɔd no so.
help-card-actions-how-it-works-descripti: Tu ne yɛ bio wɔ Tu kaad, Yɛ kaad bio, Sie sɛ nhwɛsoɔ, Yɛ nhwɛsoɔ bio ma kaad pii, Kaad a ɛsan ba ne tu kɔ nhwɛso no soro anaa n'ase. Afei Hwɛ ne Nsoroma ba, ne Ahoɔfɛ a Hyɛ kɔla, Mfonini ne Yɛ kaad fi nneyɛeɛ mu wɔ mu. Kyɛ wɔ kaad link, Bɔ bɔɔd ho, QR code ne Abakɔsɛm, afei Yi adi ne Fa ba mu. Adekorabea wɔ Fa kaad kɔ adekorabea, Pii ne Yɛ bɔɔd fi kaad yi so.
help-admin-version-what-it-is-descriptio: Version fa no kyerɛ nea WeKan yi de redi dwuma: WeKan version ne sɛnea wɔde hyɛɛ mu, kɔmputa nhyehyɛeɛ, Meteor, database ne Node.js. Ɛyɛ Sohwɛfoɔ paanel / Nhyehyɛeɛ fa a edi kan ne nsɛm a wobɛyɛ bio de akɔ mfomsoɔ amanneɛbɔ mu bere a worehwehwɛ mmoa.
help-admin-version-how-it-works-descript: Kenkan pon no, a wɔakyekyɛ mu ayɛ Platform, OS, Meteor, Database ne Node. Mia Hwɛ version na fa toto WeKan, FerretDB, Meteor, Node ne NPM version foforɔ a wɔayi adi ho; bere a ɛrekɔ so no ɛka sɛ ɛreba, na sɛ nhwehwɛmu no anyɛ yie a wohunu mfomsoɔ nkra baako mmom.
help-admin-appearance-what-it-is-descrip: Ahoɔfɛ si gyinaeɛ wɔ sɛnea WeKan yi te ne nea Bɔɔd nyinaa kyerɛ: mfa a wɔde asie te sɛ baguam bɔɔd anaa bɔɔd dwumadie, obi a ɔbɛtumi ayɛ bɔɔd, da kyerɛwbea, sɛnea kaad nsɛm bue trɛ, link address, abɔnten ɔhaw akyidi link ankasa, adeɛ din, kɔla ne agyiraeɛ mfonini.
help-admin-appearance-how-it-works-descr: Sesa kuo baako mmeae na mia saa kuo no ankasa Sie, a ɛsie saa kuo no nko ara. Agyiraeɛ a ɛwɔ Bɔɔd nyinaa: Sie ase kyerɛ sɛ wɔde adeɛ no asie, gye bɔɔd a dwumadifoɔ biara a wɔakɔ mu betumi asesa, a wɔhyɛ agyiraeɛ bere a wɔama ho kwan. Sesa kɔla sie a Sie bɔtn biara nni hɔ na ɛno nko ara ne kuo a ahyehyɛde ankasa sohwɛfoɔ hunu.
help-admin-features-what-it-is-descripti: Nea wubetumi ayɛ ne baabi a wɛbsaet sohwɛfoɔ sɔ anaa ɔdum WeKan mfa a ɛho nhia ma nhyehyɛeɛ no nyinaa: bɔɔd hwɛbea, mmoa, Kanban ne Scrum adwinnadeɛ, kaad mmeae, Adwuma dodoɔ ne tumi, Sika nhyehyɛeɛ ne ka gyeɛ, SQRL, ActivityPub, Mmara a wotumi kenkan nko ara ne API a ɛhyia a ɛho nhia. Akwan ne nhwɛso wɔ hɔ daa.
help-admin-features-how-it-works-descrip: Yi agyiraeɛ fi nea WeKan yi nni sɛ ɛde ma so, a kaad mmeae a ɛnsɛ sɛ bɔɔd biara kyerɛ ka ho, na mia Sie. Dwumadie a woayi n'agyiraeɛ fi so yera fi obiara nhyehyɛeɛ mu na server no nso po, nanso wɔkora ne nsɛm. Wobɛtumi ahwehwɛ mpene ma dwumadie a WeKan foforɔ de ka ho, na woabɔ sɔhwɛ dwumadifoɔ a wɔda so hunu dwumadie a wɔadum din.
help-admin-feature-profiles-what-it-is-d: Dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ ma dwumadifoɔ, akuo anaa ahyehyɛde a wɔapaw WeKan ketewa denam dwumadie bi a ɛho nhia a ɛde sie wɔn so, bere a afoforɔ nyinaa kɔ so hunu biribiara. Ebetumi de dwumadie koro a Nea wubetumi ayɛ fa no betumi adum no asie.
help-admin-feature-profiles-how-it-works: Mia Fa nhyehyɛeɛ ka ho, ma no din, hyɛ dwumadie a ɛde sie agyiraeɛ na kyerɛw ne dwumadifoɔ, akuo ne ahyehyɛde, afei mia fa no Sie. Din a ɛne obiara anhyia no, wɔka ho asɛm bere a wɔasie na wɔnkora. Wɔsɔ nhyehyɛeɛ no hwɛ wɔ krataafa nhyehyɛeɛ mu, na dwumadini no muni mɛnu ka kyerɛ no nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛde dwumadie dodoɔ bi sie.
help-admin-security-what-it-is-descripti: Ahobanbɔ kura server nyinaa sɔ ne dum ma nea nsɛm a ahoɔfɛ wɔ mu betumi ayɛ ne nea wobɛtumi de aba mu anaa ayi adi. Fa wɔn di dwuma gyae link a wotumi mia so, kyerɛ nsɛm a wɔahyehyɛ nyinaa sɛ fibea nsɛm kɛkɛ, si nea wɔde ba mu anaa wɔyi adi kwan, hyɛ nea wɔde ba mu kɛseɛ ano, gyae mfonini, anaa sesa dwumadifoɔ ankasa nipasu ma ɛyɛ din a obiara nnim.
help-admin-security-how-it-works-descrip: Hyɛ sɔ ne dum agyiraeɛ na wɔsie ntɛm ara; wɔsie nea wɔde ba mu kɛseɛ a ɛsen biara bere a wofi mmeae no mu, na nsɛm hunu kyerɛ sɛ anohyeto biara nni hɔ. Sɛ wɔnsesa a, sɔ ne dum biara dum na server no hyɛ ma ɛyɛ adwuma, enti wɔpo nea wɔde ba mu anaa wɔyi adi a wɔadum mpo sɛ obi frɛ no tee a.
help-admin-activities-what-it-is-descrip: Server nyinaa sɔ ne dum mmiɛnsa ma wɛbsaet a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhyɛ dwumadie akyidi ano: gyae kyerɛw obi a ɔyɛɛ deɛ, gyae amanneɛbɔ a ɛfa dwumadie ho mena, anaa si dwumadifoɔ kwan na wɔnhwɛ bɔɔd, nhwɛso ne kaad.
help-admin-activities-how-it-works-descr: Hyɛ sɔ ne dum agyiraeɛ na wɔsie ntɛm ara. Bere a dwumadie adum no, wɔnkyerɛw biribi foforɔ na wɔnkyerɛ nsɛm a ɛwɔ hɔ dada bio. Bere a amanneɛbɔ adum no, wɔmfa app mu, ɛmɛl anaa amanneɛbɔ foforɔ biara nkɔ. Bere a hwɛ adum no, obiara ntumi nsesa hwɛ gyinabea. Yi agyiraeɛ fi so na san sɔ; dwumadie a wɔankyerɛw wɔ ntam no nsan mma.
help-admin-delete-what-it-is-description: Pepa wɔ WeKan mu taa hyɛ nhwɛso, kaad ne nneɛma a wɔde aka ho agyiraeɛ sɛ wɔapepa nko ara sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛtumi asan de aba. Fa yi kura sɔ ne dum baako a ɛma wɛbsaet sohwɛfoɔ sɛe saa nsɛm no koraa.
help-admin-delete-how-it-works-descripti: Hyɛ Sɔ pepa koraa ma Wiase Sohwɛfoɔ agyiraeɛ; ɛsie ntɛm ara na ɛno ankasa mpepa hwee. Afei pepa ahyɛnsode pue baabi a wɔde pepa koraa ma, te sɛ nhwɛso wɔ nwura adaka mu anaa bɔɔd a ɛwɔ adekorabea wɔ Bɔɔd nyinaa adekorabea mu. Wɔkyerɛw nhyehyɛeɛ nsakraeɛ biara ne pepa koraa mmɔdenbɔ biara wɔ Recovery mu. Yi agyiraeɛ fi so bere a woawie.
help-admin-announcement-what-it-is-descr: Wɛbsaet nyinaa frankaa a wɔde ka biribi kyerɛ dwumadini biara a wakɔ mu prɛko, te sɛ nsiesie bere, address foforɔ anaa mmara nsakraeɛ. Ɛne bɔɔd ankasa dawurubɔ yɛ soronko.
help-admin-announcement-how-it-works-des: Hyɛ Nhyehyɛeɛ Nyinaa Dawurubɔ a Ɛreyɛ Adwuma agyiraeɛ, kyerɛw nkra no na mia Sie. Frankaa no pue wɔ Fie, Bɔɔd nyinaa ne bɔɔd a dwumadifoɔ ka ho no soro. Dwumadini betumi ato mu, na ɛkɔ so to mu ma no kosi sɛ wobɛsesa nsɛm no. Yi agyiraeɛ adaka no fi so na yi fi hɔ ma obiara.
help-admin-accessibility-what-it-is-desc: Nnipa nyinaa nkɔso krataafa ne baabi a WeKan yi ka kyerɛ ne dwumadifoɔ sɛnea obiara betumi de adi dwuma ne obi a wɔbɛfrɛ no wɔ siw bi ho. Fa yi sɔ saa krataafa no na ɛhyɛ n'asɛmti ne ne nsɛm.
help-admin-accessibility-how-it-works-de: Hyɛ Nnipa nyinaa nkɔso krataafa sɔ agyiraeɛ, a ɛsie ntɛm ara, afei kyerɛw asɛmti ne nsɛm no na mia Sie. Wɔhyehyɛ nsɛm no te sɛ kaad nkyerɛkyerɛmu. Afei bɔɔd amanfoɔ hunu Nnipa nyinaa nkɔso link wɔ bɔɔd no nifa nkyɛn. Yi agyiraeɛ fi so na san de link no sie.
help-admin-translation-what-it-is-descri: Wo ankasa nkyerɛaseɛ nsɛm di WeKan nsɛm a wɔde ahyɛ mu dada so wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ yi so, kasa biara, sɛ nhwɛsoɔ sɛ wode wo ahyehyɛde ankasa asɛmfua ma bɔɔd bedi dwuma anaa wobɛsiesie asɛm bi ansa na nkyerɛaseɛ a wɔasiesie aba.
help-admin-translation-how-it-works-desc: Mia Foforɔ, paw kasa, kyerɛw asɛm a wobɛsesa no safoa (ɛnyɛ Borɔfo asɛm no) ne nsɛm a wɔbɛkyerɛ mmom, afei Sie. Nkyerɛwee a ɛwɔ hɔ dada no nkyerɛaseɛ nsɛm nko ara na wobɛtumi asesa, na wobɛtumi apepa nkyerɛwee bi afi ne mɛnu mu. Nsakraeɛ no fa nsɛm a server no yɛ ho, te sɛ ɛmɛl; wɔ brawsa mu no seesei wɔkyerɛ wɔn ma wɛbsaet sohwɛfoɔ nko ara.
help-admin-pwa-what-it-is-description: PWA fa no hwɛ nea brawsa ne fon kenkan fa WeKan ankasa ho: meta ne link tags foforɔ wɔ krataafa biara mu, wɛb manifest a wɔde di dwuma bere a wɔde WeKan hyɛ mu sɛ app, ne Android app link fael a ɛma Android app bue WeKan link.
help-admin-pwa-how-it-works-description: Hyɛ fa a wopɛ sɛ wosesa no agyiraeɛ, a ɛsie ntɛm ara, fa wo tags anaa JSON hyɛ mu na mia Sie. Wɔpo JSON a ɛnyɛ pɛ na wɔnsie hwee. Wɔde meta tags ka ho sɛ meta elements nko ara, enti wɔyi scripts, styles ne tags a ɛyɛ krataafa foforɔ. Bere a sɔ ne dum bi adum no, WeKan de ne nea wɔde ahyɛ mu dada di dwuma.
help-admin-global-webhooks-what-it-is-de: Wiase webhooks de nkra kɔ address foforɔ so, te sɛ nkɔmmɔ anaa adwuma ankasa server, bere biara a biribi si wɔ WeKan yi bɔɔd biara so. Wɔde krataa koro a bɔɔd ankasa webhooks de di dwuma no ara di dwuma. Fa no nso kyerɛ mfidie a ɛwɔ mu a webhooks betumi adu ho ne kɔ mu ne din kyerɛw webhook.
help-admin-global-webhooks-how-it-works-: Hyɛ krataa hunu no ma denam din, address, token a ɛho nhia ne su, ɔkwan baako anaa akwan mmienu, na mia Yɛ. Wɔ webhook a wɔasie so no, wobɛtumi adum no, apaw dwumadie a ɛde kɔ ne sɛnea ɛde ma, afei Sie. Kyerɛw mfidie a ɛwɔ WeKan ankasa network so wɔ Baabi a ɛwɔ mu ase, baako wɔ nkyerɛwee biara so, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a webhooks betumi adu wɔn ho.
help-admin-shared-labels-what-it-is-desc: Nsɛnkyerɛnne a wɔkyɛ ma nsɛnkyerɛnne din baako ne kɔla baako wɔ bɔɔd pii so prɛko: wɔ bɔɔd biara so, wɔ ahyehyɛde bi bɔɔd so, anaa wɔ kuo bi bɔɔd so. Fa wɔn di dwuma ma nsɛnkyerɛnne te sɛ Ɛho hia ntɛm anaa Adetɔfoɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ ɛte saa ara wɔ baabiara.
help-admin-shared-labels-how-it-works-de: Fa nsɛnkyerɛnne ka ho wɔ nkyerɛwee a etwa toɔ mu ne din, kɔla ne nhwɛso nwoma, afei mia Fa nsɛnkyerɛnne a wɔkyɛ ka ho; nkyerɛwee biara sie anaa pepa ankasa. Wɔ kaad nsɛnkyerɛnne so no, bɔɔd amanfoɔ hunu nsɛnkyerɛnne a wɔkyɛ a wɔn bɔɔd betumi de adi dwuma na wɔmia baako so de ka ho. Sɛ wosesa din anaa kɔla wɔ ha a, ɛsesa no wɔ bɔɔd biara so, na sɛ wopepa a ɛtena saa bɔɔd no so sɛ wɔn ankasa nsɛnkyerɛnne.
help-admin-email-what-it-is-description: Ɛmɛl fa no hyɛ sɛnea WeKan de ɛmɛl kɔ, sɛ ɛfa server no ankasa ɛmɛl nhyehyɛeɛ so anaa ɔma a wɔahyehyɛ no wɔ ha, na ɛkura nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa ho: ɛmɛl domain a ɛbɛtumi ato nnipa nsa frɛ bere a ankasa din kyerɛw adum, sɛ dwumadifoɔ betumi asesa wɔn address, nea wɔbɛyɛ ɛmɛl a ɛsan ba, ne nsa frɛ ne dwumadie ɛmɛl nhwɛsoɔ.
help-admin-email-how-it-works-descriptio: Hyɛ Sɔ a ɛwɔ ɛmɛl nhyehyɛeɛ ase agyiraeɛ, paw SMTP anaa ɔma a wɔde ahyɛ mu, hyɛ ne dwumadini din, ahintasɛm ne nea ɔde kɔ address ma na mia Sie; wɔkora ahintasɛm a wɔasie bere a wogyae mmeae no hunu. Fa sɔhwɛ ɛmɛl kɔma wo ho na hwɛ sɛ ɛyɛ adwuma. Sɛ agyiraeɛ no nni hɔ a, server no ankasa ɛmɛl nhyehyɛeɛ kɔ so yɛ adwuma. Nhwɛsoɔ mmeae hunu kora ɛmɛl a wɔde ahyɛ mu dada.
help-admin-notifications-what-it-is-desc: Wɛbsaet nyinaa nhyehyɛeɛ a edi kan ma amanneɛbɔ: sɛ app mu amanneɛbɔ adaka ne ɛmɛl sɔ anaa adum ma obiara, ne sɛnea ɛmɛl, adaka ne webhooks a ɛkɔ abɔnten de ma sɛ wɔnsesa a. Bɔɔd nhyehyɛeɛ ne muni biara ankasa nhyehyɛeɛ betumi adi so wɔ wɔn ankasa mu.
help-admin-notifications-how-it-works-de: Paw Aane anaa Daabi ma Amanneɛbɔ adaka ne Ɛmɛl; apawdeɛ no sie ntɛm ara. Bue kwan bi na hyɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ, nea ɛkyerɛ, sɛnea wɔboaboa amanneɛbɔ ano ne bere a wɔde kɔ, biara sie ntɛm ara. Bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ ne amanfoɔ betumi apaw Nea edi kan na wɔasan akɔ nea wohyɛɛ wɔ ha so. Ɛmɛl kɔ kaad nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ fa koro yi ara mu.
help-admin-domains-what-it-is-descriptio: Domains kyerɛ ɛmɛl domain biara a akawnt wɔ WeKan yi so de di dwuma, ne dwumadifoɔ dodoɔ a biara wɔ. Ɛyɛ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ ntɛm a wobɛhunu ahyehyɛde a ɛwɔ nhyehyɛeɛ no so na woahunu domain a wonhwɛ kwan a wonkenkan dwumadifoɔ nhwɛso no nyinaa.
help-admin-domains-how-it-works-descript: Kenkan pon no, nkyerɛwee baako ma domain biara ne ne dwumadifoɔ dodoɔ. Kyerɛw domain bi fa wɔ hwehwɛ adaka no mu na mia Enter na hunu, na fa nea atwam ne nea edi hɔ bɔtn kɔ krataafa ntam. Wɔnsie hwee; wɔkan pon no foforɔ bere biara a wɔkyerɛ.
help-admin-organizations-what-it-is-desc: Ahyehyɛde boaboa dwumadifoɔ ano wɔ adwumakuo, ɔfa anaa adetɔfoɔ so sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛtumi de bɔɔd ne nhwɛsoɔ bɔɔd akyɛ wɔn nyinaa, wobɛtumi ama wɔn amanfoɔ ne directory te sɛ LDAP ahyia, na, wɔ multitenancy mu no, ahyehyɛde betumi anya ne ankasa domains, ahyɛnsode ne sohwɛfoɔ.
help-admin-organizations-how-it-works-de: Mia Foforɔ wɔ afadum a edi kan ti so na yɛ baako, Sesa na sesa nkyerɛwee bi, na nkyerɛwee mɛnu na pepa anaa paw ahyehyɛde sohwɛfoɔ. Nkyerɛwee sɔ ne dum ma nhwɛsoɔ a wɔkyɛ, amanfoɔ a wɔde ka bɔɔd ho ne amanfoɔ a wɔde fi kɔ mu ɔma hɔ hyia sie ntɛm ara. Hyɛ Fa bɔɔd amanfoɔ fi Ahyehyɛde koro no ara mu nko ara agyiraeɛ na hyɛ obi a wobɛtumi de no aka bɔɔd ho ano.
help-admin-teams-what-it-is-description: Akuo boaboa dwumadifoɔ a wɔyɛ adwuma bom ano sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛtumi de bɔɔd anaa nhwɛsoɔ bɔɔd akyɛ kuo no nyinaa, wobɛtumi ama amanfoɔ ne directory te sɛ LDAP ahyia, na wobɛtumi atew Nnipa nhwɛso no so akɔ kuo baako so. Wɔyɛ adwuma te sɛ ahyehyɛde a tenant fa nka ho.
help-admin-teams-how-it-works-descriptio: Mia Foforɔ wɔ afadum a edi kan ti so na yɛ kuo, Sesa na sesa no, anaa nkyerɛwee mɛnu na pepa no. Nkyerɛwee sɔ ne dum sie ntɛm ara. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wode nnipa hyɛ akuo mu a, hyɛ wɔn agyiraeɛ wɔ Sohwɛfoɔ paanel / Nnipa / Nnipa mu na mia Akuo. Hyɛ Fa bɔɔd amanfoɔ fi Kuo koro no ara mu nko ara agyiraeɛ na hyɛ obi a wobɛtumi de no aka bɔɔd ho ano.
help-admin-people-what-it-is-description: Nnipa kyerɛ akawnt biara a ɛwɔ WeKan yi so ne ne ɛmɛl, sohwɛfoɔ tebea, dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ, sɛ ɛreyɛ adwuma anaa, aman a wofi mu kɔ mu, nsɔ tebea, dwumadie a etwa toɔ ne da a wɔyɛɛ no. Ɛhɔ na woyɛ, wosesa, wodum, wobue, woyɛ wo ho sɛ obi, woyɛ no a obiara nnim no na wopepa akawnt.
help-admin-people-how-it-works-descripti: Hwehwɛ wɔ dwumadini din, din anaa ɛmɛl so na mia Enter, na fa Kyerɛ ne Kuo tew so. Mia Foforɔ na yɛ dwumadini na Sesa na sesa baako. Mia agyiraeɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛreyɛ adwuma no so na dum anaa sɔ, na nsɔ kɔkɔɔ anaa Bue ne nyinaa na bue. Nkyerɛwee mɛnu wɔ yɛ wo ho sɛ obi, yɛ no a obiara nnim ne pepa; hyɛ nnipa pii agyiraeɛ na mia Akuo na sesa wɔn akuo.
help-admin-locked-users-what-it-is-descr: Ahobanbɔ fi ahoɔden mmɔdenbɔ ho to akawnt mu bere a kɔ mu a anyɛ yie dɔɔso dodo. Fa yi hyɛ mfomsoɔ dodoɔ a ɛma wɔto mu, bere tenten a ɛbɛkyɛ ne bere ntam a wɔkan mfomsoɔ wom, soronko ma dwumadini din a ɛwɔ hɔ ne nea ɛnni hɔ.
help-admin-locked-users-how-it-works-des: Hyɛ mfomsoɔ, to mu bere ne bere ntam ma, wɔ sɛkɛn mu, ma dwumadifoɔ a wonim wɔn ne wɔn a wonnim wɔn na mia Sie; nsɛm foforɔ no yɛ adwuma ntɛm ara a wonsan mfi aseɛ. Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wohunu na woyi akawnt a wɔato mu a, bue Sohwɛfoɔ paanel / Nnipa / Nnipa, paw Dwumadifoɔ a wɔato mu nko ara na mia nsɔ kɔkɔɔ, anaa Bue ne nyinaa.
help-admin-audit-log-what-it-is-descript: Audit log no yɛ nea wɛbsaet sohwɛfoɔ ayɛ ho nkyerɛwee, nea ɛyɛ foforɔ di kan: bere, obi, dwumadie ko, sɛ ɛyɛɛ yie anaa, ne nsɛm ne address a efi mu baeɛ. Ɛbua obi a ɔsesaa biribi ne bere ma nnipa, kɔ mu, akorabea ne backup nhyehyɛeɛ.
help-admin-audit-log-how-it-works-descri: Kenkan pon a ɛwɔ Bere, Sohwɛfoɔ, Dwumadie, Nsɛm ne IP no; wɔhyɛ dwumadie a wɔpoeɛ agyiraeɛ ne ne mfomsoɔ. Kyerɛw wɔ hwehwɛ adaka no mu na tew nkyerɛwee no so wɔ sohwɛfoɔ, dwumadie anaa nsɛm so, na fa agyan a ɛwɔ pon no ase kɔ krataafa ntam.
help-admin-roles-what-it-is-description: Dwumadie si gyinaeɛ wɔ bɔɔd dwumadie a ɛbɛtumi ato nnipa nsa frɛ aba bɔɔd so, ɛma wode nea bɔɔd muni betumi ayɛ yɛ wo ankasa dwumadie, na ɛkyerɛ nea dwumadie biara betumi ayɛ. Wɛbsaet sohwɛfoɔ wɔ kwan biara daa.
help-admin-roles-how-it-works-descriptio: Wɔ Ma kwan ma wɔnto nsa frɛ mmra bɔɔd so ase no, hyɛ dwumadie a ɛbɛtumi ato nsa frɛ agyiraeɛ na mia Sie. Wɔ Wo ankasa dwumadie ase no, kyerɛw din, hyɛ nea dwumadie no betumi ayɛ agyiraeɛ na mia Fa dwumadie ka ho; nkyerɛwee biara sie anaa pepa ankasa, na afei bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ betumi de dwumadie no ama amanfoɔ. Dwumadie tebea pon no kyerɛ nea wo agyiraeɛ no de ba, ansa na woasie mpo.
help-admin-shared-templates-what-it-is-d: Nhwɛsoɔ a wɔkyɛ ma wohwɛ dwumadifoɔ nhwɛsoɔ bɔɔd a wotumi kyɛ wɔ ahyehyɛde, kuo anaa ɛmɛl domain so. Agyiraeɛ no nso si gyinaeɛ wɔ kuo ahodoɔ a wobɛtumi de nhwɛsoɔ bɔɔd akyɛ wɔn afi Bɔɔd nyinaa / Nhwɛsoɔ mu.
help-admin-shared-templates-how-it-works: Hyɛ Ahyehyɛde, Akuo anaa Domains agyiraeɛ; agyiraeɛ biara sie ntɛm ara ma nhyehyɛeɛ no nyinaa. Wɔ nea woahyɛ agyiraeɛ biara ase no, wohunu kuo biara, ne dwumadifoɔ ne wɔn nhwɛsoɔ bɔɔd, na sɛ womia nhwɛsoɔ bɔɔd so a ɛbue. Sɛ kuo bi nhwɛsoɔ du n'amanfoɔ nkyɛn anaa, wɔhyɛ no ma ahyehyɛde ne kuo biara wɔ wɔn ankasa fa mu.
help-admin-login-what-it-is-description: Kɔ mu si gyinaeɛ wɔ nea wɔma ho kwan bere a worekɔ mu, te sɛ ahintasɛm a wo werɛ afi, ankasa din kyerɛw, dwumadini din nsakraeɛ, wo ankasa akawnt a wobɛpepa ne ɔkwan apawbea. Ɛsan ma wodi server no kɔ mu nhyehyɛeɛ so a wonsan mfi aseɛ, sɛ nhwɛsoɔ ahintasɛm kɔ mu, ɔkwan a edi kan, nhyiamu tenten, fi mu ankasa, ahintasɛm mmara ne nhwɛsoɔ mmienu nsi so dua a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ.
help-admin-login-how-it-works-descriptio: Hyɛ Kɔ mu: Ma kwan agyiraeɛ adaka no agyiraeɛ anaa yi fi so; biara sie bere a womia so. Bere a ankasa din kyerɛw adum no, fa To nnipa nsa frɛ to address nsa frɛ ma bɔɔd a woapaw. Wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ krataa no mu no, mmeae biara ka nsɛm a ɛreyɛ adwuma; kyerɛw anaa paw nsɛm na sie, anaa gyae no hunu anaa paw Nea edi kan na san kɔ server no nhyehyɛeɛ so. Kɔ mu ɔkwan biara wɔ ne fa wɔ Nnipa mɛnu mu.
help-admin-saml-what-it-is-description: SAML kɔ mu ma nnipa kɔ mu denam wo ahyehyɛde nipasu ɔma so sen WeKan ahintasɛm. Ɔma no si wɔn nipasu so dua denam nkra a wɔde nsa ahyɛ ase so na WeKan de wɔn kɔ mu, na ɛyɛ akawnt no bere a edi kan a wɔkɔ mu.
help-admin-saml-how-it-works-description: Kyerɛw nipasu ɔma no kɔ mu address ne nsa ahyɛ ase krataa, WeKan yi nea ɔde ma din ne apawdeɛ afoforɔ wɔ fa yi mu, anaa wɔ server no nhyehyɛeɛ mu; nsɛm a wɔsie wɔ ha di server no dea so. Sɛ wɔsɔ a, kɔ mu krataafa no kyerɛ Fa SAML kɔ mu bɔtn a ɛde dwumadini no kɔ nipasu ɔma no nkyɛn na ɛsan de no ba.
help-admin-ldap-what-it-is-description: LDAP kɔ mu ma nnipa de dwumadini din ne ahintasɛm a wɔwɔ dada wɔ wo directory mu kɔ mu, te sɛ Active Directory anaa OpenLDAP. WeKan de ahintasɛm no toto directory no ho, ɛyɛ akawnt no bere a edi kan a wɔkɔ mu na ebetumi ama din, ɛmɛl, sohwɛfoɔ tebea, ahyehyɛde ne akuo ne directory no ahyia.
help-admin-ldap-how-it-works-description: Hyɛ directory no address, port, encryption, base ne sɛnea wɔhwehwɛ dwumadifoɔ ma, afei sie; nsɛm a wɔasie di server no nhyehyɛeɛ so na Nea edi kan san de server no nsɛm ba. Mia Sɔ LDAP nkitahodie hwɛ na sɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛreyɛ adwuma no hwɛ, na Ma LDAP dwumadifoɔ nhyia seesei na fa akyi nhyiamu no yɛ ntɛm ara. Paw LDAP sɛ ɔkwan a edi kan wɔ Kɔ mu fa no mu.
help-admin-oauth2-what-it-is-description: OAuth2 ne OpenID Connect kɔ mu ma nnipa de akawnt a ɛwɔ dwumadie foforɔ so kɔ mu, te sɛ Keycloak, Authelia anaa GitLab, sen WeKan ahintasɛm. Ɛnte sɛ social kɔ mu ɔma a wɔahyɛ dada, wode kyerɛ ɔma biara denam n'address a wode bɛma so.
help-admin-oauth2-how-it-works-descripti: Kyerɛw WeKan din sɛ app wɔ ɔma no nkyɛn, afei kyerɛw ne client id, ahintasɛm, server address, endpoints ne sɛnea ne dwumadini mmeae hyia WeKan wɔ ha; nsɛm a wɔsie wɔ ha di server no nhyehyɛeɛ so na ɛyɛ adwuma kɔ mu a edi hɔ a wonsan mfi aseɛ. Afei kɔ mu krataafa no kyerɛ kɔ mu bɔtn a wɔhyɛ ne nsɛm wɔ Kɔ mu fa no mu.
help-admin-cas-what-it-is-description: CAS yɛ prɛko kɔ mu nhyehyɛeɛ: nnipa kɔ mu prɛko wɔ wo ahyehyɛde CAS server so, na WeKan gye tikɛt a ɛde ma no di, enti WeKan nhunu ahintasɛm no da.
help-admin-cas-how-it-works-description: Kyerɛw CAS server no base, kɔ mu ne nhwehwɛmu address wɔ ha na sɔ no; nsɛm a wɔsie wɔ ha di server no nhyehyɛeɛ so. Paw CAS sɛ ɔkwan a edi kan wɔ Kɔ mu fa no mu, anaa ma dwumadifoɔ mpaw fi ɔkwan apawbea no mu. Kɔ mu de brawsa no kɔ CAS kɔ mu krataafa so na ɛsan de ba WeKan a wɔakɔ mu.
help-admin-header-login-what-it-is-descr: Header kɔ mu ma reverse proxy a wɔgye no di a ayɛ prɛko kɔ mu dada ka kyerɛ WeKan dwumadini no nipasu, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a dwumadini no bɛkɔ mu a ahintasɛm biara nni hɔ na wɔyɛ akawnt no nsrahwɛ a edi kan.
help-admin-header-login-how-it-works-des: Wɔkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ yi wɔ ha sɛ wotumi kenkan nko ara na wontumi mfi Sohwɛfoɔ paanel mu nsie, efisɛ proxy a wɔgye no di betumi akɔ mu sɛ obiara; wɔhyɛ wɔn wɔ server no nhyehyɛeɛ mu na wɔsan fi aseɛ. Ɛsɛ sɛ proxy no si dwumadini no so dua, de nipasu headers kɔ na yi headers a ɛte saa biara a clients de ba, na proxy address a wɔakyerɛw nko ara na wɔgye di.
help-admin-oauth-providers-what-it-is-de: Yei ne social kɔ mu bɔtn a wɔayɛ dada: Google, GitHub, Facebook, Twitter, Meteor Developer, Weibo ne Meetup. Biara hia app id ne ahintasɛm a ɔma no de ma wo nko ara, na wobɛtumi de wɔn ne OAuth2 kɔ mu a ɛyɛ ne nyinaa adi dwuma bom.
help-admin-oauth-providers-how-it-works-: Yɛ app wɔ ɔma no developer wɛbsaet so ne WeKan callback address, afei kyerɛw ne id ne ahintasɛm wɔ ha na sɔ ɔma no; nsɛm a wɔsie wɔ ha di server no nhyehyɛeɛ so. Afei Fa kɔ mu bɔtn ma saa ɔma no pue wɔ kɔ mu krataafa no so.
help-admin-passwordless-what-it-is-descr: Kɔ mu a ahintasɛm nni mu ma dwumadini kɔ mu denam code a wɔde di dwuma prɛko a WeKan de kɔma no wɔ ɛmɛl so, sen ahintasɛm. Ɛyɛ ahotɔ ma nnipa a wɔn werɛ fi ahintasɛm, ɛnyɛ nhwɛsoɔ a ɛto so mmienu, na ne ahobanbɔ te sɛ dwumadini no ɛmɛl adaka dea ara pɛ.
help-admin-passwordless-how-it-works-des: Hwɛ sɛ ɛmɛl a ɛkɔ abɔnten yɛ adwuma, afei sɔ no wɔ ha; nsɛm a wɔsie wɔ ha di server no nhyehyɛeɛ so. Afei kɔ mu krataafa no de kɔ mu code ma wɔ ɛmɛl so: dwumadini no kyerɛw n'address, onya code a ɛyɛ adwuma bere tiawa bi, ɔkyerɛw na ɔkɔ mu.
help-admin-backup-what-it-is-description: Backup yɛ WeKan yi akorabea seesei anaa sɛnea nhyehyɛeɛ te, a nsɛm, nneɛma a wɔde aka ho ne mfonini yɛ apawdeɛ soronko, na ɛsan de ba. Wɛbsaet sohwɛfoɔ yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no nyinaa anaa ahyehyɛde baako backup; ahyehyɛde ankasa sohwɛfoɔ yɛ ne bɔɔd nko ara backup. Backup a ɛkɔ so daa de nsakraeɛ biara kɔ mmom sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛtumi asan akɔ bere biara so.
help-admin-backup-how-it-works-descripti: Paw nea ɛka ho, hyɛ nea wobɛfa aka ho agyiraeɛ na mia Yɛ backup seesei; backup a ɛyɛ pɛ hia ne mmiɛnsa nyinaa ne nhyehyɛeɛ no nyinaa. Hyɛ da biara, nnawɔtwe biara anaa bosome biara nhyehyɛeɛ na Sie. Mia Kyerɛ backups na san de baako ba, sɛ wode nsɛm a ɛnni hɔ nko ara bɛka ho anaa wobɛsesa biribiara. Wɔ Backup a ɛkɔ so daa mu no, hyɛ fɔlda a ɛrekɔ, nsɛm ne bere a wɔkora, afei paw baabi a wobɛsan akɔ.
help-admin-attachments-what-it-is-descri: Nneɛma a wɔde aka ho fa no si gyinaeɛ wɔ baabi a wɔkora kaad nneɛma a wɔde aka ho ne mfonini, kɛseɛ a ɛbɛtumi ayɛ, bere tenten a wɔkora wɔn ne sɛnea wɔtu wɔn fa akorabea ntam. Wobɛtumi akora fael wɔ server no disk so, wɔ database mu anaa wɔ cloud akorabea te sɛ S3, MinIO, Azure, Google Cloud Storage anaa WebDAV mu.
help-admin-attachments-how-it-works-desc: Paw fa bi fi benkum mɛnu mu. Hyɛ akorabea a fael foforɔ kɔ mu, hyehyɛ akorabea biara ne ne kenkan ne kyerɛw sɔ ne dum, na tu nneɛma a wɔde aka ho anaa mfonini fi akorabea baako kɔ foforɔ mu. Anohyeto hyɛ fa bra ne twe kɛseɛ, Kora pepa nneɛma dedaw a wɔde aka ho nna bi akyi, na Database tu tu nsɛm fa MongoDB ne FerretDB ntam.
help-admin-problems-summary-what-it-is-d: Sohwɛfoɔ paanel / Ɔhaw krataafa a edi kan ne wo da biara nhwehwɛmu ma server no nyinaa. Ɛka kyerɛ wo nea ɛrekɔ so seesei, nea ɛnyɛ yie seesei, ne ɔhaw foforɔ dodoɔ a amanneɛbɔ biara aboaboa ano, ne bɔtn a wode bɛsiesie anaa wobɛgye atom.
help-admin-problems-summary-how-it-works: Tebea kyerɛ ntutuo ne nsiesie a ɛrekɔ so, a ebetumi ama kɔ mu akyɛ, na ɔhaw biara ne ne dodoɔ ne nea ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ di akyi, ne Siesie kaad a abubu, San fa bra anaa Siesie bɔtn baabi a ɛfata. Nsiesie a ɛpepa nsɛm bisa wo sɛ di kan mia Si so dua. Wɔ Nsɛm apɔmuden ase no, Hyɛ aseɛ yɛ akyi nhwehwɛmu. Wɔ Ɔhaw ase no, hyɛ amanneɛbɔ a woahwɛ agyiraeɛ na mia Gye tom na san yɛ wɔn dodoɔ foforɔ, anaa Pepa na pepa wɔn nkyerɛwee.
help-admin-problems-security-what-it-is-: Mmɔdenbɔ biara a ahobanbɔ wɛnfoɔ poeɛ anaa ohuu: nea ɛyɛ, sɛnea emu yɛ den, obi a ɔbɔɔ mmɔden, baabi a efi ne mpɛn dodoɔ. Ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi bɔɔ mmɔden, ɛnyɛ sɛ wɔato tokuro no mu nko ara. Ahobanbɔ sɔ ne dum no ankasa wɔ Sohwɛfoɔ paanel / Nhyehyɛeɛ / Ahobanbɔ mu.
help-admin-problems-security-how-it-work: Wɔkyerɛ nkyerɛwee no a nea ɛyɛ foforɔ di kan, na mmɔdenbɔ a ɛsan ba yɛ nkyerɛwee baako a ne Mmɔdenbɔ dodoɔ kɔ soro, na Nsɛm ka nea wɛnfoɔ no huu. Kyerɛw din, nkyekyɛmu, fibea, dwumadini din anaa address wɔ hwehwɛ adaka no mu na yiyi mu bere a woreyɛ, na mia dwumadini din bi so na bue saa akawnt no. Gye amanneɛbɔ no tom anaa pepa wɔ Ɔhaw / Mua so.
help-admin-problems-impersonation-what-i: Sohwɛfoɔ a wɔyɛ wɔn ho sɛ dwumadifoɔ afoforɔ ho nkyerɛwee. Wo ho a woyɛ sɛ obi ma sohwɛfoɔ hunu WeKan sɛnea dwumadini baako hunu no, sɛ nhwɛsoɔ sɛ ɔbɛyi kokoam bɔɔd adi, na amanneɛbɔ yi ma saa tumi no da adi akyiri.
help-admin-problems-impersonation-how-it: Wɔkyerɛw nkyerɛwee bere a sohwɛfoɔ paw Yɛ wo ho sɛ dwumadini wɔ Sohwɛfoɔ paanel / Nnipa mu, ɔyɛ kɔ mu token ma dwumadini foforɔ denam REST API so, anaa ɔyi bɔɔd, kaad anaa adeɛ a wɔde aka ho adi bere a ɔyɛ ne ho sɛ obi. Nkyerɛwee biara kyerɛ da, sohwɛfoɔ, dwumadini a ɔyɛɛ ne ho sɛ ɔno, bɔɔd ne deɛ enti, nea ɛyɛ foforɔ di kan. Mia din bi so na bue saa dwumadini no, na fa Enter hwehwɛ. Biribiara wɔ ha nsesa anaa ɛmpepa nkyerɛwee biara.
help-admin-problems-password-length-what: Ɛkyerɛ wɔn a wɔde ahintasɛm a ɛtiaa sen tenten a ɛsua koraa kɔ mu, baabi a efi, ne sɛ wɔasesa fi saa bere no anaa. Wobɛtumi ahunu wɔn a ɛbɛka wɔn ansa na woahyɛ ahintasɛm foforɔ tenten a ɛsua koraa so.
help-admin-problems-password-length-how-: Hyɛ Ahintasɛm tenten a ɛsua koraa, hyɛ Hyɛ tenten a ɛsua koraa so agyiraeɛ na po ahintasɛm foforɔ a ɛtiaa, na mia Sie. Wɔmpo kɔ mu da, nanso bere a wɔahyɛ so no, wɔbisa akawnt a ahintasɛm dedaw tiawa wɔ so sɛ ɔnni kan nsesa. Pon no wɔ nkyerɛwee baako ma akawnt biara ne kɔ mu a edi kan ne nea etwa toɔ, address, kɔ mu dodoɔ ne bere a wɔsiesiee. Yiyi mu wɔ Ahintasɛm a ɛtiaa dodo, Wɔasiesie ayɛ ahintasɛm a ɛware sɛ anaa Ne nyinaa so. Wɔnkyerɛ akawnt a ɛfa LDAP, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, CAS anaa Sandstorm so kɔ mu.
help-admin-problems-performance-what-it-: Ɛkyerɛkyerɛ sɛnea WeKan de bɔɔd kaad ba mu, a ɛno na ɛkyerɛ sɛnea ɛyɛ den sɛ wobɛbue bɔɔd kɛseɛ. Ɛyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmu nko ara, a biribiara nni hɔ a wobɛmia so anaa wobɛsie.
help-admin-problems-performance-how-it-w: Kaad a wɔde ba yɛ ankasa ma bɔɔd biara: bɔɔd a kaad boro 500 wɔ so de kaad a wohunu wɔ nhwɛso biara mu nko ara ba bere a woretu kɔ fam, ne akontaa a efi server no so, na bɔɔd ketewa de kaad biara ba. Server hwɛfoɔ betumi ahyɛ sɛ ɛmfa ne nyinaa mmra anaa ɛmfa nkakrankakra mmra, anaa asesa kaad dodoɔ no, wɔ server no nhyehyɛeɛ mu na wasan afi aseɛ. Bɔɔd Akontaabu hwɛbea kyerɛ ɔkwan a ɛde di dwuma.
help-admin-problems-speed-what-it-is-des: Ɛkyerɛ wɛb krataafa ne REST API abisadeɛ a ɛkyɛɛ ansa na wɔrebua, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛhunu krataafa anaa ɔfrɛ a ɛyɛ brɛoo ne mpɛn dodoɔ.
help-admin-problems-speed-how-it-works-d: Wɔsusu abisadeɛ biara bere gye fael a ɛnsesa, na nea ɛgye sɛkɛn mmienu anaa nea ɛboro saa sɛ wɔnsesa a, wɔkyerɛw. Wɔkora abisadeɛ brɛoo koro no ara sɛ nkyerɛwee baako a ne dodoɔ ne ne da kɔ soro, na Nsɛm kyerɛ ɔkwan, kwan ne bere a ɛgyeeɛ. Hwehwɛ yiyi mu bere a woreyɛ, na Ɔhaw / Mua gye tom anaa ɛpepa. Wɔhyɛ anohyeto no, anaa sɛ wobɛdum no, wɔ server no nhyehyɛeɛ mu. Methods ne publications bere a ɛreyɛ adwuma seesei wɔ Instrumentation ase mmom.
help-admin-problems-tests-what-it-is-des: Server a ɛreyɛ adwuma no ankasa nhwehwɛmu a anyɛ yie. Ntɛm ara a ɛhyɛ aseɛ akyi no, WeKan hwɛ sɛ database no bua, sɛ wobɛtumi akyerɛw wɔ fael fɔlda mu, sɛ memory heap no da so wɔ baabi ne sɛ disk no wɔ baabi a ɛda hɔ kwa.
help-admin-problems-tests-how-it-works-d: Nhwehwɛmu no yɛ adwuma prɛko, bɛyɛ sɛkɛn 15 bere a server no ahyɛ aseɛ akyi, na nea anyɛ yie nko ara na ɛyɛ nkyerɛwee: Fibea bɔ nhwehwɛmu no din na Nsɛm ma ne mfomsoɔ nkra. Ɔhaw foforɔ biara nni hɔ kyerɛ sɛ biribiara anyɛ bɔne fi bere a wɔpepaa amanneɛbɔ no a etwa toɔ. Fa no nni bɔtn a ɛsan yɛ wɔn, enti san fi WeKan aseɛ. Gye tom anaa pepa wɔ Ɔhaw / Mua so.
help-admin-problems-cpu-what-it-is-descr: Ɛhwɛ mfidie no nyinaa processor adesoa, efisɛ WeKan ne ne database wɔ kɔmputa koro so betumi de CPU pii adi dwuma a ɛbɛma software afoforɔ ayɛ brɛoo. Wɔkyerɛw bere a CPU kɔ soro kyɛ wɔ ha, na adwuma tenten yɛ brɛoo bere a mfidie no adwuma dɔɔso.
help-admin-problems-cpu-how-it-works-des: Nkyerɛwee a ɛwɔ soro kyerɛ CPU a wɔde redi dwuma seesei, cores dodoɔ, adesoa mfinimfini, nea ɛsua, mfinimfini ne nea ɛso a aba nnansa yi, ne nea WeKan reyɛ, a ɛyɛ foforɔ sɛkɛn 5 biara. Pon a ɛwɔ ase no kyerɛ bere a adwuma dɔɔso a atwam: mfitiaseɛ nkyerɛwee, nkyerɛwee baako pɛ a ɛfa brɛoo ho, ne awieeɛ nkyerɛwee a ɛwɔ bere tenten, soro koraa ne sɛ brɛoo no boaeɛ anaa. Hwehwɛ yiyi mu bere a woreyɛ. Anohyeto, anaa sɛ wobɛdum hwɛfoɔ no, wɔ server no nhyehyɛeɛ mu.
help-admin-problems-ram-what-it-is-descr: Ɛhwɛ memory ne swap dodoɔ a mfidie no nyinaa de di dwuma, na ɛkyerɛw bere a memory a wɔde di dwuma pii hyɛ aseɛ ne bere a ɛwie. Sɛ memory sa anaa swap ba a, ɛma WeKan ne software afoforɔ a ɛwɔ mfidie koro so yɛ brɛoo anaa ɛbubu.
help-admin-problems-ram-how-it-works-des: Nkyerɛwee a ɛwɔ soro kyerɛ memory a wɔde redi dwuma seesei sɛ ɔha nkyɛmu ne sɛ gigabytes a wɔde adi dwuma ne ne nyinaa, ne swap bere a mfidie no wɔ bi, a ɛyɛ foforɔ sɛkɛn 5 biara. N'ase no, pon no kura mfitiaseɛ nkyerɛwee baako ne awieeɛ nkyerɛwee baako ma bere biara a memory kɔɔ soro, nea ɛyɛ foforɔ di kan, nkyerɛwee 10 wɔ krataafa biara so, ne hwehwɛ adaka. Gye tom anaa pepa wɔ Ɔhaw / Mua so. Anohyeto no wɔ server no nhyehyɛeɛ mu na wɔkenkan bere a server no hyɛ aseɛ.
help-admin-problems-disk-what-it-is-desc: Ɛhwɛ baabi a ɛda hɔ kwa wɔ disks a ɛkura database, nneɛma a wɔde aka ho ne nneɛma a wɔde aba so. Disk a ayɛ ma ma fa bra nyɛ yie na ɛsiw database no kyerɛw kwan, enti yei ma kɔkɔbɔ ntɛm ansa na ɛbɛsi.
help-admin-problems-disk-how-it-works-de: Nkyerɛwee baako a ɛreyɛ adwuma seesei ma disk biara kyerɛ ɔha nkyɛmu a wɔde adi dwuma, gigabytes a ɛda hɔ kwa ne ne nyinaa, ne beaeɛ ne nea WeKan kora wɔ hɔ, a ɛyɛ foforɔ sɛkɛn 30 biara, na disk a ɛwɔ bere a ɛkɔ soro mu no wɔhyɛ no hann. Pon a ɛwɔ ase no wɔ mfitiaseɛ nkyerɛwee ne awieeɛ nkyerɛwee ma bere biara a wɔde di dwuma pii, na hwehwɛ yiyi mu bere a woreyɛ. Gye tom anaa pepa wɔ Ɔhaw / Mua so. Wobɛtumi de disks afoforɔ a wobɛhwɛ aka ho wɔ server no nhyehyɛeɛ mu.
help-admin-problems-instrumentation-what: Nea WeKan server yi reyɛ akontaabu a ɛkɔ so seesei: nkitahodie dodoɔ a abue, ne mpɛn dodoɔ a wɔfrɛ method ne publication biara, mpɛn dodoɔ a ɛnyɛ yie ne bere a ɛgye. Ɛkyerɛ WeKan fa a adwuma dɔɔso anaa ɛnyɛ yie seesei a nhwɛsoɔ adwinnadeɛ foforɔ biara nhia.
help-admin-problems-instrumentation-how-: Nkyerɛwee a ɛwɔ soro kyerɛ nkitahodie a ɛreyɛ adwuma, nea abue ne nea wɔato mu ne bere a akontaabu hyɛɛ aseɛ. Nnua ma beaeɛ biara, te sɛ Kaad, Bɔɔd, Kɔ mu anaa Nneɛma a wɔde aka ho, kyerɛ ɔfrɛ, bere mfinimfini ne mfomsoɔ; mia beaeɛ bi so na kyerɛ ne nkyerɛwee nko ara, na san mia so na kyerɛ ne nyinaa. Pon no kyerɛ ɔfrɛ, nea wɔawie, mfomsoɔ, ne bere mfinimfini ne nea ɛso. Ɛyɛ foforɔ sɛkɛn enum biara, ɛkan server adeyɛ yi nko ara, na ɛsan fi zero bere a wɔsan fi aseɛ.
help-admin-problems-broken-cards-what-it: Ɛkyerɛ kaad a bɔɔd biara ntumi nkyerɛ, efisɛ bɔɔd, kwan anaa nhwɛso a ɛyɛ wɔn dea no nni hɔ. Ɛkata bɔɔd biara a ɛwɔ server no so so, sɛ woyɛ muni anaa wonyɛ.
help-admin-problems-broken-cards-how-it-: Nkyerɛwee biara kyerɛ kaad asɛmti, ne id, bɔɔd, kwan ne nhwɛso a ɛda so wɔ hɔ asɛmti, ne su ne bere a wɔyɛɛ no; beaeɛ hunu ne fa a ɛnni hɔ no. Kyerɛw asɛmti bi fa na mia Enter na hwehwɛ, na fa nea atwam ne nea edi hɔ bɔtn kɔ krataafa so. Fa no kyerɛ kaad nko ara: fa Siesie kaad a abubu wɔ Ɔhaw / Mua so siesie wɔn. Sɛ wobue bɔɔd bi a, ɛno nso siesie ne kaad.
help-admin-problems-files-what-it-is-des: Ɛkyerɛ nneɛma a wɔde aka ho a wɔakora wɔ server yi so, ne bɔtn a ɛde nea database ka fa adeɛ biara a wɔde aka ho ne mfonini ho toto nea ɛwɔ akorabea mu ampa ho. help-admin-problems-files-how-it-works-d: Pon no kyerɛ nhwɛsoɔ, fael din, kɛseɛ, su ne adeɛ a wɔde aka ho, bɔɔd ne kaad ids, ne hwehwɛ adaka. Hwɛ fael ne abakɔsɛm, Hwɛ fael su ne extensions, anaa Hwɛ fael a ɛnni hɔ ne nea wonnii akyi hyɛ nhwehwɛmu aseɛ; Gyae nhwehwɛmu gyae no. help-admin-problems-rules-what-it-is-des: Ɛkyerɛ adwuma ankasa mmara biara a ɛwɔ server no so ne ne bɔɔd, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛhunu wɔ baabi baako nea WeKan yɛ ankasa wɔ bɔɔd nyinaa so, sɛ nhwɛsoɔ bere a worehwehwɛ mmara a ɛtu kaad a wonhwɛ kwan.
help-admin-problems-rules-how-it-works-d: Pon no kyerɛ mmara asɛmti, ne bɔɔd, ne dwumadie su ne nea ɛkanyan no dwumadie su, nkyerɛwee 10 wɔ krataafa biara so, a wɔahyehyɛ wɔ bɔɔd so. Fa no yɛ nea wotumi kenkan nko ara: sɛ wopɛ sɛ wosesa mmara bi a, bue ne bɔɔd na sesa wɔ saa bɔɔd no mmara mu.
help-admin-problems-webhooks-what-it-is-: Pon a ɛkyerɛ webhook biara a ɛwɔ server no so, bɔɔd biara webhooks ne wiase dea nyinaa: bɔɔd a biara yɛ ne dea, obi a ɔde kaa ho ne baabi a ɛde kɔ. Ɛboa ansa na woadum webhooks, asɛm bi akyi, anaa bere a nsɛm kɔ baabi a obiara nkae sɛ ɔhyehyɛeɛ.
help-admin-problems-webhooks-how-it-work: Nkyerɛwee baako ma webhook biara, nea ɛyɛ foforɔ di kan, kyerɛ bɔɔd, wura, din, address, su, sɛ ɛsɔ anaa adum, dwumadie a ɛde kɔ, sɛ wɔahyɛ token anaa, ne bere a wɔde kaa ho. Mia bɔɔd asɛmti so na bue bɔɔd no na sesa ne webhook wɔ hɔ, na wiase webhooks wɔ Sohwɛfoɔ paanel / Nhyehyɛeɛ / Wiase Webhooks mu.
help-admin-problems-boards-what-it-is-de: Ɛkyerɛ bɔɔd biara a ɛwɔ server no so ne n'ahwɛ kwan, amanfoɔ, ahyehyɛde ne akuo. Ɛbua bɔɔd a ɛwɔ hɔ, obi a ɔbɛtumi ahunu biara ne obi a ɔwɔ so, a wommue bɔɔd biara.
help-admin-problems-boards-how-it-works-: Nkyerɛwee biara kyerɛ asɛmti, id, kwan, sɛ bɔɔd no wɔ adekorabea anaa, amanfoɔ a wɔreyɛ adwuma, ne ahyehyɛde ne akuo a wɔne wɔn kyɛ. Fa nea atwam ne nea edi hɔ bɔtn kɔ krataafa so. Wontumi nsesa hwee wɔ ha.
help-admin-problems-cards-what-it-is-des: Ɛkyerɛ kaad biara a ɛwɔ server no so, ne baabi a ɛwɔ ne obi a ɔwɔ so, wɔ bɔɔd nyinaa so sɛ woyɛ muni anaa wonyɛ. Ɛbua baabi a kaad bi wɔ ne n'amanfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔde adwuma ama wɔn, a wommue bɔɔd baako baako.
help-admin-problems-cards-how-it-works-d: Nkyerɛwee biara kyerɛ kaad asɛmti, ne bɔɔd, ne kwan ne ne nhwɛso, ne n'amanfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔde adwuma ama wɔn dwumadini din. help-admin-problems-recovery-what-it-is-: Baabi a wobɔ database no ho ban na wowie adwuma a egyinaa kwan mfinimfini. Ɛkyerɛ database nhwehwɛmu, backups ne nea wɔsan de baeɛ abakɔsɛm, na ɛma wosi gyinaeɛ wɔ nea ɛbɛto ɛmɛl a akyere, amanneɛbɔ, mmara ɛmɛl, nhwɛso nhyiamu adwuma ne bɔɔd a wɔde reba mu a egyinaeɛ.
help-admin-problems-recovery-how-it-work: Efi soro no wohunu fael nhwehwɛmu bɔtn, afei ɔfa te sɛ ɛmɛl a wɔde rekɔ ntoatoasoɔ, dwumadie amanneɛbɔ a ɛretwɛn, mmara ɛmɛl, nhwɛso nhyiamu adwuma ne nea wɔde reba mu a egyinaeɛ, biara ne bɔtn te sɛ Gyina, Kɔ so, San yɛ, Tow gu anaa Kora. Si so dua bere a wɔbisa, na sɛ adwuma no reyɛ a, mia Yɛ no foforɔ na san bɔ mmɔden. Pon a ɛwɔ ase no kyerɛw nsiesie asɛm ne gyinaeɛ biara; kyerɛ Ne nyinaa, Wɔawie, Anyɛ yie anaa Wɔapepa na fa Enter hwehwɛ.
help-admin-problems-offices-what-it-is-d: Ɛkan kɔ mu a ɛyɛɛ yie wɔ onipa ne address biara so, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛhunu baabi a akawnt biara fi kɔ mu ne address a akawnt pii kyɛ. Address a wɔkyɛ betumi ayɛ adwumabea, VPN anaa network nkitahodie a wɔkyɛ; ɛnkyerɛ sɛ akawnt no yɛ onipa baako.
help-admin-problems-offices-how-it-works: Wɔkyerɛ nnipa baako baako, biara ne nkyerɛwee ma address biara: IPv4, IPv6, kɔ mu a edi kan ne nea etwa toɔ, kɔ mu dodoɔ, ne beaeɛ bere a proxy a ɛwɔ WeKan anim de bi ma. Kyerɛw dwumadini din, din nyinaa, address anaa beaeɛ na mia Enter na hwehwɛ, na fa nea atwam ne nea edi hɔ bɔtn kɔ krataafa so. Wɔnsiw obiara kwan esiane amanneɛbɔ yi nti, enti address a wɔkyɛ nto nnipa mu da.
help-admin-problems-api-what-it-is-descr: Ɛkyerɛ REST API endpoints a wɔde di dwuma, obi a ɔde di dwuma ne mpɛn dodoɔ. Mfa afoforɔ ka nea anyɛ yie; yei ka nea wɔhwehwɛ sɛ server no yɛ. Wɔ server a wɔnsɔɔ REST API so no, ɛda hɔ hunu.
help-admin-problems-api-how-it-works-des: Nkyerɛwee biara yɛ akawnt ne endpoint, nea adwuma dɔɔso di kan: ɔfrɛ dodoɔ, bere a wɔfrɛɛ no kan ne nea etwa toɔ, ne IPv4 ne IPv6 address foforɔ ne wɔn beaeɛ. Dwumadini din hunu kyerɛ ɔfrɛ a efi obi a onni akawnt hɔ, a wɔhunu no wɔ address so. Kyerɛw endpoint, method, dwumadini din anaa address na yiyi mu bere a woreyɛ, na kɔ nkyerɛwee 10 so prɛko.
help-admin-problems-database-what-it-is-: Ɛkyerɛkyerɛ nea database no kaeɛ. Mfomsoɔ a efi MongoDB, SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB anaa SAP HANA mu taa yɛ nea wɔakyerɛw ama ne developers, enti fa yi bɔ database no din, ɛde ɔhaw no hyɛ su bi mu te sɛ disk, kɔ mu, syntax anaa bere a atwam, na ɛde nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛyɛ mmerɛw ne anammɔn a edi hɔ ka ho.
help-admin-problems-database-how-it-work: Wɔkyerɛ nkyerɛwee no a nea ɛyɛ foforɔ di kan. Nsɛm ka nea ɔhaw no kyerɛ ne nea ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ, na database no ankasa nkra di akyi, na afadum afoforɔ no kyerɛ database, su, sɛnea emu yɛ den, adwuma no, obi ne baabi a efi bere a wonim, ne mpɛn dodoɔ. Hwehwɛ yiyi mu bere a woreyɛ, a database no ankasa nsɛmfua ka ho. Bere a woadi ho dwuma a, gye tom anaa pepa wɔ Ɔhaw / Mua so.
help-admin-problems-integrity-what-it-is: Ɛkyerɛ sɛ server yi gyinaa yie anaa, nea ɛmaa ɛbubuu, ne sɛ backup a ɛkɔ so daa no anyɛ yie anaa, ne fael nhwehwɛmu bɔtn koro a ɛwɔ Fael amanneɛbɔ mu no ara. Hwɛ ha bere a biribi ato mu a wonhwɛɛ kwan.
help-admin-problems-integrity-how-it-wor: Wɔkyerɛw nkyerɛwee ma nsan fi aseɛ a wɔannyina yie, sɛ nsan fi aseɛ ntɛm bere a server no san baa simma mmiɛnsa mu anaa ɛbubuu bere a ɛkyɛɛ sen saa, ma mfomsoɔ a wɔanhwɛ ne ne nkra, ne bere a backup a ɛkɔ so daa no anyɛ yie. Nkyerɛwee no, nea ɛyɛ foforɔ di kan, 10 wɔ krataafa biara so, na hwehwɛ yiyi mu bere a woreyɛ. Fael nhwehwɛmu bɔtn a ɛwɔ soro nsesa fael anaa nkyerɛwee biara. Gye tom anaa pepa wɔ Ɔhaw / Mua so.
help-admin-cloud-what-it-is-description: Cloud paanel yɛ hosting hwɛfoɔ krataafa a ɔde hwɛ adetɔfoɔ pii WeKan domains so fi baabi baako: wɔn nna, databases, ka krataa, mmoa tikɛt ne nkɔmmɔ, DNS nkyerɛwee ne wɛb server akwan. Ɛwɔ hɔ bere a server no nhyehyɛeɛ sɔ ma ne ankasa domain nko ara, na wɛbsaet sohwɛfoɔ a wɔwɔ hɔ, Cloud Admins no nko ara na wohunu.
help-admin-cloud-how-it-works-descriptio: Fa adetɔfoɔ domains ka ho ne wɔn nna ne sɛ biara wɔ ne ankasa WeKan ne database anaa ɛkyɛ yei, sɔ database nkitahodie hwɛ, na kyerɛw ka krataa. Domain biara nya mmoa bɔɔd ma tikɛt ne nkɔmmɔ. Hwɛ na yɛ DNS nkyerɛwee foforɔ, fa wɛb server akwan bra, na kyerɛw address a wɔama ho kwan na hyɛ baabi a Cloud Admins betumi afi akɔ mu ano. Adetɔfoɔ kɔ mu na wohunu wɔn ankasa domain.
help-all-boards-what-it-is-description: Bɔɔd nyinaa yɛ krataafa a ɛkyerɛ wo bɔɔd. Benkum mɛnu no paw bɔɔd a wɔbɛkyerɛ, te sɛ Nea wɔahyɛ nsoroma, Nea aka, Fie, Nhwɛsoɔ, Adekorabea, adwumabea anaa ahyehyɛde anaa kuo, na ti dua no wɔ hyehyɛ, hwehwɛ, yi adi ne Multi-Pawion.
help-all-boards-how-it-works-description: Mia ɔfa bi wɔ benkum mɛnu mu na afei bɔɔd bi so na bue no. Fa Hyehyɛ bɔɔd ma wo ankasa twe nhyehyɛeɛ anaa asɛmti so, na hwɛbea mɛnu no na sesa fa bɔɔd ahyɛnsode ne pon ntam. Sɔ Multi-Pawion na hyɛ bɔɔd agyiraeɛ na fa kɔ adekorabea, yɛ bio, yi adi anaa hyɛ baako sɛ wo Fie bɔɔd, anaa twe bɔɔd kɔ Adekorabea so.
help-workload-what-it-is-description: Adwuma dodoɔ ne tumi kyerɛ, nnawɔtwe biara, adwuma dodoɔ a onipa biara wɔ ne nnɔnhwerew a ɔwɔ ntam, wɔ bɔɔd biara a woyɛ adwuma wɔ so. Ɛkyerɛ obi a adwuma aboro no so, obi a ɔbɛtumi agye bi aka ho, ne nea adwuma kɛseɛ a ɛreba hia ansa na wɔabɔ obiara din.
help-workload-how-it-works-description: Paw nnawɔtwe a edi kan, nnawɔtwe dodoɔ ne sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛ nnɔnhwerew anaa story points, afei mia nnawɔtwe bi so na hunu ne kaad. Nnawɔtwe a adwuma boro nnɔnhwerew so yɛ kɔkɔɔ. Hyɛ wo ankasa adwuma bere, nimdeɛ ne bere a wonni hɔ, bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ de nkyekyɛmu ne beaeɛ a wɔde sie ma dwumadie ka ho, na sohwɛfoɔ de aman nna kronkron ka ho.
help-billing-what-it-is-description: Sika nhyehyɛeɛ ne ka gyeɛ ne baabi a bɔɔd sohwɛfoɔ hyehyɛ na wogye ka wɔ bɔɔd adwuma ho: ne sika nhyehyɛeɛ, nea adwuma no abɔ ne nea ɛbɛbɔ, dɔnhwerew biara ka, ka a wɔbɔ, ka a ɛnsesa, bo nsusuiɛ ne ka krataa, a ɛgyina bere a wɔakyerɛw wɔ kaad so.
help-billing-how-it-works-description: Paw sika su ne dɔnhwerew ka ma muni biara ne bɔɔd nea edi kan, hyɛ sika nhyehyɛeɛ, na fa ka a wɔbɔ ne ka afoforɔ ka ho. Afei bere a wɔakyerɛw wɔ kaad so kyerɛ sɛ nea wɔde adi dwuma ne nkɔmhyɛ wɔ sika nhyehyɛeɛ no ho. Sɛ wopɛ a, pene bere so ansa na woayɛ ka krataa. Hyɛ wo ka krataa yɛfoɔ nsɛm ma prɛko, afei yɛ ka krataa ma bere bi, twe wɔn ba, hyɛ wɔn agyiraeɛ sɛ wɔde akɔ na kyerɛw ka a wɔatua, anaa yɛ bo nsusuiɛ ma adwuma a aka.

gitea-import-help: Ɛde GitHub nkabomkuo anaa dwumadini, anaa ne kɔd akorabea bi, ba Gitea fɔda no mu tẽẽ: git, nsɛm, twe nsrɛmu, adwenkyerɛ, nsɛnkyerɛnne, akwansideɛ, mfirieɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde aka ho. Ɛsɛ sɛ Gitea gyae. San yɛ bio na fa deɛ ɛyɛ foforo anaa deɛ wɔasesa nko ara ba.

gitea-token-refused: GitHub apo sɔhwɛ no. Ne mmuaeɛ:

gitea-delete-repo-wrong-name: Din a wɔakyerɛw no nnyɛ kɔd akorabea no owner/name. Wɔamfa biribiara amfi hɔ.

gitea-packages-unlinked: Nneɛma kuo a ɛne no bɔ abusua no tena owura no nkyɛn, a wonni abusuabɔ:
